Good-Bye Season 17 Double Trouble Event (01/17- 01/24)
Earn double Season Badges from daily and weekly missions during the event.


Shop Update

Transcendence Class Promotion (01/17 -02/06)
Two Transcendence Classes, Special Agent Mei and Pyromaniac Yuri, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

Special Agent Mei
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/75b6df5a437352efa682fef3d0d304808bc76231.png
Background: Mei is a Chinese-born special agent who works for the Intelligence Agency and is trained in high-level combat. Most recently, she had been assigned to assist a fellow agent, but has found this difficult. In a turn of events that wrecked her resume, Mei has been unable to track her target due to their masterful disguise. When she discovered that the troublesome pyromaniac that had been terrorizing the world was actually the agent that she had been told to support, Mei became extremely conflicted, but carried on. Still struggling to find the pyromaniac agent, she eventually received intel that they had met up with David's company, so now Mei is on the move again to finally provide support.
Paired Weapon: Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
Feast's activation time has been decreased, and damage increased.
Zombie Scenario Skill: Special Agent's Stance
Passive: Damage dealt to the boss is increased when playing alongside Pyromaniac Yuri (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). Buff effect is amplified if the connection effect is active, and Pyromaniac Yuri or Special Agent Mei is in the same room (up to 2 players). 
Trap Evasion's Add-On effect is applied by default.
Active: Uses Conceal in Zombie Scenario, which will obscure you. Your HP will slowly recover during this time, but inflicting damage on an enemy will reveal you. Once Conceal is disabled, your movement speed will return to normal, and a set amount of HP will be restored immediately for you and your allies within a set range.
Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
+10% EXP/Points
In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
This character adds one initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.

Pyromaniac Yuri
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f0ed63fef3b67d8e25da7d00298fec62ccdb1e06.png
Background: A mysterious girl with an amazing talent for handling explosives, Yuri is known for working exclusively on more destructive activities. Although she successfully completes most of her missions, she once unintentionally injured Jennifer while on an assignment. Yuri is a master of disguise and can infiltrate any location to get the job done, but recently, she has been on the run from Mei, who has been persistently chasing her after Yuri had planned on using David Black and his company but ended up exposing her current whereabouts to Mei. Now, the two of them find the chase and each other’s company to be getting exhausting.
Paired Weapon: Dual Beretta Gunslinger
Gun Kata's damage is now unaffected by distance, rather than decreasing the farther away your target is.
Gun Kata's damage has been increased
Zombie Scenario Skill: Blow It Up
Passive: Damage dealt to the boss is increased when playing alongside Special Agent Mei (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). Buff effect is amplified if the connection effect is active, and Pyromaniac Yuri or Special Agent Mei is in the same room (up to 2 players).  
Giant's Feet's Add-On effect is applied by default.
Active: Applies explosion damage within a set range around you in Zombie Scenario (Not applicable to objects).
Damage of allies within the explosion range is increased for a set duration.
Explosive Ammo is loaded in your magazines, which explode at set intervals.
Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
+10% EXP/Points
In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
This character adds one initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.

Conditions and Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/933fc4adfa1334a7141cef6da1b24c92b456040d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/591c21162cc35c396c7f068e579616f56b870bc7.png
Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.

Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%

Satellite Mine
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9bd598e8eb7cf0c209457c9d9a85251451467278.jpg
Description: A special mine armed with cutting-edge satellite technology. It can either seek nearby enemies on its own or be manually detonated. When activated, it creates a zone that hinders enemy movement, then calls down a laser bombardment that only harms enemies after a short delay.

Laevateinn
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d3651be67321ae24dfe290155a1477b568473cbf.png
A pistol that holds 50 rounds of 5.7mm explosive ammo that explodes when it hits the target. When you fire beyond a certain number of rounds, a special feature becomes available.
Special Feature: Electric Area. Right-clicking after the gauge is charged 25% removes the Slow debuff on self, deals a set amount of damage to enemies approaching the area, and pushes them back.

A set portion of the damage dealt is restored as HP. (Attack/skill/movement disabling and AoE HP leeching features do not work in certain modes).

Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points

Update Information

Metal Arena is an event mode that can only be played for a limited time.
The end of the Metal Arena mode will be announced in a separate update.
Apart from the new Return of the Arena medal, existing Metal Arena medals cannot be collected during the event.


Mode Improvements

Display Damage Fonts
The advanced settings for Original / Team Deathmatch / Original (AI) / Team Deathmatch (AI) rooms now have an option to Display Damage Fonts.
Original mode can now display damage fonts.
 
Expanded Set Weapon Storage Slots
Weapon slots have been increased from 9 to 12 and a issue was fixed where the shortcut key would not function properly after the 7th page.
 
Human Teams can now be changed in Original (AI) and Team Deathmatch (AI) modes.
The Maintain AI Player Team option allows humans to play on different teams.
 
Gun Deathmatch Weapon Fixes
Lv. 16 Newcomen removed
Lv. 20 Rock Breaker added
 
Studio Improvements
The maximum number of maps has been increased to 120.
Added the ability to send Background Music Blocks / BGM (Scen_S8E2_main, Scen_S8E3_boss., Scen_S8E4_boss).
Added a Ghost option to Player Settings and the ability to check Area Triggers while in Ghost mode.
New speed setting added (X5).
New Weapon Spawner weapons have been added. (M2, MP40, M1 Garand, M1918 BAR, and M1911 A1.)
A skip blocking feature has been added. When enabled this ensures that cutscenes cannot be accidentally skipped.
 
Added Class-Only Voice Blocking
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/83266258269a2499bcb34024b8d05db9f9782a60.jpg
A Mute tab has been added to the far right of the chat window.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5e16aeacb77d71c11c7148a3278f0c305d553475.jpg
Pressing the Mute tab will display the Class-Only Voice Blocking window.
Checking the box to the left of the player list will mute that player's voice.
* AI is not displayed on the list.
* Pressing Block All Radio Voices will block all players on the list (excluding yourself).
* Any blocked players will have their voice muted by default.
* This setting only applies to a single session and is reset when you start a new game.

Option to Shorten Enhancement Cutscenes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/776d2296d090dc201786383ceef04c614119c211.jpg
A feature that shortens cutscenes which play after weapon enhancement has now been added.
Click on Shorten Enhancement Cutscene at the top of the Enhance button to turn this feature on. (Any changed settings will be saved until next login.)
 
Saved Night Vision Goggles Settings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/815b008a776ebaccc5df0b0240652e973e236473.jpg
The settings for Night Vision Goggles will be the same until the session ends. It will only be reset after logging in again or continuing on to the next session. (Zombie Evolution excluded.)
For example, playing a zombie will apply the Night Vision Goggle effect automatically, but turning the effect off will keep it that way even if you become a zombie on the next round.

AI Class Appearance and Weapon Improvements
Various costumes, weapons and AI Classes with equipped zombie skins have been added.

Two Advanced For Them Medal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4b2260e9f893e66f48ac564f45c47c35c799ae50.png
Received after clearing Zombie Scenario with two people using Advanced weapons only

I'll Take It Rare Medal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0df36fb5688b5f2a516a459d631099bfb8f2d92c.png
Received after clearing the Zombie Scenario alone using Rare weapons only

We'll Take It Rare Medal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/42f61c16793554a40b1f2e5322d3902dcb45b17a.png
Received after clearing the Zombie Scenario with two people using Rare weapons only

Keeping It Unique Medal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a10c9f812aedb808cdd799b5d8e4d2d8dbe3087e.png
Received after clearing the Zombie Scenario alone using Unique weapons only

Two Unique To Quit Medal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9e5287ab48313356dd2240a991ed718b0c8fe8a6.png
Received after clearing the Zombie Scenario with two people using Unique weapons only

One Against Ten Medal

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Back-to-School Name Stickers Event! (09/20 - 10/4)New semester has begun! Collect Name Stickers to obtain items like the Shy Light Zombie Nameplate and the Transcendence Decoder!

 Two New Parts Celebration Event (9/20 - 10/4)To celebrate the release of 'Bomb Boost' and 'Bomb Self-Shield', we've made it so you can get rewards simply by playing the game!

 CSN:S 9th Anniversary Event (09/20 - 10/4)It's the 9th Anniversary of CSN:S! Join the event and claim your rewards!

 CSN:S 9th Anniversary Box Sale (09/20 - 10/4)Come celebrate the 9th Anniversary of CSN:S with a special promotion!

---------- Details ----------

Update Information

Zombie New Scenario 8-4 Map
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3102dbc6c2117beb39fa5d3067ffe652e4c2283a.png
Survival: Isolation
Survivors of the Aegis Institute received intel that Super Soldiers and Kronos were meeting up and decided they must surprise them with an ambush. Instead, after arriving at the rendezvous point, the team gets surrounded by a horde of enemies.

New Part Information
Bomb Boost Part - Grades 1 - 6
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/84c7cd73672726356318bfadd5bc16939e88e38d.png
Type: Part
Content: A part that can be equipped on the bomb to enhance its performance.
In Zombie Mode, a set percentage of the bomb's attack power will be increased, depending on the grade of the part.
In Zombie Scenario, a set percentage of the bomb's attack power will be increased, depending on the grade of the part.
* Bombs that can be equipped with parts have a Parts Emblem before the bomb's name.

Bomb Self-Shield Part - Grades 1 - 6
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4f60ccad2515319eb7a0db9e89420ec7da1c1630.png
Type: Part
Content: A part that can be equipped on the bomb to enhance its performance.
- In Zombie Mode, reduces the maximum set amount of damage done to self from equipped bombs, depending on the grade of the part (based on 100 Armor).
- In Zombie Scenario, reduces the maximum set amount of damage done to self from equipped bombs depending on the grade of the part (based on 100 Armor).
* Bombs that can be equipped with parts have a Parts Emblem before the bomb's name.


Event Information

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: August 9th
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c24188cf84f8fc0328b7e258460316451ebdbd1b.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

 Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (8/9– 8/23)The perfect opportunity to play Random Weapon Zombie Hero!

 Ad Balloon Popping Event (8/9 - 9/6)Earn rewards based on how many ad balloons you pop during the event. (The number of times you attack a popped balloon is irrelevant; you receive credit for attacking it at least once.)

 Heat Wave Targets and Water Balloon Grenade Giveaway (8/9 - 8/23)Score zombie kills with the Water Balloon Grenade in Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Evolution to receive rewards

 August Holiday event (8/9 - 8/23)Log in during the event to receive rewards based on how many days you've logged in

 Transcendence Class Promotion (8/9 - 9/6)Two Transcendence Classes, Immortal Eric and Smile Mary, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

 Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Death Eater (8/9 - 9/6)Death Eater will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!

---------- Details ----------

Update Information
Part Open Weapon Information
Part Weapon Expansion
Star Chaser SR


New Events

Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (8/9– 8/23)
The perfect opportunity to play Random Weapon Zombie Hero!

Featured Maps
Italy/Assault/Dust/Abyss 2

Weapon Update
Cousteau, Doom Blaster, Tyrant's Mace, Laser Storm, Avalanche TECH, Crowbar Maverick TECH, Dart Pistol TECH, AUG Guardians, Queen's SL8, Queen's Special Duck Foot Gun, Queen's Tomahawk, Ignite-7, Demolition Hammer, Gravity Repulsor, and M3 Azhi Dahaka


Ad Balloon Popping Event (8/9 - 9/6)
Earn rewards based on how many ad balloons you pop during the event. (The number of times you attack a popped balloon is irrelevant; you receive credit for attacking it at least once.)

Popped Balloons / Rewards
5: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10 + Season Badge x20
10: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5 + Season Badge x30
15: Unique Decoder x3+ 10,000 Mileage
25: Event Decoder x3 + Season Badge x50
35: Class Decoder x5 + 10,000 Mileage
50: Transcendence Decoder x5 + Season Badge x100

Notice
Each account can participate in the mission up to 5 times per day.
Each account can only receive rewards once.
Eligible Maps: Dust 2, Militia, Estate, Mouse Hole, Italy, Assault
Participation will only count in rooms with 3 or more players (includes Laboratory Mode, excludes Studio Mode).
The player that delivers the last hit to a popped ad balloon will receive +10% EXP/Points.
The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.


Ad Balloon Medal Event (8/9 - 9/6)
Become a stone-cold ad balloon killer! Pop 300 ad balloons to earn medals and more!

Conditions / Rewards
Receive [Honor] Killer B Medal + Transcendence Decoder x10 for scoring 300 Kills of the Ad Balloon (depending on the last hit).

Notice
Players who already possess the [Honor] Killer B medal cannot receive another one, but they will still receive the Transcendence Decoder reward.
Only the player that delivers the final hit that pops the balloon will add it to their total kill count (for the purpose of this achievement).


Heat Wave Targets and Water Balloon Grenade Giveaway (8/9 - 8/23/2023)
Score zombie kills with the Water Balloon Grenade in Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Evolution to receive rewards
Water Balloon Grenade: 30% Damage + Knockback Probability

Kills / Rewards
1 Kill: 500 Mileage + Rare Decoder x3
3 Kills: Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days) + Rare Decoder x5 + Unique Decoder x1
5 Kills: Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
6 Kills: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5 + Unique Decoder x3
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ef4d2fcc8e0fd5e4ff6080d584f5a67bc69dae2f.png
7 Kills: Point Transcendence Decoder x10 + Point Class Decoder x10 + Event Decoder x3 + Great Vacation Nameplate (300 Days)

Notice
Each account can participate in the mission up to 5 times per day.
Each account can only receive rewards once.
Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (includes Laboratory mode and excludes Studio Mode).
Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.


August Holiday event (8/9 - 8/23
Log in during the event to receive rewards based on how many days you've logged in:

Rewards
Reach 2 days of total login: Rare Decoder x5
Reach 3 days of total login: Unique Decoder x5
Reach 6 days of total login: Class Decoder x3
Reach 7 days of total login: Event Decoder x5
Reach 9 days of total login: Event Decoder x10
Reach 10 days of total login: Transcendence Decoder x3
Reach 11 days of total login: Class Decoder x5
Reach 12 days of total login: Transcendence Decoder x5

Notice
Each account can only receive rewards once.
You will receive your rewards each time you log in.


Shop Update

Transcendence Class Promotion (8/9 - 9/6)
Two Transcendence Classes, Immortal Eric and Smile Mary, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

Immortal Eric
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2be6331296434b42ea9734483d7dee4da00e8535.png
Background story: After a near-death experience during a zombie attack, his wounds healed up and he returned with an incredible new power. As his superhuman self-recovery rate and physical strength granted him with the resources to compete with the zombies, he willingly fought the undead on the front lines to help others. Fitting his nickname, Immortal, he returns alive every time there is a rumor that he had died. It is known that he is not part of any organizations or groups, but that he does work with Smile Mary.
Paired Weapon: Death Eater
Paired Effect: Special Attack ammo recharge rate increase
Hyperbeam: Fire a beam that deals damage to enemies ahead of you. Knocks zombies back in Zombie modes.
Area duration skill
(Zombie Scenario) Passive: Passively restores HP and increases Defense
(Zombie Scenario) Active: Maximizes the HP recovery and Defense increase effects on self and nearby allies
Connection buff skill
(Zombie Scenario) Playing with Smile Mary grants a chance to not take damage upon hit
Add-On Feature
(Zombie Scenario)  Add-On effect is applied by default, and stacking it will increase only the 10% Decreased Damage effect


Smile Mary
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/edcdb8f9cb80746aaf8bd54550a8382e0bc69667.png
Background story: As the zombie invasion brought dangers to the everyday lives of the people, some of the general public began to awaken their special abilities. Mary is one of those, having the ability to control the aggression of zombies through psychokinesis, amplify the powers of allies, and control minds. Nobody approaches her as it is said that she could even read the minds of others, but there is a rumor that she sticks with Immortal Eric, another psychic.
Paired Weapon: Death Eater
Paired Effect: Special Attack max ammo increase
Hyperbeam: Fire a beam that deals damage to enemies ahead of you. Knocks zombies back in Zombie modes.
Area duration skill
Passive: (Zombie Scenario) When you and your nearby allies are hit, this grants a chance to not take damage and instead increase damage for you and allies nearby
Active: (Zombie Scenario) Maximizes the effects that grant a chance to not take damage and instead increase damage for you and allies nearby upon hit
Connection buff skill
(Zombie Scenario) Playing with Immortal Eric grants a chance to not take damage upon hit
Add-On Feature
(Zombie Scenario)  Add-on effect is applied by default, and using the identical Add-on will stack.


New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (8/9 - 9/6)
Get guaranteed 2 Transcendence Classes (Immortal Eric and Smile Mary) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

Conditions and Rewards
Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
Select one from Immortal Eric + Eric's Hero Helmet or Smile Mary + Mary's Cube

Notice
1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
Selecting Immortal Eric will automatically provide Eric's Hero Helmet (Permanent).
Selecting Smile Mary will automatically provide Mary's Cube (Permanent).
Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can only be received once per account.


Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Death Eater (8/9 - 9/6)
Death Eater will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!

Death Eater Drop Rate
Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%

Death Eater
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/638ee27eb3869435758bd358c74c2de383b17d0c.png
Description: A shotgun developed with alien technology that can hit nearby targets simultaneously with its basic attacks. Its special attack, Hyper Beam, deals damage to enemies in front of the wielder.


Death Eater Guaranteed Giveaway (8/9 - 9/6)
Depending on the number of Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders used, you may be guaranteed to receive the Death Eater permanently!

Reward Thresholds
Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points

Notice
6 Guaranteed Points each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
1 Guaranteed Point every time you use 1 Class Decoder.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: July 26th
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e9a0c33d6a80b85a074cd0318c75afdadaee77be.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

 New Epic Secondary Weapon 'Gravity Repulsor' Promotion (7/26 - 9/6)The new Epic Secondary Weapon, Gravity Repulsor, will drop from Epic Decoders during the event.

 Resonance Energy Collection Event (7/26 - 9/6)Gather Resonance Energy from Epic Decoders and complete missions to earn more items!

 DESERT Weapon Giveaway (7/26 - 8/23)5 Original weapons reimagined with the DESERT concept! Don't miss the opportunity to obtain these new classic weapons by just playing the game!

 Epic Decoder Special Promotion (7/26 - 9/6)Epic Decoder chain purchases with increasing discounts are available during the event!

---------- Details ----------

Improvements

Human HP Recovery Skill ON / OFF (Zombie Hero / Zombie Z Laboratory)
Fixed it so the Human HP Recovery skill is OFF when the Fire Bomb is not used (or whenever Fire Bomb is not used in Zombie Z mode).           


New Events

New Epic Secondary Weapon 'Gravity Repulsor' Promotion (7/26 - 9/6)
The new Epic Secondary Weapon, Gravity Repulsor, will drop from Epic Decoders during the event.

Epic Decoder
Obtainable Items: Gravity Repulsor + Gravity Repulsor Nameplate
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1c0837c7acc7d39ccfc66c5a71744f9bacfb081b.png
Drop Rate: 0.35%

Gravity Repulsor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5fdb1ba9298b49ed2c8a8f951887771175d1b7d7.png
A weapon created with anti-gravity technology. Fires anti-gravity rounds to inflict damage over an area and sends out pulses around the player to protect them. You can also automatically charge the anti-gravity energy to leap and hover in air, and rapidly descend and inflict damage.

Gravity Repulsor Nameplate
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/11b0854ab364384b17554848d87aa3be7dd7ac1e.png
 An exclusive nameplate created to celebrate the release of the 2023 Epic weapon, Gravity Repulsor. This customizes how your name appears in the match lobby.

Resonance Energy Box
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9295bd0c03b99e75c8452137fb7aaddcbe8a419f.png
You have a chance to obtain 3 - 100 Resonance Energy by using a Resonance Energy Box.

Notice
The Gravity Repulsor Nameplate is acquired upon obtaining a Gravity Repulsor.
You will receive 1 Resonance Energy Box for each Epic Decoder used.
You have a chance to obtain 3 – 100 Resonance Energy when using a Resonance Energy Box.
All unused Epic Decoders will be removed and replaced with 100 Mileage each during maintenance on 9/6.
Unused Resonance Energy will be removed and replaced with 15 Mileage each during maintenance on 9/6.
All unused Black Rabbit's Galaxy Boxes will be removed and replaced with 30 mileage each during maintenance on 9/6.
Enhanced weapons and weapons with parts attached that are obtained from Epic Decoders have their durations stacked with already owned weapons (with the same enhancement/parts).

Resonance Energy Collection Event (7/26 - 9/6)
Gather Resonance Energy from Epic Decoders and complete missions to earn more items!

How to Obtain Resonance Energy
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/697699813ed95d5bda6d32976fcd11b768c83ac2.png
Score 6 Kill Points with Kills, Assists, or Human Infections (excluding bots) in Zombie mode: Resonance Energy x1 (up to 20 per day)
Clear Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher after scoring 100 Kill Points: Resonance Energy x3 (up to 25 per day)
Reach 60 minutes of playtime in any mode: Resonance Energy x15 (up to 15 per day)
You have a chance to obtain 3 – 100 Resonance Energy when using a Resonance Energy Box.

Notice
How to Get Zombie Mode Kill Points: Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots) / Zombie Kill Assist as a Human: 1 Point/ Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points (Excluding bots)/ Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points
You can only obtain up to 30 Resonance Energy per day per account (excludes Resonance Energy obtained from Epic Decoders).
The Resonance Energy Shop has a wide and exciting selection of items available for purchase with Resonance Energy. Resonance Energy will be deducted upon a purchase, but don't forget that you'll get bonus fragments with each item!
Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).


Resonance Energy Shop Opening (7/26 – 9/6)
You can purchase new Epic Weapons, Epic Edition Weapons, and other various items with Resonance Energy that you've acquired from Epic Decoders and completing missions.

M3 Azhi Dahaka
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8c3cba7cd51b7ac8cf92fc8d84f6613aeef396ca.png
 A shotgun imbued with the soul of a demonic dragon. Its basic attack is accompanied by dragon breath, which can be used to unleash a  on a marked target, and , which summons the dragon to fight alongside you.

Repulsor Wing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/cd0ff66da39e7e17460846b1906e6e669621d807.png
Wings created using gravity panels. Can be equipped in the back slot.

Super Soldier Mode Update Information
 Experience superior combat like never before!
 For more information, please refer to the [Super Soldier Mode Preview].

Super Soldier Mode Guide
A PVP mode based on Team Deathmatch where humans compete against each other.
Super Soldier players have powerful specs such as High HP and DEF, plus a double jump! Enhanced physical abilities and addition of skills make them formidable in any battle.
Play strategically with the 4 experts: Fighter, Defender, Brawler, and Sniper.
Each expert has specific skills.
You can set hotkeys for each Expert through the Option / Skill Bar Settings.
Collecting the S.V.P. Supply Box during the game will significantly enhance your Attack Power and Movement Speed.
Player specs will be changed based on the Weapon Restriction Options.


Zombie Hero and Zombie Z Update Information

Fire Bomb Options (Zombie Z, Zombie Z Laboratory, Zombie Hero, and Zombie Hero Laboratory)
You can now turn on/off the use of Fire Bombs in Room Settings.
Room Settings > Advanced Options
 (Fire Bomb will be 'on' when Zombie Restriction > Normal Zombies Only is selected)

Option added to restrict the amount of Zombie Z Mutations (Zombie Z and Zombie Z Laboratory)
An option that limits the number of Mutations obtained in Zombie Z.
Select 20, 25, 30, 35, or 40 in the drop-down menu in Room Settings.
Selecting 20 will allow you to acquire a maximum of 20 Mutations. You cannot collect any more after reaching 20.
 (This amount does not include mutations increased by Class, etc.)

Added option for Mutation Restriction (Zombie Z and Zombie Z Laboratory)
This is an option that removes up to 4 selected Mutations in Zombie Z.
You cannot remove Mutations that are automatically provided at certain levels.

Damage from the end of Fire Bomb ending has been adjusted (Zombie Z, Zombie Z Laboratory, Zombie Hero, and Zombie Hero Laboratory)
Damage from the end of Fire Bomb has been adjusted.

If you do not log in during the following season, however, the coupon will be automatically removed.

A page where previous season items can be purchased will become available to those who reach Rank 100 on the Season Pass!
The page begins with the player's progress from the past season, and they can purchase Season Pass Ranks from the page to obtain items.

The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.

CEST (GMT +1) 20:00 - 21:00 Failnaught, Devastator, Satellite Mine, and Spell Lance Scarlet Rose

Get Guaranteed Points when you use Epic Decoders during the promotion!
Conditions and Rewards
Each time you reach 300 points, you can choose 1 of the following weapons:
Divine Blaster / Doom Blaster / Negev NG-7 Ajax / Spell Lance Scarlet Rose / Lightning Fury / Psychic Harmonium

You'll earn 1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Epic Decoder.

All unused Epic Decoders will be replaced with 100 mileage each and removed during the maintenance on 5/17 (Wed).

Divine Blaster / Doom Blaster Crafting Event (4/19 – 5/17)
You can obtain the Divine Blaster or Doom Blaster if you purchase the Blaster blueprint while you own the Doom Blaster or Divine Blaster during the event.
How to Craft
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b9a54eff7cadf5a1d80a78346fc61f13597770a3.png
Divine Blaster (Permanent) can be obtained by pressing [Use] on the Blaster blueprint while both the Doom Blaster (Permanent) and the Blaster blueprint are in your inventory.
Doom Blaster (Permanent) can be obtained by pressing [Use] on the Blaster blueprint while both the Divine Blaster (Permanent) and the Blaster blueprint are in your inventory.
Press [Use] on the Blaster blueprint while the Doom Blaster (Permanent), the Divine Blaster (Permanent), and the Blaster blueprint are all present in your inventory to select and claim either the Doom Blaster (Permanent) or the Divine Blaster (Permanent).

Completing [Use] of the Blaster blueprint will remove the Blaster blueprint from your inventory.
You have to press [Use] on the Blaster blueprint after the purchase to craft it into Divine Blaster (Permanent) or Doom Blaster (Permanent)
It can only be crafted once per account.
If you have not used the Blaster blueprint during the event, they will be used automatically on the 5/17 (Wed) maintenance (Conditions to obtain and rewards are same as the above)


Blaster Blueprint Promotion (4/19 – 5/17)

Notice
The Blaster blueprint can only be purchased by those who own the Doom Blaster (Permanent) or Divine Blaster (Permanent).

Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%
Satellite Mine
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e454a78f866aaa8452bc3acdbe3f8534623333e0.png
Description: A special mine armed with cutting-edge satellite technology. It can either seek nearby enemies on its own or be manually detonated. When activated, it creates a zone that hinders enemy movement, then calls down a laser bombardment that only harms enemies after a short delay.
Laevateinn
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d3651be67321ae24dfe290155a1477b568473cbf.png
A pistol that holds 50 rounds of 5.7mm explosive ammo that explodes when it hits the target. When you fire beyond a certain number of rounds, a special feature becomes available.
Special Feature : Right-clicking after the gauge is charged 25% removes the Slow debuff on self, deals a set amount of damage to enemies approaching the area, and pushes them back.
Special Feature : Right-clicking after the gauge is charged 100% removes the Slow debuff on self, disables the attacks/skills/movement of enemies within the area, and pushes them back. A set portion of the damage dealt is restored as HP. (Attack/skill/movement disabling and AoE HP leeching features do not work in certain modes).


Satellite Mine/Laevateinn Guaranteed Giveaway (4/19 – 5/17)
Depending on the number of Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders used, you may be guaranteed to receive the Satellite Mine/Laevateinn permanently!
Reward Thresholds
Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points
Notice
6 Guaranteed Points each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.
All unused Premium Transcendence Decoders will be replaced with 500 mileage each and removed during the maintenance on 5/17 (Wed).

Other Changes

The existing VVIP Free Pass and VIP Free Pass names, appearance, and descriptions have been adjusted.
Class Pass, a new Diamond rank reward, has been added.
Fixed an issue where an abnormal texture would display after reloading the Heaven Splitter.

Fixed an issue where shooting with the M4A1 Scope would display the flame from the barrel's cover.
Fixed an issue where Pyromaniac Yuri and Special Agent Mei would look awkward while holding certain weapons. 
Fixed the tattoo tooltip on the Encyclopedia to now display the related image. 
Fixed an issue where the Arbalest's normal attacks would not properly display the effects in certain situations. 
Fixed an issue where the reward pop-up window would not display the "Bound" text for bound items.
Fixed an issue where the BGM would not play on the game result screen after ending a session. 
Fixed an issue where certain accounts could not get the BGM to play when they'd run the client. 
Fixed an issue where the AS50 and AS50 Pink Gold's accuracy values after enhancement were incorrectly set.
Fixed an issue where you were able to report yourself in the lobby.
Fixed an issue where the challenge mode would not supply the basic knife.
Fixed an issue where the Divine Blaster and JANUS-11's shop values were not being displayed properly. 
Fixed an issue where Morale Boost values were being displayed incorrectly depending on the time you acquired the Fanatic mutation.
Fixed an issue where using the right-click attack of the Dual Beretta Gunslinger as Pyromaniac Yuri would make the damage decrease depending on range. 
Fixed an issue where the Whip Sword's Special Feature was getting utilized for unusual gameplay tactics. 
Fixed an map spawn error issue in Zombie Scenario Pursuit: Angra Nest. 
Fixed the abnormal texture on the air in Zombie Scenario Pursuit: Last Clue.
Fixed the levels of certain Zombie Z grenades:
Heart Grenade: 26 -> 29
Pumpkin Grenade & Rice Cake Grenade: 1 -> 15
Special Agent May has now been revised to Special Agent Mei.[/olist]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

How to Participate
Earn 2 points each time you score 2 kills or 6 assists as a human, or infect 2 humans as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 40 points per day, excludes bots).

Easter Celebration Costume Event (4/5 - 4/19)
Participate in the event and earn lots of great rewards!

Shop Update

New Transcendence Class Promotion (4/5–5/3)
Two new Transcendence Classes, Special Agent May and Pyromaniac Yuri, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.
Special Agent May
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/75b6df5a437352efa682fef3d0d304808bc76231.png
Background: May is a Chinese-born special agent who works for the Intelligence Agency and is trained in high-level combat. Most recently, she had been assigned to assist a fellow agent, but has found this difficult. In a turn of events that wrecked her resume, May has been unable to track her target due to their masterful disguise. When she discovered that the troublesome pyromaniac that had been terrorizing the world was actually the agent that she had been told to support, May became extremely conflicted, but carried on. Still struggling to find the pyromaniac agent, she eventually received intel that they had met up with David's company, so now May is on the move again to finally provide support.
Paired Weapon: Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
 activation time decreased and damage increased
Zombie Scenario Skill: Special Agent's Stance
Passive: Damage dealt to the boss is increased when playing alongside Pyromaniac Yuri (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). Buff effect is amplified if the connection effect is active, and Pyromaniac Yuri or Special Agent May is in the same room (up to 2 players). 
 Add-On effect is applied by default.
Active: Uses Conceal in Zombie Scenario, which will obscure you. Your HP will slowly recover during this time, but inflicting damage on an enemy will reveal you. Once Conceal is disabled, your movement speed will return to normal and a set amount of HP will be restored immediately for you and your allies within a set range.
Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
+10% EXP/Points
In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.
Pyromaniac Yuri
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f0ed63fef3b67d8e25da7d00298fec62ccdb1e06.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/740bcab1c1c5aa04ea1131fa1c7fe4ab0d4ab62d.png
This is the tale of Ritsuka's return to the Asia Red Army's hideout.

Ritsuka received the request from Douglas Jacob to stop David Black and Erica. She ambushed them, but the mission was a failure, forcing her to retreat to the Asia Red Army's hideout.
However, the Asia Red Army's hideout is in ruins, as if a full-blown war had happened.
Ritsuka investigated the area to assess what had happened there.
Uncontrollable zombies swarmed out of the hideout, with no trace of the Asia Red Army allies anywhere. Ritsuka found herself enraged as she approached the truth.

 Fixed the issue where the animation would display strangely in Zombie Evolution when transforming into a mutant zombie.
 Fixed the issue where the water would display strangely in the Abyss 3 map.

 Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (2/8 – 2/22)The perfect opportunity to play Random Weapon Zombie Hero!

 First Lunar New Year Full Moon - Moon Gazing Event (2/8 – 2/22)Gaze up and wish upon a moon! 

 Valentine Heart Attack Event (2/8 – 2/22)Love blooms this Valentine's in the form of explosive, event-exclusive Heart Grenades! Share the love and get rewards!

 Agent Ritsuka & Pop Star Alin Transcendence Class Promotion (2/8 – 3/8)Agent Ritsuka and Pop Star Alin will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event.

Agent Ritsuka & Pop Star Alin Transcendence Class Promotion (2/8 – 3/8)
Agent Ritsuka and Pop Star Alin will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event.
Agent Ritsuka
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/acba22b17f89f8b29cd7601cff5a59655fff39c5.png
Born in Asia, Ritsuka wandered from one war zone to the next and grew up in the midst of battle. She is currently under the employ of Kronos to kidnap or murder those who dare to resist the company. After being placed under heavy scrutiny due to the failed kidnapping of Ji Yoon Choi, she hid her affiliation and personally engages in missions to ensure their success. * This class has changed to the CT team.
Exclusive Skill: You Think I'm Joking? - The skill activates automatically upon encountering an elite monster in a Zombie Scenario for a chance to instantly kill elite monsters and increase Ritsuka's attack power upon activation.
The Shadow Blade Add-On effect is applied on this character in Zombie Scenario mode. (Can be stacked with other Add-Ons and the effect increases).
Pop Star Alin
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5b44c56ab3085b6dea1508d17a6404528c820170.png
After making her escape with the help of the mercenaries, she couldn't risk revealing herself to the world. Even if she chose to go public, she could be marked for elimination by Kronos and the government agencies that work with them. That's why she chose to hide her identity and adopt the new persona of an idol. Idol by day and terrorist by night, she received a reinforcement request from Victor while out with Dominique to destroy another Kronos factory.
Exclusive Skill: One, Two, Happiness! - Increases the Movement Speed of self and nearby allies within range. Creates a shield for allies and grants invincibility for self for a set duration.
The Group Tactics Add-On effect is applied on this character in Zombie Scenario mode. (Can be stacked with other Add-Ons and the effect increases)
A humming sound has been added when using the Psychic Sizer.


Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (2/8 – 3/8)
Get 2 guaranteed new Transcendence Classes (Agent Ritsuka, Pop Star Alin) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!
Conditions and Rewards
Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use
Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use
Select one: Agent Ritsuka + Agent Sunglasses OR Pop Star Alin + Pink Crystal
Notice
1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
Upon selecting Agent Ritsuka, automatically get the permanent exclusive costume, Agent Sunglasses.
Upon selecting Pop Star Alin, automatically get the permanent exclusive costume, Pink Crystal.
Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can only be received once per account.


Other Changes

 Mission chain bug fix
 The mission chain bug will be fixed 

 Arbalest update
 The normal attack won't be blocked by allies.
 The Cosmic Blackhole recharging time will be shorten.
 The weapon sound won't be played repeatably when using Cosmic Wave and Emotion same time.

 Studio contest reward distribution
 The studio contest reward will be distributed again

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Romy's older brother. He got his quick thinking from his father, a former guard captain of Lost City, and his survival skills were essential in keeping Romy and himself safe. New Events
Find the Zombie Event(11/30–12/14)You can participate via the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.
 How to Participate
- Click the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the lobby screen.
- Among a group of 16 characters (12 zombies, 4 humans), find and hit the zombies using particular bullets.
- Get these bullets from the Find the Zombie Bullet Giveaway
- Hitting a zombie will increase the reward grade by 1 and allow you to take an additional shot. Hitting a human will decrease the reward grade by 1 and reset the Find the Zombie in progress.
- The reward grade can be increased up to a High Class Gold Box if you hit enough zombies consecutively, and you can claim the reward at it's current grade by clicking "Surrender."
- Click "Automatic Fire" to quickly and automatically proceed through one game.

 What is "Automatic Fire"?
- Proceed by randomly firing in a game.

Celebratory Studio Contest InfoWe're celebrating the new theme and blocks by holding a Studio Creation Mode map creation contest!

 Studio contest schedule
- Application Period: 11/2 – 11/30
- Finalists Announced: 12/28
- Player Vote: 12/28 – 1/11
- Winner Announcement & Awards: 1/25

 How to Participate
- Step 1: Create a Studio Creation Mode map
- Step 2: Register a thumbnail image and map description
- Step 3: Add "#partygame" to the map's title

 Criteria
- 10 finalists will be selected based on creativity, number of recommendations, number of cubes earned, use of new blocks and script diversity, utilization of content, and relevance to the subject.
- There is no limit on how many times you can enter, and a single player can win multiple/duplicate prizes.

 Prizes (evaluated based on creativity and popularity)
- 1st (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x300 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
- 2nd (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x200 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
- 3rd (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x100 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
- 4th - 10th: Transcendence Decoder x50 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
- All participants (with +10 map play counts and +3 recommendations): 5,000 Mileage + Contest Participation Medal

 Notice
- If you have already obtained the Excellent Creator Medal, another one will not be given.
- Using new blocks (device, character, and device block) will award extra point, but they are not necessary to win prizes.
- You can only enter each prize category once, and you cannot win the same prize more than once.
- Your award may be revoked if you're not the owner of the account.
- Your award may be revoked if the entry has nothing to do with the subject.
- The entries must be original creations, and your award will be revoked if the entry contains content in violation of the game's Terms and Conditions, contains plagiarized content, or violates the rights of 3rd parties in any way.
- Entries containing sexually suggestive or violent images exceeding the standards of the game may be deleted immediately.
- If there are no entries fitting the selection criteria after evaluation, there may be no winning entry, or the award may be changed.
- All legal responsibilities fall to whoever submitted the entry, should there be a dispute regarding the entry.
- The award may be revoked from contestants who have violated the Terms and Conditions or operational rules of CSNS during the contest or award periods.
- Please submit your entries only if you agree to all of the above.


New Events

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6f571647994f9864e309d096dfeaa7558dd93973.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Content: New Zombie Scenario 8-2 Map Released
Experience the New Super Soldier Project of Kronos: Queen's Story of the Past in the new Zombie Scenario! 

Event: Start the Firework Festival with a bang from the Firework Set! (10/5 – 10/19)
Play every day and collect Firework Sets to earn rewards! 

Event: Epic Weapon Heaven Splitter Guaranteed Giveaway! (10/5 – 11/2)
Based on the amount of Epic Decoders used during the event, you could receive a Heaven Splitter (Permanent)!

Event: Asura Hell Splitter Blueprint Promotion (10/5 – 11/2)
The Asura Hell Splitter is here! Purchase the Asura Hell Splitter blueprint for a guaranteed acquisition of the Asura Hell Splitter. 
Check out the Details section below for more information.


---------- Details ----------

New Content
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8484053203ad3b47eb7e05e6b261a6a7a6430a51.jpg
Zombie New Scenario 8-2 Map Pursuit: Planned Tragedy
 New Super Soldier Project of Kronos: Queen's Story of the Past
 A sudden power outage resulted in all the doors of the laboratory's experimental wards to open. Experiments such as Queen and Cyborg ended up escaping in midst of the chaos, even succeeding in hijacking a helicopter for their escape. Meanwhile, lab researchers monitored them from within the lab. They put together a tracking unit to lure them to a secure location and forced a crash landing by knocking out the helicopter rotors. Still, the Queen and her fellow experiments wished only to escape, but as they tried to leave the lavish, lifeless neon city, they were met by a horde of zombies and other, new experiments. All the while, the Kronos researchers were watching. Now a new experiment begins.
 You can find detailed information in the [Zombie Scenario 8-2 Preview].


Game Improvements 

 Inventory Lock System
- Added a locking feature to prevent important items from being accidentally lost.
- Locking the item will prevent the item from being auto-filled in situations where the item would be spent, such as disassembly, Enhancement Material selection, and auction use.
- Some items (provided by default, event items, etc.)  will have restricted locking features.

 Enhancement Simplification
- Inserting EXP Material has been removed from the process. A feature that guides the player when a high rank weapon is inserted has been added.
- Enhancement Guide and result pop-up window has been improved.

 Zombie Scenario Player Experience Improvements
- An escape feature has been added to use in when a character is stuck within the map. If you are unable to move for a set period of time, [ESC > Map Escape] becomes activated, and you can use it to move to the spawn area.
- Fixed an issue where some Phobos wouldn't appear during Pursuit: Last Clue.

 6 BGM is now added to the Music Block in Studio Mode.

 Other Changes
- Hitbox errors, unnatural modeling, and animations have been revised through class modeling and animation improvements.
- Please refer to [Developer's Letter] for more details.



New Events
Event: Mileage Auction Event (10/5 – 10/18)October opens with an open Mileage Auction! Log in now to get the items you need!
 Permanent Auction Item Added: Trinity Grenade

 Auction Feature / Content
- Item Rank: Premium (All weapons except for premium are Normal Rank)
- Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
- Number of Auction Listings: 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
- Regarding the Market Price of Items:  When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices)
- Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed
- Auction Settings: You can search by bid or direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
- Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
- Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12: 00: 00 AM – 11: 59: 59 PM) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.

 Notice
- As the Trinity Grenade has been added, the M95 White Tiger has been removed from the premium.
- Lower Price Limit: 50,000 / Upper Price Limit: None
- The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
- You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
- Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
- If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
- Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
- If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
- The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
- When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
- Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.


1,000 Mileage Auction Event (10/7 – 10/9)During the auction period, a special item sold for 1,000 Mileage will appear at certain times.
 Time / Special Items
- 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM (CEST) / Spell Lance Scarlet Rose

 Notice
- 1,000-Mileage auction items will appear periodically during auction hours.
- Special items will appear within 10 minutes of the beginning of each auction hour, with bidding open for 10 minutes.
- Those who did not win the auction will be refunded 1,000 Mileage when the auction closes.
- Claim rewards by clicking Obtain after winning.


Start the Firework Festival with a bang from the Firework Set! (10/5 – 10/19)Play every day to get the Firework Set!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3733cb977f6c837d56c9cb8131d13945afbf1d25.png

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Content: Zombie Scenario Event Mode (9/7 - 9/21)
Ability Mode is here! Zombie Ability Scenario is different from other Scenarios thus far. Go experience the power now!

Event: Zombie Scenario Event Mode Max Level Ability Event (9/7 - 9/21)
Go experience the new Zombie Scenario (Event Mode) and earn rewards during the event period!

Event: Transcendence Weapon Failnaught Guaranteed Giveaway Event
Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you could receive a Failnaught (Permanent)!
Check out the Details section below for more information.


---------- Details ----------


New Content

Zombie Scenario New Event Mode Guide (9/7 - 9/21)For details, please refer to the [Zombie Ability Scenario Preview].

Ability
 Ability: A power that inflicts special damage on monsters, apart from weapons and character skills
 Abilities cannot inflict damage on structures.
 You can only have 1 Ability.
 Abilities change according to acquisition rates, but ability levels can always increase.
 Ability Points are earned in increments of 12 levels, from player Lv. 27.
 - Max Level for Abilities is 7.
 - You can also earn EXP from Ability attacks.
Ability Types
 Blizzard: An ice storm surrounds the player. Inflicts damage on monsters within range.
 Meteor: A meteor falls around the player. Inflicts big damage on the enemy.
 Energy Round: Fires a piercing Energy Round straight ahead.
 Gaebolg: Attacking enemies leaves a mark, shortly followed by a spear of light that inflicts damage.
 Flame: Attacks will inflict fire damage. Killing a burning enemy will damage other enemies around them.
 Splash Ball: Shoots a sphere forward that penetrates enemies and ricochets on impact with walls.
Maps for the Event
 Total of 2: Truth Uncovered (7-4), An Approaching Threat (8-1)

VIP System ImprovementVIP System has been relocated to the Home screen, for easier access.

VIP System page has been improved.
 Privileges at all ranks are now available for viewing.
 Tooltip feature has been added to enable players to see the information of reward items.
 Information required for Rank upgrades is now more accessible.
VIP System Perk Renewal
 VIP Perk Enhanced: Supplied mileage increased + Zombie Scenario clear reward enhanced
 VIP Additional Perks
 - Additional distribution of Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (100)
 - Additional distribution of Exploration Success Rate-Up 20%
 - Additional distribution of Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3
VIP System Weapon Catalog Renewal
 Available items on Transcendence Decoders updated, and rotation weapons added to VIP Weapon Pass
 Available items on Class Decoders updated, and rotation classes added to Class Pass distributed above Diamond Rank
 Unique Weapon Pass distributed above Platinum Rank now updated with the Unique Decoder's contents 
 Rare Weapon Pass distributed above Gold Rank now updated with the Rare Decoder's contents

Zombie Conquest (beta) Mode Update InformationFor details, please refer to the [Zombie Conquest (beta) Update Preview].

Some items in the supplied weapon list per base for the Human Team will be changed.

Added 2 Zombies
 Blotter Zombie is now available from the 2nd base.
 Aksha Zombie is now available from the 3rd base.
Zombie Awakening Effect Change
 Light Zombie: Previous awakening effect removed. Conceal duration and cooldown decreased, damage and range during Conceal increased, stun and knockback during Conceal decreased
 Venom Guard: Increased range of damage inflicted on enemies nearby during Awakening
Maps added and bases changed
 Assault and Dust maps will be added.
 Bases will now appear in fixed locations on Town Hall and Skyscraper maps.
Safe Zone: Respawn Areas of both teams are set as Safe Zones.
 Players located inside the safe zones do not take damage, and they can attack outward.
 Players outside of the safe zone cannot attack inside.
 Safe zones can only be entered by that team's members. The opposing team cannot enter the safe zone.
 Humans can press B inside the Safe Zone to access the purchase menu.
 - If you're using supplied weapons, the weapon list will not change until you die.
 - If the base changes, players will be able to purchase weapons relevant to the next base in the safe zone.
Waiting Room Team Integration: Players will be displayed in a single list in the waiting room instead of on their teams.
 Players will be assigned to A and B teams when the game begins. Players who join while the match is already in progress will join the team with less players. If both teams have the same number of players, they'll be placed randomly. 
 [Extra Room Settings > Separate Integrated Team] option will be added, and selecting this option will separate the A and B team members to play.
Other Information
 End of Session related revision: information displayed when the session ends early will include more details.


New Events

Zombie Scenario Event Mode Max Level Ability Event (9/7 - 9/21)Go experience the new Zombie Scenario (Event Mode) and earn rewards during the event period!

How to Participate 
 Reach Lv. 7 (Max Level) on Normal or higher in Ability once

New Content

New Zombie Conquest (beta) Mode Release
Zombie Conquest (beta)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/38cb21d6e474728a40d424e6f75b63fa346570de.jpg
 Mode Rules
- Humans earn points by capturing and holding bases, and zombies must prevent them from doing so. Each team will swap between playing as humans and zombies. The team that ends with a higher score wins.
- Humans capture bases by occupying them. Each base has a maximum amount of points that can be earned. If this maximum is reached, the target base will cycle to the next one, and more time is added to the round. Points will be based on how many bases out of the 3 have been captured by the end of the round.
- Base Disruption: Zombies enter bases to disrupt humans from capturing them.

 Human Rules
- Remember, getting hit by zombies hurts. If you get hurt too much, you die!
- Dead humans may revive to rejoin combat after a waiting period.
- For humans, weapon purchases will be restricted depending on base progression.
- All humans will begin combat with the weapons supplied at the first base.
- Once the second base is active, humans can decide whether they will use the unlocked weapons or keep the weapons they currently have.
- When the third base is active, a previously selected ability will be enhanced for humans.

 Zombie Rules
- For zombies, class selection will be restricted depending on base progression.
- You may only use normal zombies in the first base.
- Light Zombie, Stamper, and Banshee are available for use in the second base.
- Heavy Zombie, Voodoo Zombie, Rusty Wing, and Venom Guard are available for use in the third base.

 Awakening
- The Awakening gauge will charge as you play the game, and [V] will activate it.
- The Awakening gauge will charge over time and can be accelerated through combat and capturing bases.
- Awakening is available for both humans and zombies. Humans have a single, uniform effect, while zombies acquire different effects depending on the zombie class in use.

 Additional Info
- Teams will swap each round.
- If the difference in score becomes too large to overcome, the game may end early.

 Notice
- Press [TAB] in game to check current restrictions, selected abilities, and Awakening effects.

- The enhancement success rate formula is the same as the one that was made public below. 
- Enhancement Success Rate = Cumulative Material EXP / Required Enhancement EXP

- All previous room settings will be ignored when setting up the room for a Competitive Match (Beta), and the settings can't be changed.

Competitive Match (Beta) Room Settings

Weapon Restrictions (Cost Restriction) Added
- All weapons have costs based on their rank, and 4 primary/secondary/melee/throwable weapons with a total cost of 25 or below can be used.
- When the cost of owned, not yet purchased, or not yet picked up weapons exceeds the 25 cost limit, the weapon can't be obtained.
Certain Rule Changes
- Karma gain is doubled.
- Random human heroes don't appear in Competitive Match (Beta), and can be played only by using Karma.
- In Zombie Z mode, zombie heroes can appear at random after all zombies are unlocked.
- The amount of mutations based on Zombie Z levels are increased, and some mutations don't appear.

[New Content]

Zombie Scenario Mode Update
Zombie Scenario New Event Mode Update (12/1 - 12/15)
Random Transformation: End of Madness & Random Transformation: Truth Uncovered
Information: Killing zombies on the event map during the event period grants a chance to drop gene orbs. Earning the orbs (4 types) fills the gauge, and once the orb gauge is full, press the T key to transform into a random monster.
- The 4 types of orbs have a chance to drop from all zombies.
- Earning an orb fills up one tick of the gauge and changes the color of the gauge to that of the orb.
- The more orbs of the same color you collect, the higher your chance of transforming into their respsective monster.\n- Red: Revanant. Green: Yeti. Blue: Dr. Rex. Yellow: Frozen Wrath
- Earning additional orbs after transforming grants a buff that lasts a particular period of time (once per 4 gene orbs).
- If you are having difficulty playing or don't like the selected monster, you can manually cancel the transformation by pressing the T key again.
- While transformed, you will transform back into a human upon death.
- Sitting down after transforming to a monster as certain classes can cause the bottom half of the body to be buried under ground.
New Zombie Scenario Map - Pursuit: Evelyn's Test B
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ccfb304aca5033910307523e9bd59bbe507f390f.png



Exploration System Improvement
Exploration System Rewards Revamped
Rate for exploration start availability changed for each difficulty.
- The difficulty been reduced so the standard class level 1 can run easy difficulty.
Base Reward and Success Reward Changes and Additions
- Base Reward, which is granted regardless of success, now gives a Scenario Add-On and Part.
- For Decoder-related contents (weapons/class) from Success Rewards, it has now been changed to grant unlimited items for a small chance.
Added Exploration Success Rate-Up +10%p item.

Exploration Pileup Progress Event Open

Family System Improvement
Family Achievement Improvement
Family Rewards Revamped: Changed rewards to fit the current state of the game.
Family Achievement Added: With the addition of new Modes and Scenarios, 9 new achievements have been added.
Quality-of-Life Improvements: You can now exclude the achievements you can't pursue when viewing the achievements, and total points are provided in order to see your overall progress.
Family Storage Improvement
When listing enhancements/parts weapon, the portion listed without the enhancements/parts information can now be used with the enhancements/parts information.
The method of viewing weapon enhancement information and part information in storage (outlines, tooltip, etc.) is now displayed the same way as personal inventory.
Other Information
Added Login rate information of the past week to Family Search List and Main Page.
- This information changes in real-time and it marks your attendance if you log in at least one out of the seven days.
- This information is also available on Family Search, so it can help determine which Family members have actually been active in the past week.

Hitting the same enemy with the default firing mode stacks a mark, inflicting additional damage each time it stacks. Upon reaching 5 stacks, damage is transferred to nearby enemies and the stacks are reset. While charging up, the Hunter's Eye activates, allowing you to learn the location of enemies within a certain distance and attack through obstacles. The default firing mode's auto-aim and stack effects, as well as the Hunter's Eye, will not be triggered in specific modes (Zombie/Human Scenario, Zombie Shelter, or Zombie Giant).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2ea1cd4116e7eef4dda5e940f2c03f6e105ac469.png
 A human-vampire hybrid, born into a noble family, she has lived her life suffering from discrimination and neglect because of her mixed blood. Her pride as nobility has become a twisted defense mechanism that leads her to sneer at everything. While she appears human, her vampiric blood gives her great physical abilities. She is the sole survivor of her family. Her parents were executed by the inquisitors when the townsfolk sold them out. She has joined a hunter's guild who highly value her abilities, making a living killing those who could be her brothers or sisters.
 Paired Effect: The maximum amount of penetration for Failnaught's charged shot increases.
 Exclusive Skill: Feast of Blood - In Zombie Scenario, she can use this skill to increase the attack power of herself and allies by 30% for 10 seconds, while restoring her HP for 1% of the damage she deals. Infinite Ammo effect is applied during the duration of this buff (herself and allies). Allies within a certain distance get the buff, but the HP restoring skill is only applied to herself.
Ethan
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1fc9bce6fcf7b6f6593b97069def10745a3d5f0b.png
 An inquisitor who eliminates evil and strives to do good. He has eliminated numerous villains, as if to prove actions are worth more than words. His calm voice and handsome appearance have made him very popular. While he looks calm and gentle on the outside, he loses his cool if he makes a mistake or faces an unexpected situation. He has troubled feelings towards Ismael, who has vampire blood despite being a hunter. He watches her closely, waiting for the moment she proves herself evil.
 Paired Effect: The explosion damage for Failnaught's charged shot increases.
 Exclusive Skill: Barrier - In Zombie Scenario, he can use this skill to create a barrier in front of him. He creates a shield for the himself and allies within certain distance, and slows the movement speed of monsters who pass through the barrier.

Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.

- Assists: 4,000 dollars, 1,500 EXP, and 2x Karma

For rooms with 30 or more players, the number of Host Zombies spawned will be 4
If the Human Team wins, 1 additional Host Zombie will spawn in the next round

- ① Human Team wins 2 times in a row
- ② Human Team's cumulative winning rounds are 4 rounds or more
- ③ Final round (The number of additional Host Zombies spawned will not exceed 2. Based on a 32-player room, the max Host Zombie count per round will be limited to 6.)
Reduced Zombie Respawn TimeIn the event of a death after Detoxification Time, the respawn time has been reduced from 8 sec to 3 sec.
Gameplay Experience ImprovementsMade improvements to the excessive effects when being hit by weapon attacks, alleviating the vision-blocking effects of being hit when you play as a zombie.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0c8eed56017ef6d433e8a8b97d2aee5a6eea145e.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
Content: Zombie Z Season 2 Update
The evolution continues! Achieve greater power in Zombie Z!

Content: Mileage Auction System Improvements
New options for people looking to buy weapons!
	
Event: Get the New Weapon, Magnum Shooter (Permanent)
Collect Special Ammo and unlock the new weapon, Magnum Shooter (Permanent)!

Promotion: New Transcendence Classes, Anemone & Mirage
One's a pro gamer, the other is an iconic virtual streamer (and hacker) from the VR platform Chrono World. Now available in Premium Class Decoders!Check out the Details section below for more information.


---------- Details ----------
 
[New Contents]

Zombie Z Season 2 Update
System Revamp
Max level increased from 30 to 40!
Zombies get greater dollar rewards for dealing damage and infecting targets.
Boosted in-game rewards for playing as a zombie.
- Fixed an issue that prevented a zombie from getting dollar rewards for damage dealt immediately before being killed.
Mutation Improvements
Mutation Enhancement
- Certain mutations can now be enhanced to Lv. 2. Each player can have up to 5 Lv. 2 mutations.
- Press the P key to upgrade one random mutation to Lv. 2. The upgraded mutations will display in the HUD. Each upgrade costs in-game dollars.
- If you already have 5 Lv. 2 mutations, the newly upgraded mutation will randomly replace one of your existing Lv. 2 mutations.
Mutation Boost System
- Mutation Boost lets you temporarily amplify the effects of a Lv. 2 mutation. Mutation Boost lasts for 5 seconds and has a 30 second cooldown.
Added new mutations and improved existing mutations.
- [All] Early Adopter: Reduces all unlock levels by 1.
- [All] Discount Coupon: All purchase amounts in dollars are discounted by 10%.
- [Humans] Quick Change: Increases weapon swap speed.
- [Humans] Double Impact: Grants a low chance to apply damage one additional time.
- [Humans] Net Round: Grants a small chance for attacks to fire a net round.
- [Humans] Glass Cannon: Increases attack power, but also increases damage taken.
- [Humans] Busy Life: Increases attack power when you cannot use skills.
- [Humans] Emergency Escape: Escape into the air after taking what would have been a lethal blow.
- [Zombies] Mutant: Zombie gains an additional skill.
- [Zombies] Furiously Fast: Zombie becomes faster when its HP is low.
- [Zombies] Poisonous Cloud: Creates a cloud of lethal gas when a zombie dies.
- [Zombies] Aggressive Investment: Gain bonus dollars from infected targets.
- [Zombies] Hook Bomb: When a Zombie Bomb explodes, it pulls enemies in.
- [Zombies] Liberator: Increases your strength as you infect more humans.
- [Zombies] Fetch: Inflicting damage with a Zombie Bomb creates a zombie dog.
- [Zombies] Darkness: Allows rebirth as a Darkness Zombie.
- [Changed] Craftsmanship: Reduces skill cooldown.
The zombies from Zombie 4: Darkness now appear in Zombie Z.

Weapon purchase process and other gameplay improvements
Added a recommended weapons page that shows recommended weapons for your level.
- This page appears where Bookmark used to be displayed in the purchase window.
Check Weapon Recommendations system improvements
- Recommendations will be sorted and shown in the order of monthly purchase counts in Zombie Z mode, from high to low.
Random Purchase improvements
- Challenge Reward + is added to Random Purchase. When you score kills with the weapon that is purchased, you will receive additional rewards.
- This bonus only applies to weapons purchased with Random Purchase (Challenging Reward +) early in the round. It ends when you swap weapons, if you get infected, or when the round ends.
Advanced Random Purchase improvements
- Reduced the weapons pool for Advanced Random Purchase, increasing its usability.
Added a checkbox to close the purchase window
- Added the option to toggle closing the purchase window pop-up on or off.
HP bar display for attack target
- An HP bar will display for any enemy you hit directly and any enemy you target with your crosshair for 2 seconds or longer.

Mileage Auction System ImprovementYou can now place buy orders when you want to purchase a weapon
- Looking to Buy tab: Choose a weapon and list the price you want to buy it for.
- Eligible weapons: Regular auctionable items that haven't had any successful transactions in a while.
- Bidding: Potential sellers can browse bids in the Looking to Sell tab.
- The auction runs for 1 hour after the buy listing is posted. One seller is chosen from among those who offered to fulfill the bid and the transaction is completed.
- If the number of sellers exceeds a certain threshold within the 1 hour limit, the auction will end early.

New Contents

Season 9: Fantasy WorldIn CSN:S' ninth season, fantasy world we invite you to explore a fantasy world full of adventures!

1. Season Pass ChangesSeason Pass Reward Revamp
  - Starting with Season 9, Season Pass rewards have been revamped.
  - You'll now receive rewards for each rank of the Free Pass. For details, please refer to the reward table below.
  - You can now check the remaining uses and duration of reward items from the Season Pass reward screen.
Black Market Early Access
  - Starting with Season 9, the Black Market will open early for players who reach Rank 100.
  - When you reach Rank 100 on the current Season Pass, the Season Missions will terminate, and you'll get access to new missions rewarding Black Market Badges.
  - You can access the Black Market from the [Mission] menu. Those who have not reached Rank 100 can only use the Black Market during the off-season.
  - All Black Market Badges you've obtained will vanish when a new season begins.
2. Season InformationA 'season' is a reward system that runs for a set period of time. Complete missions and events during a Season to earn Season Badges which raise your Season Rank. You'll receive rewards based on your rank throughout the season.
3. Season RankSeason Ranks indicate how much progress players have made participating in missions and events in the game. You'll earn various rare rewards when you increase your Season Rank. Season Rank and Season Badges are specific to their respective season.
4. Season RewardsRewards are immediately distributed as you achieve new ranks each season.
If you purchase a Season Pass, you'll get the Season Pass rewards in addition to the free rewards.
Starting with the Season 9 Pass, season rewards will no longer be limited-time items.
Growing Weapons: When you receive a weapon's new stage (from 1-4), you will get to keep the previous stage of the weapon.

Individual zombie limit changed: Increased the max number of individual zombie limits to 4. If you set individual zombie limits, the HP, Armor, Defense, and HP Recovery of all zombies will increase in proportion to the maximum number of zombies.

  - 4 limits: HP and Armor: +3000/Defense: +5%/HP Recovery: +200
2. Zombie Karma updateZombie Stage 2 Karma: Upon using Karma, immediately transforms into a hero zombie class and becomes invincible for 6 sec.
Zombie Stage 3 Karma: Upon using Karma, die and then revive as human after 3 sec. Can only be used after virus detoxification. (If all zombies revive as humans, the round ends in a Human Team victory.)
3. Zombie balance update (skill update)Normal Zombie: Damage taken during Berserk reduced from 150% → 140%
Deimos: Shock cooldown increased from 12 sec -> 15 sec
Metatron: Movement Speed increases by 10% while using Immortality
Psycho: Smokescreen's damage reduction amount reduced from 75% → 65%; Smokescreen cooldown increased from 15 sec → 20 sec; duration per each Smokescreen increased from 1.5 sec → 2 sec
Jiangshi: Invincibility duration reduced from 5 sec → 4sec; invincibility cooldown increased from 15 sec → 18 sec
Aksha: Absorb cooldown reduced from 20 sec → 16 sec, Knockback Resistance slightly increased
Chaser: Defense slightly increased
Rusty Wing: Defense slightly decreased 
4. Zombie Z ContentIf the Zombie Limit is set to Normal Zombies only, the Adaptability mutation will not appear.
Fixed mutation added: Adaptability will be fixed as the 26th mutation given. (If the Zombie Limit is set to Normal Zombies only, you will get a different mutation.)
Mutation Changes

  - Endurance: Changed the default activation rate from 1% → 1.5%
  - Armored Advance: Defense increase per round - 1.5% → 1%
  - Speedy Crouch: Default Movement Speed increase - 50 → 40; Movement Speed increase per round - 5 → 6

The "Death>Kill Rule" option has been moved under Extra Room Settings.
The "Remove Zombie Permanent Death" option has been moved under the room settings.

The slot information displayed will not include inventory information that the player cannot manage directly, such as for PC cafe or VIP pass.
From the inventory's model view, can now toggle the UI on/off by right-clicking the mouse icon on the top right of the model view.
* There may be instances where Default items do not take up inventory slots, depending on how they are distributed. There may also be cases where items are distributed on the system level but do not appear in the inventory. Thus, the actual number of slots available differ slightly from what is displayed.

Icon information: Weapons, Parts, Craft, Classes, Costumes, and Items
The number of items you can disassemble at once has been increased from 9 to 99.
A filter feature that allows you to check per each inventory category will be provided on the right of Select Items for Disassembly.

You can also batch-apply with Ctrl + drag or Ctrl + double-click.

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dc3fa6b220d44444e64bf5c917891a44d61d82eb.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
Content: Daily Mission Revamp
Daily Missions have been simplified and the Black Market is now available during the off-season!

Content: Additional Zombie Scenario Improvements
Zombie Scenario is back with even more improvements.
	
Content: Abyss Difficulty in Zombie Scenario Maps
Introducing an even new level of difficulty: Abyss! Monsters are tougher, stronger, and faster. Are you up to the challenge?

Promotion: New Transcendence Class Promotion (4/21 - 6/2)
Meet the 2 new classes now available from Class/Premium Class Decoders!Check out the Details section below for details.



Expanded Info
 
New Contents

Daily Mission RevampDaily Missions have been simplified and the Black Market is now available during the off-season! For more details, please refer to the Daily Mission Revamp Preview.

There are now 3 types of Daily Missions.Instead of choosing from many missions, now you just need to complete the 3 set missions.
Daily Missions won't reset until you've completed them.
Completed Daily Missions reset every day at midnight.
Significant changes have been made to the Reset Daily Mission items.This item has been renamed to Daily Mission Difficulty Change.
Using a Daily Mission Difficulty Change allows you to change a mission to high, normal, or low difficulty.
When you change a mission's difficulty, you'll keep any progress you've already made. Use this when the going gets tough!
The Black Market is open for business.Before each new season begins, the Black Market will be open.
Get Black Market Badges from Daily Missions and use them to buy items.

Black Market Badge
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/34ae41fa94bd08003dbb24f671b9ab27416f512f.png
  - Type: Item
  - Description: Collect these badges and exchange them for items from the Black Market.
  - All Black Market Badges will disappear when a new season starts.

CSN:S Brand Backpack

  - Description: A CSN:S brand backpack. Can be equipped on the back.

Black Market Items

  - Daily Missions will award Season Badges during a season and Black Market Badges during the off-season!

Additional Zombie Scenario Improvements 2
New Add-Ons and Balance ChangesNew Add-Ons
  - Veteran's Help: When you equip this Add-On and drop a weapon on the ground on Very Hard or higher difficulty, the weapon will remain on the ground without disappearing. Only up to 1 weapon will remain.
  - Deft Movement: Grants a chance not to take damage when hit by an attack.
  - Abundant Returns: Obtain 1 additional Add-On after defeating elite monsters.
  - Healer: Whenever you heal yourself, nearby allies are also healed for a portion of the healing effect's value.
  - Revenger: Increases attack power each time an ally dies.
  - Group Tactics: Reduces damage taken for each nearby ally player.
  - Steel Physique: Increases maximum HP.

Add-On Balance Changes
  - Ammo Reserves - Activation Rate: 5% → 7%
  - Reinforced Attack - Base Damage: 120 → 100
  - Quick Rejoining - Cooldown Reduction: 12% → 15%
  - Addict - Cooldown Reduction: 6 sec → 10 sec
  - Nouveau Riche - Base Dollar Obtained Increase: 150% → 200%
  - Trap Evasion - Activation Rate: 25% → 30%
  - Giant's Feet - Base Damage: 250 → 300

Map Playlist Automatic Add-On Feature
  - When the map changes while you play a Map Playlist, your most recent Add-Ons will keep being used repeatedly until the Map Playlist ends. If you use up all of an Add-On in the middle of a Map Playlist, the other Add-Ons that you haven't used up will continue to be used.
Elite Monster Balance ChangesMonster Stat/Enhancement Effect Balance Adjustments
  - Attack Power Increase: Reduced the amount this increases the monster's attack power.
  - Spider Web: Weakened the movement speed reduction.

New Abyss Difficulty in Zombie Scenario
New Zombie Scenario Difficulty AddedAdded the Abyss difficulty.
Abyss is an even higher difficulty than the existing Inferno difficulty. Monsters will have greater attack power, HP, speed, etc.

Abyss 1 - First Contact
