We plan to regularly add Abyss difficulty to more maps in the future.
Inferno Difficulty ExpandedInferno difficulty, which was previously provided only for a limited number of maps, has been added to be playable on all maps. 

Zombie Mode Update
Season 8 Content ChangesZombie Boost Items Removed
  - Power-ups will no longer appear when a zombie dies.

Zombie Scenario 7-3 - Pursuit: Missed ConnectionsEver since she escaped from the Panic Room, Erica has suffered from mysterious bouts of debilitating pain. Time passed in vain without being able to find the cause. One day, David Black receives a message from Soi out of the blue. Soi claims that there is information about Erica's condition and suggests that Black go to Rex Laboratory to search for a cure. When Black and Erica get there, however, the laboratory is in shambles after an attack. Now they must search the lab for any signs of Soi and a cure.

Zombie Scenario Improvements
Introducing Elite MonstersWhen you play Zombie Scenario on Normal difficulty or higher, there is a chance for new elite monsters to appear.
Elite monsters have more powerful stats than normal zombies, as well as enhancement effects. The higher the difficulty is when you encounter them, the more powerful their abilities become.
If you clear the scenario after defeating an elite monster, you can get Add-On and Part items.

Introducing the Add-On SystemNew item type, Add-Ons, can be obtained by defeating elite monsters.
Add-Ons are consumable items which, when used, apply their effects to the next Scenario Mode match. You can view your Add-On items in the mode-exclusive section of your inventory.
You can equip Add-Ons in the lobby before playing Zombie Scenario Mode. When the match starts, 1 of each equipped Add-On will be consumed, and the Add-Ons' effects will be applied to that match.
You can press the M key during the match to see the currently equipped Add-Ons.

Other System ChangesThe Round Re-Challenge item no longer has a cooldown. Instead, there is now a limit on how many times it can be used per match based on difficulty. You can see how many uses you have left by pressing Tab during the match.
Easy and Normal: No limit
Hard: Up to 15 uses
Very Hard: Up to 10 uses
Hell: Up to 5 uses
Inferno: Up to 3 uses
In Zombie Scenario maps on Very Hard or above difficulty, when you discard a weapon, the weapon will now disappear immediately.
You can view special conditions and rewars for each difficulty with the Difficulty Guide button in the Zombie Scenario Mode lobby.

Zombie Content UpdateFor details, please refer to the Season 8 Zombie Mode Update Preview.

Zombie Content UpdateZombie Boost Items
- There are three zombie-exclusive power-ups that can appear when zombies die.
- Green: Increases maximum HP by 10%
- Blue: Reduces zombie skill cooldown by 10%
- Yellow: Increases Movement Speed by 5%
- Zombies drop 1 of the above power-ups upon death. Zombie players can pick up the power-up by approaching within 2m.
- You can have the effects of all 3 power-ups at once. The same power-up can be stacked up to 2 times.
- These effects last until the end of the round or death.
- These power-ups can be found in Zombie Hero and Zombie Z.

Death Information Window and Revenge Bonus System
- Death Information Window Improvements: Upon death, a pop-up will display information about the player who killed you.
- Revenge Bonus System: Marks players who killed you this round and grants bonus points upon taking revenge.
- The Death Information Window and Revenge Bonus System can be found in Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, and Zombie Evolution.

New Zombie Mutations
- Painful Memories: Marks the player that killed you and decreases the damage taken from that player by 50%.
- Supply Contamination: Press E to place 1 Zombie Bomb on a human team Supply Box. When a human approaches, the Zombie Bomb explodes and inflicts damage.

Zombie Z Improvements
- In Zombie Z Mode, if you do not have the Specialist mutation by Lv. 30, your Lv. 30 mutation is guaranteed to be Specialist.

Hall of Fame button changed to be slightly fancier and larger
First play points added: Upon obtaining League Points for the first time each day, get an additional 10 points
Bronze-rank players gain play time and points even after getting kicked or leaving the match early

Additional InformationYou can check your league status under My Info.
You can review score and weapon information for the top 100 players in the Hall of Fame.
League Ranks: Master > Diamond > Platinum > Gold > Silver > Bronze
Advance your league rank by getting League Points from playing zombie modes.
You can only earn League Points for your first 2 hours of zombie mode play each day.
* Zombie League Season 3 is a [Trial] season. Its rules, such as its progression period, rewards, etc., may be adjusted in the future.
* The Season Pass and Zombie League Season are separate systems with different progression periods.
* Zombie League = Zombie Hero + Zombie Evolution + Zombie Z + Studio Zombie + Zombie (AI)
* Master Rank is the only rank you must advance through competition.
* There is no minimum player requirements for earning League Points, but playing with more players grants a higher bonus.
* You cannot get League Points in private, password-protected rooms.

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

Content: Added the New Zombie Draugr
A new zombie has been released in Zombie Evolution! With the power to switch between offense and defense, this zombie is perfect for breaking through the enemy line!
	
Content: Zombie Evolution & Zombie Z Rebalance
A new change comes to zombie modes! Read on to learn how they've been rebalanced.
	
Content: New Inferno Difficulty Map for Zombie Scenario
Total War has been updated with Inferno difficulty! We plan to add Inferno difficulty to more maps in the future, so have fun.

Content: Medal System Improvement Part 2 Information
The Medal System has been further improved! 3 new medals have also been added, so be sure to check them out.

Promotion: Transcendence Class Promotion (12/23 - 1/27)
New Transcendence Classes, Leader Soi and Super Soldier Jennifer, have been released! Get them from Class Decoders today!

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.



Expanded Info
 
Contents

New Zombie: Draugr{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/017e1b1e64001c2a59feeda07cfe11a0e958d352.png
A new zombie exclusive to Zombie Evolution has been released! With the power to switch between offense and defense, this zombie is perfect for breaking through the enemy line!

IntroductionDraugr is a powerful mutant zombie class that uses a sword. It has a very long attack range, but slow attack speed. Hold right-click to charge up to 3 stages. Range and damage increase according to the charge stage.

SkillDeflect: Block enemy projectiles with your sword. While using this skill, the effects of knockback and stun against you are reduced. Use the skill again to deactivate it. The gauge gradually drains while using the skill, and refills when not using it.

Dimension Slash: Channel your focus and teleport forward, dealing damage to all humans in your path and pulling nearby humans in. Cannot move through obstacles.


Zombie Evolution & Zombie Z RebalanceA new change comes to zombie modes!

Zombie Evolution Mode1. Human Skill Limit Change: After learning 2 skills, you can use virus to learn more skills. Doing so will replace the first skill you already learned with the new skill.

2. Added Human Team Banshee skills.
  - Vampire Bats Skill: While the skill is in effect, vampire bats attack when you hit an enemy, inflicting additional damage and healing you for a portion of all damage dealt.
  - Banshee Buff: Marks Zombies in the direction you are facing in red.

3. Increased the amount of virus required to use skills while you are Human from 2 to 3.

4. Slightly increased the periodic virus gain when Humans survive.

5. Adjusted Human skill balance.
  - Aksha: Reduced the cumulative damage required for the Discharge skill and increased the attack power boost to up to 250%.
  - Rusty Wing: Slightly increased the Glide skill's cooldown.
  - Deimos: Slightly reduced the Shock skill's cooldown.
  - Venom Guard: Reduced the Zombie Explosion skill's cooldown.

6. Reduced the number of Virus Essences generated upon a zombie death from up to 6 to 5.

7. Reduced the amount of virus obtained from Virus Essence when you are a zombie from 50 to 35.

8. Increased the amount of virus obtained when a zombie kills a human from 120 to 150.

9. Increased the virus level required to transform into a mutant zombie from 7 to 9.

10. Increased the virus level consumed to transform into a mutant zombie from 6 to 9.

11. Respawn time now increases even when dying from normal headshots, not just from Deadly Shot.

12. Adjusted Brutus and Arachne balance.
  - Slightly increased Brutus defense.
  - Slightly increased Brutus HP.
  - Slightly reduced Arachne HP.
  - Slightly increased Arachne armor.
  - Reduced Arachne's Web Walk skill cooldown from 6 to 5 sec.

Zombie Z Mode1. Mutation Changes
  - Contact Infection: Damages nearby humans every second. The damage increases every round.
  - Icarus: Has a 2-sec cooldown after using Glide.

2. Zombie Z Mode Unlock Levels Adjusted
  - Changed the unlock level for some zombies and weapons.

3. Additional Changes
  - Fixed the issue where you could attack while using Venom Guard's Self-Destruct skill.
  - Round settings can now be selected in 2-round increments with a minimum of 5 rounds and maximum of 17 rounds.

Contents

Studio - Scenario TX UpdateThis is a "shooting RPG" based on Studio Mode. Hunt monsters and obtain various items to grow stronger, all in an isometric view.

 Enjoy Scenario TX gameplay utilizing about 80 different skills!
 You can become even more powerful through the Scenario TX's Expert advancement system, exclusively for Lv. 30.

Scenario TX Missions A new form of scenario where the official Scenario TX lore is applied, featuring boss monsters.

 Zombie Team Stage 3 Karma Effect: Play as Zombie Hero, Invincible for 7 sec (ignore damage, stuns, and knockback)

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: October 7th
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/90170341aed9f970ac74b6f1909da004b4ef715b.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

Content: Season 7 Psychic Punk (10/7 - 12/23)
The new season, psychic punk, is here. You can find neon signs and futuristic accessories in Season 7. There are also many changes such as updates to the Karma system, skill changes, balance changes, and so on. Check them in the game now.
	
Content: League System Revamp
The league system has been revamped and will run in seasons. The first season, Zombie League Season 1, will run until 11/25. This season will be a trial run and there may be changes made mid-season. We plan to run various league seasons besides Zombie League in the future.
	
Content: Build Marker Release
We've added the Build Marker, which allows you to designate areas and easily edit them. To celebrate its release, we are giving away Build Marker, Build Minigun, and Build Scanner licenses for free when you play at least 30 minutes in Studio Creation Mode.

Promotion: Negev NG-7 Ajax Promotion (10/7 - 11/25)
During the promotion, enjoy 3x drop rates for the Transcendence Weapons, Negev NG-7 Ajax and M3 Black Dragon. Once the promotion is over, M3 Black Dragon will become permanently available.

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


Expanded Info
Contents
Season 7: Psychic Punk (10/7 - 12/23)
The new season has arrived with the psychic punk theme. Feel the future in Season 7 with fancy neon signs, futuristic accessories, and retro style.
 Main Rewards
 Growing Weapon: Plasma Rifle MK-1, Plasma Rifle MK-2, Tiamat MK-3, and Tiamat MK-4
 Zombie Costumes: Android Light Zombie and Boombox Stamper
 Weapon Paints: Cyber Neon Weapon Paint and Psychedelic Weapon Paint
 Costume: Cyber Helmet, Combat Mask, Hover Board, Hover Wings, Cube Bot, and Pulse
 Sprays: Boss David Black Spray, Android Light Zombie Spray, Boombox Stamper Spray, Special Agent Criss Spray, and Psychic Punk CS Spray
 Medals: Season 7 Trailblazer Medal and Season 7 Conqueror Medal

Season 7: Zombie Contents
Various changes will be applied to Season 7 zombie contents.
 Karma System Update
 Both Human and Zombie Teams can now fill the Karma gauge.
 Zombie Team Karma Effects
 Zombie Team Stage 1 Karma Effect: Ignore stuns and knockback for 2.5 sec
 Zombie Team Stage 2 Karma Effect: Ignore damage, stuns, and knockback for 5 sec (cannot move)
 Zombie Team Stage 3 Karma Effect: Can play as a Hero Zombie
 Newly Added Sub-Effects per Each Karma Stage
 Between Stages 0 and 1: Can select a weapon/zombie 3 levels higher than your level, respectively
 Between Stages 1 and 2: Can select a weapon/zombie 6 levels higher than your level, respectively
 Between Stages 2 and 3: Can obtain all human/zombie mutations, respectively 
 Zombie Z Balance Adjustments
 There will now be a cap for the EXP that can be obtained from taking damage as a zombie in Zombie Z mode, based on the distance between you and the human that damaged you.
 Lowered the unlock level for early-/mid-game weapons and zombies overall. (Raised for some weapons and zombies)
 Added new mutation and adjusted mutation balance 
 New Human Team Mutation
 Bomb Defense: Reduces the damage and knockback taken from Zombie Bombs
 Balance Adjustment
 Contact Infection: Changed so that infection occurs when you maintain contact for a short time, instead of infecting immediately upon making contact
 Endurance: Increased the proc rates and reduced the duration for the Endurance mutation.

Zombie Evolution Content Update
Various changes are applied to Zombie Evolution mode.
 Changes
 Added Zombie Evolution medals
 Added Zombie Evolution daily and weekly missions
 Added Zombie Evolution Studio Mode, as well as 2 Studio maps (Dust+ and Assault+)
 The more zombies exist, the longer the respawn wait time becomes
 Extended the wait time between one round's end and the next round's start to 15 sec
 You can now open the results window (F key) while waiting between rounds
 Zombie vision (N key) now maintains its on/off status throughout a match
 The skill sound now plays in 1st person view when a human uses an additional skill
 Balance changes for humans' additional skills
 Reduced cooldown for Light Zombie and Ganymede skills: 18 sec -> 16 sec
 Reduced cooldown for Voodoo Zombie skill: 20 sec -> 18 sec
 Reduced cooldown for Stamper skill: 20 sec -> 16 sec
 Increased cooldown for Jiangshi Zombie skill: 28 sec -> 30 sec
 Reduced secondary weapon attack power granted by Jiangshi Zombie skill: 80% -> 60%
 Increased movement speed granted by Venom Sting skill: 5 -> 7
 Increased damage of Venom Sting's Shadow Attack skill: 800 -> 950
 Reduced Slot 4 equipment attack power granted by Blotter skill: 50% -> 10%
 Reduced cooldown for Rusty Wing skill: 22 sec -> 20 sec
 Reduced the wings' HP for Rusty Wing skill: 400 -> 100
 Increased cooldown for Psycho Zombie skill: 12 sec -> 13 sec
 Reduced the Zombie Countermeasure Vaccine toss interval for Psycho Zombie skill: 0.5 -> 0.4
 Increased cooldown for Deimos skill: 22 sec -> 24 sec
 Increased the duration of the zombie attack lock inflicted by Deimos skill: 3 sec -> 4 sec
 Mutant Zombie balance changes
 Reduced HP recovered while resting as Brutus and Arachne
 Slightly reduced defense for Brutus
 Slightly increased duration of Charge for Brutus
 Slightly increased cooldown of Charge for Brutus
 Slightly reduced the Zombie Hound summon cooldown for Brutus
 Reduced the Zombie Hound HP for Brutus
 Slightly reduced the Zombie Hound attack power for Brutus
 Zombie Balance Fix
 The movement speed and jump boost granted by Berserk is now the same for all virus levels
 Skill Changes
 Venom Guard: New skill "Zombie Explosion" and buff added
 Aksha: Discharge skill changed and buff added

League System Revamp
The league system is being completely revamped. Leagues now run in seasons. You can see the current league status under the profile screen.
 League Changes
 Leagues will run in seasons. These seasons are separate from the existing Season Pass.
 In the Hall of Fame, you can see the points and weapons of the top 500 players in the league.
 You can earn League Points to increase your league rank. League Points can be obtained when you play the featured modes in the league. Please beware that you will not get points if abnormal activity is detected during your gameplay.
 League Ranks: Master > Diamond > Platinum > Gold > Silver > Bronze
 Only the top 500 players can achieve the Master rank.
 The more people play together, the easier it is to earn League Points. 
 League Season Operation Rules
 While the first league will be a Zombie League, we plan to feature various modes in the future.
League duration may be different for each league, but they will be updated at about a 4-week interval by default.
The points required to advance in league ranks may be changed in the future. 

[Trial] Zombie League Season 1 (10/7 - 11/25)
Zombie League Season 1 will be the first of the revamped leagues. Zombie League Season 1 will be a trial run. We ask for your understanding that its schedule or details may change.
 Zombie League Featured Modes: Zombie (AI), Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, and Studio Zombie

 League Rewards
 Master Rank: Zombie League Master Zombification + Gungnir (15 Days) + Axion (15 Days) + Aetheris (15 Days)
 Diamond Rank: Zombie League Diamond Spray + Holy Sword Divine Order (15 Days) + Female Student Light Zombie (15 Days)
 Platinum Rank: Zombie League Nameplate + Dual Beretta Gunslinger (15 Days) + Nurse Venom Sting (15 Days)
 Gold Rank: Infinity Laser Fist (15 Days) + Mummy Stamper (15 Days)
 Silver Rank: Trinity Grenade (15 Days) + Chef Heavy Zombie (15 Days)
 Zombie League Master Zombification: Changes the special effect when you revive as a zombie in Zombie Mode. It will be removed if you drop out of Master rank or if the season ends.

Studio Creation Mode Improvement Pt. 2
Various improvements have been made to Studio Creation Mode.
 Added Build Marker, a New Creation Tool
 You can create an area by designating the location for two markers. Left-click to place markers, and right-click to retrieve the markers.
 The area created can be filled or erased with the Build Rifle or the Build Minigun. You can only fill the area with blocks that are 1x1x1 in size and have a block cost of 0.
 If you use the Build Scanner, you can also copy the area you created and paste it into another location.
 Quick Menu Improvements
 Ghost Mode: Ghost Mode and Zero Gravity mode have been merged. The player becomes semitransparent, can pass through all objects, and becomes invincible.
 Speed Mode: Allows you to move faster than the default speed. It is also possible to adjust your movement speed.
 Camera Settings: Isometric view has been added. You can also zoom in/out with the mouse wheel.
 Show Device Tree View: You can see all device blocks currently placed in the Studio map in a single glance as a tree view.
 Player Settings: A menu that includes various creation convenience features has been added.
 Sounds Added: 30 new sound effects and 12 new music tracks have been added.

Events
Find the Zombie Event (10/7 - 10/28)
There are 16 characters on the board, and 12 of them are zombies. Snipe the zombies to get rewards. Press "Find the Zombie" on the bottom of the Lobby screen to play.
 Bullet Giveaway
 For every 30 minutes of game login time every day during the event, you will receive 1 bullet. (There's no limit to how many you can obtain a day.)
 Detailed Rules
 When you guess where a zombie is, your reward grade goes up by 1, up to a total of 13. When you snipe a human, your reward grade goes down by 1. The higher grade you receive, the better rewards you will get.
 You can claim your reward by pressing Surrender or sniping all zombies, then pressing the Claim Reward button.
 To snipe a zombie, you need bullets. Bullets can be earned from events or purchased from the Shop.

BALROG IS BACK (10/7 - 11/25)
Various changes will be applied to the BALROG series weapons.

 During the event, damage will be increased and Zombie Z unlock level will be decreased for BALROG Blue series weapons.

Expanded Info
Contents

New Zombie Evolution Mode Update
It's our first new game mode in a while! Join this endlessly evolving battle between humans and zombies, where the S Virus changes everything.
 Background
 Despite efforts to stop Kronos Inc.'s Super Soldier Project, experiments continued. The S Virus, a new pathogen based on the Z Virus, has been discovered.
 In small quantities, the S Virus lets humans use the powerful abilities of zombies without losing their intellect.
 Kronos has been creating powerful boss zombies using the new virus. Agents tried their best to prevent this, but the S Virus was leaked during this process.
 Now, a new battle between two sides using the S Virus unfolds.
 New Zombie Evolution Map
 Zombie Junk House
 Basic Rules
 Win Conditions
 Zombies: Infect all humans
 Humans: Survive until the round ends
 New Rule
 Zombies get infinite respawns. However, the respawn timer is increased if killed by Deadly Shot.
 You can use powerful abilities by collecting and using S Virus.
 Obtaining the Virus
 Humans: Obtain S Virus when you score zombie kills or assists, or when you survive for a certain duration. The less humans remaining, the more you obtain.
 Zombies: Obtain virus when you infect humans, or when you score human kills or assists. You can also get virus from Virus Essence that other zombies leave when they die.
 Virus Stages
 Your virus stage is displayed in the center of the screen. Virus stage tops out at stage 10 and persists until the end of the match.
 Virus Effects
 Your basic stats increase with your virus stage. (You can see your current stats by pressing L.) When zombies reach a high virus stage, their respawn time is slightly increased.
 Virus Injection
If you reach a certain virus stage (stage 2 for humans, stage 7 for zombies), press V to inject the virus into your body. This consumes virus stages but gives you new abilities.
 Humans: Can inject up to 2 times to randomly obtain a zombie ability. This also grants a resistance to infection from zombies. The virus disappears from your body over time.
 Zombie: Injecting the virus will transform you into a powerful mutant zombie. There are 2 types of mutant zombies, chosen at random.
 Brutus: Has strong HP and Defense. Though it is slow, it is not knocked back or stunned by normal guns.
 Arachne: Has a skill that allows quick movement. It can attack humans with double-jump and use spider webs to move in unexpected ways.

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
Contents: Season 6, The Wizard of Oz (6/10 - 9/2)

The theme for Season 6 is the Wizard of Oz! Season levels have been increased to 100. Also, new content like the quest zombie, which is a random quest, has been added
 
Contents: Weapon Paint Switching System

You can now apply 2 or more paints to a single weapon. Once you apply the paint, you can freely swap it on and off. With the switching system's implementation, the Paint Reset Blueprint item will no longer be sold.

Shop: Premium Room Host Release 50% Off Promotion (6/10 - Until Separate Notice)

The Premium Room Host is a temporary item that grants all kinds of benefits. To celebrate its release, you can purchase it at 50% off!

Shop: SKULL IS BACK Promotion (6/10 - 7/8)

The SKULL series has been selected as the first Weapon of the Month! During the promotion, you can purchase the SKULL series directly from the Shop, and these weapons have received tweaks as well. Also, the Blood Weapon Paint item will be sold at 50% off.

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


Expanded Info

Contents

Season 6, The Wizard of Oz (6/10 - 9/2)

The theme for Season 6 is the Wizard of Oz. You can increase your season level when you play during the season, and you will receive rewards according to your level. If you own the Season Pass, you can receive additional rewards.
 Zombie Content Changes
During the season, the following changes will be applied.
1. Venom Guard
 Self-Destruct skill's duration increased (5 seconds → 15 seconds)
 Self-Destruct skill's explosion range increased
 Self-Destruct skill's knockback effect increased

2. Heavy Zombie
 Trap skill's human binding duration reduced (7 seconds → 3 seconds)
 Trap skill's human detection range reduced
 Trap skill's human seeking speed increased
 Trap's transparency removed

3. SCAR-OZ Enhancement Effects Applied

 Season Changes
 Added new Season 6 items and increased the max level to 100
 Added the Season Pass reward preview feature

New Feature: Quest Zombie (Random Quest)

After the game starts, you will receive a quest automatically when each team respawns.
 Eligible Modes: Zombie Z, Zombie Hero, and Bot Zombie

 Human Team
You will receive a mission to kill a specific zombie. When you complete the mission, you will receive 1 of the following effects randomly: attack power buff, movement speed buff, maximum HP buff, revive as human when dying as infected.

 Zombie Team
You will receive a mission to play as a specific zombie, and can select the quest zombie at #0 in the class selection screen. When you complete the mission, you will receive the following 3 effects: maximum HP buff, additional Armor, decreased stun and knockback effects.

 Notice
 You will receive bonus effects each time you complete a quest in your current round.
 For the Zombie Team, effects received from completing a quest will have different values per zombie.
 Regardless of the team, clearing the quest once is considered meeting the condition once. (Event Conditions)


Weapon Paint Switching System

You can now apply 2 or more paints to a single weapon. Once you apply the paint, you can freely change to and from it. With the switching system's implementation, the Paint Reset Blueprint item will no longer be sold.


Other Changes

 The Mileage Duffel Bag item has been revamped.

 Zombie Z, Zombie Hero, and Bot Zombie

You can earn rewards based on the daily quest clear count during the event. (Up to 10 times a day) Regardless of the Human/Zombie team, clearing the quest zombie once is considered meeting the condition once.

When you clear the quest zombies 10 times in a single day, it will count as 1 day towards the total day count. You can get additional rewards based on total days. These rewards can only be obtained once.

The CSN:S Team

Contents
New Content: Exploration System
The Exploration system is a new mode where your classes will bring back items even while you are logged out.
Check it out by pressing the "Exploration" button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.
 Exploration System Overview
 You can select and send 3 classes to an exploration area.
 The exploration success rate changes based on the area, the level, and the exploration levels of the classes.
 The duration changes based on difficulty. (Easy: 2 hours, Normal: 4 hours, and Hard: 8 hours)
 You'll receive the base reward when the exploration ends. If you complete the mission, you'll get an additional reward.
 Please be careful, as the reward will be reset if you do not claim it within 24 hours after completing the exploration.
 Starting Exploration
When you press the button in the Lobby, the "Exploration" window will appear. The Exploration window has 3 parts.
Exploration Slots: 1 area will be provided by default. You can open up to 2 additional slots by using Exploration Slot Expansion Coupons, for a total of 3 slots.
 Exploration area information will be updated every day at midnight.
 Exploration Settings: You can select the difficulty for the currently selected area, and set the 3 classes to dispatch.
 You must fill all 3 class slots to depart. There are minimum and maximum success rates for each difficulty.
 When the exploration area changes, there is a chance to get the "Bonus Class" mark. If you send the Bonus Class, the exploration success rate increases.
 You can change the exploration area randomly by pressing the button on the top left. However, using this option will cost Mileage.
 To cancel an exploration that is already in progress, select the exploration area and press the X button on the top right. The assigned classes will not need to rest.
 Classes Owned: You can check the status of the classes you have.
 Each class has a different exploration level. Temporary classes cannot be used for exploration.
 Classes that complete an exploration once will need to rest. They cannot go on another exploration that day.
 Classes on exploration can be used in other game modes without restrictions.
 Exploration Level Enhancement
In the Enhance screen, you can raise the exploration level of the classes you own.
 When enhancing, you can use classes, costumes, and sprays as material.
 Temporary items can also be used as material. You will receive the same rewards as you would from dismantling the item.

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
Season 5 Kingdom Collaboration
Season 5 is built around a collaboration with the drama Kingdom. 
This time, we're enhancing the perks of the Season Pass and updating Zombie Mode. Check out the mysterious weapons, costumes, and other items based on the Joseon theme!
 
Season 5 Kingdom Collaboration: Lee-Chang and Yeong-Shin Class Promotion (2/19 - 3/18)
 Lee-Chang and Yeong-Shin, the two main characters of Kingdom, will appear as the new Transcendence Classes. The Lee-Chang and Yeong-Shin classes are equipped with a unique synergy effect that enhances Season 5 weapons. These classes can be obtained not from Decoders, but from packages.

Various Events
There are tons of events celebrating the Season 5 collaboration with Kingdom. 
You can earn all kinds of rewards simply by playing the game and participating in events, like the Golden Zombie Event, Zombie Z Newbie Event, Heart Attack Event, and more! 
Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


Expanded Info
Contents
Season 5 Kingdom Collaboration (2/19 - 5/13)
Season 5 is built around a collaboration with the drama Kingdom.

You can obtain Season Badges from Missions, Events, and other activities during the season. All kinds of rewards will be given when you collect these badges and level up your grade. Purchasing the Season Pass will grant you additional rewards! 

Check out the mysterious weapons, costumes, and other items based on the Joseon theme!


Season 5 Zombie Mode Update
For Season 5, we've made the following changes to Zombie Mode.
 You can level down in Zombie Z mode.
 Press the L key to level down, which will remove 1 random mutation. If there are no mutations that can be removed, 1 point will be deducted.
 The balance of Banshee and Voodoo Zombies has been changed.
 Banshee
 Damage taken reduced by 70 while using the Pulling skill.
 Range and pulling force increased for the Pulling skill. Voodoo Zombie
 The Heal skill now recovers 1,800 HP every 1.5 seconds over 6 seconds.
 Cooldown for the Heal skill reduced to 12 seconds.
 Increased amount of HP recovered automatically to 800.
 Slightly increased Movement Speed.
 The weapons obtained from the Season 5 Pass will be enhanced when used in Zombie Z mode.
 This enhancement effect will end when Season 5 ends.

Season Pass Improvements
The following changes have been applied to the Season Pass.
 The amount of Season Badges distributed will be approximately doubled compared to Season 4, so that players will be able to reach season ranks much faster.

 The difficulty of the daily missions has been adjusted.
 The difficulty of particularly challenging daily missions has been adjusted further.
 The chance of getting missions to score kills using rifles, machine guns, sub-machine guns, and pistols has been lowered.
 Missions to participate in Team Deathmatch, Gun Deathmatch, All-Star Mode, Zombie Escape Mode, and the New Zombie Shelter for 10 minutes have been removed.

Weapon Synergy Effects with Classes
The new Transcendence Classes Lee-Chang and Yeong-Shin will gain enhancement effects when they are equipped with Season 5 weapons.

 Hwando, Timed Bomb, Scythe, Arquebus, Reflex Bow, Matchlock Pistol, Moon Glaive, Blistering Bolt Repeater

 Increased Damage

 Blistering Bolt Repeater (Yeong-Shin) - Number of alt fire projectiles +1. Rate of fire delay reduction for alt fire (0.7s -> 0.55s)

Other Changes
 The Shield skill for the Cyborg class has been changed to not take damage from allies
 The effect caused when hit by the Heaven Splitter will no longer block line of sight
 The explosion sound from the Magnum Launcher's alt fire has been fixed
 The issue where the Studio Monsters still attacked the players using the Conceal skill in New Zombie Shelter has been fixed
 The issue regarding incorrect variable values for World Settings from the Lua Script has been fixed
 Other miscellaneous crashes and minor bugs have been fixed

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: January 2nd
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/592b32a06bf3e048b2bdacab8828b6a8c124a001.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
New Game Mode: Manhunt
The new game mode ‘Manhunt’ has been added. Become a Human and fix the generators to secure your escape while hiding from the prowling zombie, or become a Zombie and ensure that no human leaves alive!

New Transcendence Classes: Queen & Cyborg
Season 4 Transcendence Classes Queen and Cyborg can be obtained from the Class Decoders, as well as Premium Class Decoders for the duration of the promotion. A giveaway promotion, as well as a promotion that boosts drop rates will take place at the same time, so don't miss out on your opportunity to obtain the new Transcendence Classes!

Enhancement System Revamp and New +6 Enhancement Weapons
The enhancement system has been revamped. The maximum enhancement has been increased to +9, and you can now employ unused weapons as enhancement materials. Additionally, the Warhammer Storm Giant and the Dual UZI can now be enhanced to +6.

2020 New Year! Surprise Mileage Auction (1/2 - 1/15)
You can buy and sell items on the Mileage Auction from 12:00 - 23:59 each day between 1/2 after maintenance until 1/15. Also, special items will appear from 20:00 - 21:00 each day between 1/2 - 1/12 (CET). Don't miss out on a weekend full of rare items!

There are also other events, and updates to the Family system. Check out the Expanded Info section below for details!



Expanded Info
Contents
New Game Mode: Manhunt
The new game mode ‘Manhunt’, and a map associated with the mode has been added. Become a Human and fix the generators to secure your escape while hiding from the prowling zombie, or become a Zombie and ensure that no human leaves alive! 


New +6 Enhancement Weapons
2 new weapons that can be enhanced to +6 have been added.
 Warhammer Storm Giant
 Dual UZI

Enhancement System Revamp
The Enhancement System has been revamped. The changes are as described below.
 Changes to the Enhancement Method
 You can add Enhancement EXP to a weapon by using other weapons as enhancement materials. You can attempt to enhance a weapon with at least 1 Enhancement EXP, and your odds of success will vary according to how much Enhancement EXP you've accumulated. Temporary or rental weapons may not be used as materials.
 The maximum enhancement has been increased to +9. The weapons that can be enhanced up to +9 are listed below. However, the 'Damage' enhancement value for +9 weapons are applied only in Zombie, or Zombie Scenario Modes.
 Weapons whose max enhancement increased to from +8 to +9: WA2000 / Thompson Chicago / KSG-12 / RPG-7 / WA2000 Gold Edition / KSG-12 Gold Edition
 Weapons whose enhancement increased to +9 from +6: Volcano / Ripper / Savery / Crimson Hunter / Dark Knight / Paladin
 Convenience Features Added
 Enhancement suffix deleted
 Enhancement search feature added
 The names of Anti-Enhancement material items have been changed. Use these materials during enhancement to lower the enhancement level by 1.
 (Prior to the change) Anti-Enhancement (Anti-ENH)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/28f20a13819908445ffee6aeb88b49f068133fc4.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the changes in today's update!

Some of you may have been confused to discover that the game's title was recently changed from Zombies to Studio. In our never-ending struggle to keep the game fresh and provide a better, funner experience, we have been developing the game in a much broader direction. Our new focus includes allowing players themselves to participate in content creation. Of course we fully intend to continue to improve and expand upon our existing Zombie modes as well. As always, we are extremely grateful for your continued support.

Studio Feature Expansion – Scenario T
Scenario T is the very first studio update since the game was retitled. Scenario T is a Zombie Scenario in Studio Mode. Use the newly added features to create maps with RPG mechanics.

New Item: Season 4 Transcendence Weapon, the Hellhound, and Etc.
The Hellhound is a new type of weapon that automatically patrols the vicinity of its user. It is usable alongside your primary weapon, unleashing a wide variety of new strategies! In addition to the Hellhound, 3 kinds of ZS boxes, each filled with a variety of items, that you can purchase with points. Additionally, the Small medical kit has been can now be purchased in bundles of 30.

Decoder Improvement
We improved the Decoder system so that it would be more straightforward to understand the source of acquisition of the weapons based on their grades. Please refer to the separate notice for details. 

In addition to the announcements above, there have been changes to the Zombie Meta, and the Zombie Scenario has been revamped as well. Please refer to the [Details] section below for details.


Expanded InfoContentsStudio Feature Expansion – Scenario T
This is a 'Zombie Scenario' in Studio Mode. Utilize the newly added features to create maps involving RPG mechanics, such as leveling up and farming items.
 Monsters
 3 kinds of new monsters have been added.
 The creator is able to control many different types of monsters at the same time using the script.
 The grades of monsters can be configured. The grades are differentiated into 5 stages (Regular, Rare, Unique, Champion, Named).
 EXP, as well as items exclusive to the Scenario T can be obtained by defeating monsters.
 Weapons
 The weapons are differentiated into 4 grades (Regular, Rare, Unique, Transcendence). Additional attributes are applied at random for weapons having higher grades.
 Weapons can be obtained from rewards for defeating the monsters, as well as shops located in the map.
 Weapons have levels and attributes. These attributes can be configured using the script.
 Caution: Weapon usage is restricted for the weapons not possessed in the players' inventory.
 Sample Maps
 2 sample maps have been included in the updated to experience the new features at your convenience.
 Scenario T01 – Missing Advance Troops (Tutorial Map)
 Scenario T02 – Sewer Depths (Play Map)

Decoder Improvement
The Decoder system has been improved to better convey how weapons of particular grades are acquired. Going forward, Transcendence Weapons will be obtained from Transcendence Decoders, or Transcendence Premium Decoders. Please refer to the separate notice for further details.


Zombie Scenario Revamped
There's been various changes to the Zombie Scenario.
 The Appearance of Golden Zombies in Zombie Scenario Mode
 Golden Zombies will randomly appear. You'll be made aware of their appearances through the notification messages.
 The Golden Zombies will appear randomly upon playing for more than 3 minutes in rooms with a regular difficulty or higher.

 Rewards can be obtained for scoring Golden Zombie kills. The types of rewards vary according to the event details. Please refer to the Event category for details.

 Each player in the room will be able to obtain 1 loot.
 The reward will disappear if it is not claimed within a certain time.
 The Scenario points have been adjusted, lowering the previous difficulty for obtaining the Reward Boxes.

Zombie Related Changes
The information disclosed below have been changed.
 The new Zombie Mode map ‘Alcatraz-Z’ has been added.
 The Sound Effects for Zombie Mode has been revamped.
 The unlocking level for certain weapons in Zombie Z has been slightly lowered.
 Aksha's skill stats have been changed for balance adjustment purposes.

2 types of medals that can be obtained from the Studio Hide and Seek Mode have been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0d4d33e00db4ad5a1a59921b9ee0d5af92f90f58.jpg

Updated Content
Season 4 Halloween Content Update
 Season 4 is here with a spooky Halloween theme! Check out all the new Season 4 items, such as the Season 4 Weapon, Ghost Knight, and the new classes, Wraith Bride Ritsuka and Ripper Henry.


Studio - New Feature Update
3 new features have been added to the Studio.

A. Cheer Feature
You can gift Cheer Cubes to the creators of maps that you enjoy using the Cheer feature.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/90cf35ff7af7fa909386ef9b8336bce3f1210b9e.png
1) How to Cheer the Map Creators
Find the Cheer button to the top left of the screen when looking at the Map Info in Studio Mode. You can also use the Cheer feature in-game if the creator has a Cheer Message Board placed in the map.

2) Gifting Cheer Cubes
 You can send the creator a message, or convert the Cube Fragments in your possession to Cubes to gift to the creator from the Cheer window. Cube Fragments can be earned by purchasing cash items.

3) Using Cubes
 The creator can use the Cubes they get to exchange them for Mileage.

B. Shop Feature
 Players on the map can use blocks such as the Coin Checker block, Item Buying block, and Weapon Shop blocks to use Cheer Cubes and Points as they would use Coins. The Points and Cubes used on the map will be saved to that map for the creator.
1) The creator is unable to use Cheer Cube Fragments or Points on maps they created themselves.

2) Using Cubes Saved on a Map
 Just as with the Cheer feature, the creator can exchange the Cubes for Mileage. Be aware that Cubes expire over time if not used.

3) Using Points Saved on a Map
 The creator can retrieve the points on the map after paying a small fee. The points will be refreshed every day at midnight, and there's a limit to how many can be retrieved per day. As with Cubes, these points expire over time if not used.

C. Studio Player Event
 We've added the Event Ticket item, which creators can use to host 30-day events on their own maps. Please note that the Event Ticket is an experimental item that will be given out only in a limited fashion. Please refer to the ‘Who Wants to Make Their Creation Maps Go Viral?! (10/30 - 11/13)’ event notice for details.

1) Hosting an Event
 Using an Event Ticket on one of your maps allows you to host an event on it. The event will be applied according to the duration and conditions configured with the ticket, and such values cannot be changed once applied. Moreover, tickets can only be applied to maps listed as Public. Using multiple tickets allows you to increase the number of winners. Be warned that you won't be able to use additional tickets once the event is applied.

2) Checking and Participating in Events
 Check out the maps with events going on by sorting and filtering from the Studio screen. Maps with an event in progress will have an event tag attached, and be displayed at the top of the list even if they have low recommendations.

 Hover your mouse over maps with an event in progress to check the participation conditions. If a map has a ‘Give a recommendation’ condition, the condition can be satisfied from the pop-up menu displayed when you play the map for more than 3 minutes.

3) Checking Event Winners
 You can find information on the event winners from the Cheer pop-up window after selecting the map.


Hide and Seek Mode Revamped
 New changes have been applied to Hide and Seek Mode, and 3 new medals have been added.
 Changes
 We're adding a feature to turn yourself invisible to allies and spectators. Select this option by clicking the check box when you choose an Object to transform into.
 Selective Random Decoration Block: A block that transforms randomly into one Object from a selected list has been added.
 Configurable Category Added: Restrict the type of objects that a player can transform into, as well as configure the damage taken by the Seeker
 3 Medals for Hide and Seek Added
 New Medals (3 Kinds): Can only be earned in rooms with four or more players
 Award-Winning Actor
 A medal awarded to those who received Golden Thumbs Up a total of 100 times
 Hawkeye
 A medal awarded to those who killed objects a total of 100 times as a seeker
 Fortune's Favored
A medal awarded to those who killed objects a total of 200 times during Burning Time


Zombie Scenario Mode Revamped
The Scenario Reward Boxes, as well as the Clear Rewards have been changed, and 7 new medals have been added.
 New Medals (7 Kinds): Can only be earned in rooms with four or more players

A medal awarded to those who defeated Colossus 100 times.

A medal awarded to those who defeated Megalodon 100 times.

A medal given to those who have cleared all of the Zombie Scenario Season 2.

Partner Mode Revamped
New changes have been applied to Partner Mode.
 Changes
 The new map Villa has been added.
 The attacking location (respawn) can now be selected, and the target location (bombsite) will be randomly selected.
 Sub-objectives have been added that will provide combat support upon completion, such as weapons, ammo, recovery items, armor, and movement speed buff effects.


Quality-of-Life Improvements
The changes below have been applied to make the overall game experience better for players.
 Changes
 The list of recommended weapons in Zombie Z and Zombie Modes has been improved.
 You can check the Accolades obtained from the round in battle results.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e7b6e769f0f44bde4b85ec761297ec6165c91da8.jpg

Contents
Partner Mode
Partner Mode, where you cooperate with AI Partners, has been added.
You can check the details in the Preview section.
1. A list of maps available to be played will be displayed when you select Partner Mode. Only Demolition is supported at present, but we plan to add a variety of other modes in future updates. (Minimum of 2 players required)

2. You can select your Partner at the beginning of the game. Each partner is unique, with different personalities and abilities.
 AI Abilities: Partner's overall intelligence and skill.
 Reflexes: How fast the Partner reacts. The higher the value, the quicker the Partner reacts.
 Combat Power: Measurement of combat skills. The higher the value, the better the Partner is in combat.
 HP: Amount of HP. Partner dies when HP reaches 0.
 Movement Speed: How fast the Partner moves. The higher the value, the faster they move.
3. Give commands to your partner using the Z key.	


Zombie Meta Change
Zombie Meta has been changed, and new medals have been added as well.	
 28 Medals Added
 Zombie Fixes
 Zombie Armor: Overall HP increased
 New game option added in Zombie Mode
 Zombie skill balance fixed
 The Light Zombie's Conceal skill has been changed to slow movement speed temporarily upon use, and then restore to normal speed if the zombie is not attacked
 Rusty Wing's Glide skill has been changed to lower speed upon use
 Zombie Z Balance Fix
 EXP required for level ups increased: 22,500 -> 25,000 EXP per each level up
 Zombie Z Weapon Adjustment
 3 New Mutations Added: Intellectual, Zombie Bomb Giveaway, Revenge


Vote Kick System Revamp
The Vote Kick system has been improved.
You can check the details in the Preview section.

1. Vote Kick system has been separated from the Report and Manner Systems
 The Vote Kick system does not affect Manner points.
 If a vote to kick has been called, players in the room will be notified via chat.

Survivors,

Are you having an exciting April? Hopefully these patch notes for 4/3 will make it even better!


Updated Events

The Thunder Ghost Walker is here! (April 3 - May 1)
The long-awaited Thunder Ghost Walker has finally arrived! This is a single-shot pistol equipped with an optical invisibility system and .50 BMG special ammunition. If you use the Conceal skill while wielding the Thunder Ghost Walker, your Movement Speed will also get a big boost.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/be30018843fe1ff59493ed53402896f7ac68714a.png

Have a look at the review video for the Thunder Ghost Walker if you haven't yet. Special thanks to [Huxley], who created the video!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dP9-88Y6pLo
How to Get
Get this awesome new weapon from Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders and Top 50 Premium Decoders!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/238f3ff4045d1b5791eb95d96a86637c90c58a8e.png
Notes
All Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders and Top 50 Premium Decoders sold during the promotion will be removed during maintenance on Wednesday, May 1st.
Each unused Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder will be replaced with 500 Mileage.
Each unused Top 50 Premium Decoder will be replaced with 50 Mileage.

The Thunder Ghost Walker becomes even more powerful when used with the Conceal skill, making it a must-have weapon!


Thunder Ghost Walker Guaranteed Giveaway! (April 3 - May 1)
We are offering a guaranteed Thunder Ghost Walker for everyone interested in giving this powerful weapon a try!

Conditions
Use 210 Top 50 Premium Decoders, OR
 Use 35 Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders, and we'll give you your very own Thunder Ghost Walker.

When you've used enough, you'll get the item immediately. Keep in mind that each account can only receive this reward once!


Find the Zombie Event! (April 3 - April 17)
During the event, click the Find the Zombie tab at the bottom of the screen to participate!

There are 16 characters (12 Zombies, 4 Humans) in total, and you can progress through the event by hitting zombies with bullets.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/7aee85381338ed0a5d46c780200cdd468d4d3b04.png

How to Get Bullets
You can get bullets by playing the game for 15 minutes or longer.
You can also purchase them from the Shop, in bundles of 1, 10, 30, or 50.

How to Progress
The more zombies you hit, the higher your reward rank grows. You also earn more shots.
When you hit a human, your reward rank goes down, and the game ends.
When you select Surrender, the game ends and you get your current rewards.
Every time you receive your rewards, the event scoreboard will reset.
You can participate in the event as long as you have bullets, either earned from play time or bought from the Shop.

What Are the Rewards?
Class 1 - Class 4 Bronze Box (Contains one random item)
Class 1 - Class 4 Silver Box (Contains one random item)
Class 1 - Class 4 Gold Box (Contains one random item)
High Class Gold Box (Contains ALL items)

Reward List
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/484ac3711b83803aad6c0656ab790d3931156c99.png
Notes
You can obtain up to 10 bullets a day from play time.
Over the course of the event, you can earn up to 150 bullets.
Play time can only be earned in rooms with 8 or more players!


Information on Parts Error Compensation
Recently, we confirmed an issue where certain part effects were not applied, due to a code error in the service. 

We apologize for any inconveniences this may have caused. We have fixed the error in today's maintenance.
We will also give a 5000 Mileage Coupon as a login reward to all players who may have been inconvenienced. (Excludes new accounts created after 4/2 23:59:59)

Once again, we apologize to all players affected by this issue. We will do our best to minimize such issues in the future.


We want to thank you all for your continued support of CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best regards,
The CSN:Z Team

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ece767dd910f29148e711d79edcb740c473c6c5f.jpg

Survivors,

Here’s a brief summary of what’s coming at you in this week’s update.

Updated Content
Re-opening Hidden Mode (Classic weapons restricted)
Adding FUN mode to Quick Start  (November 21 – December 5)

Updated Items
Transcendence Chest (Sets of 1, 10+2, 50+15)
Hunter Killer X-12

Updated Maps
Random Weapon Zombie Hero Revive

Updated Events

Black Friday Sales Promotion (November 21 – December 5)

Transcendence Chests will be on sale during the promotion! The boxes come in sets of 1, 10, or 50, but we'll give you 2 extra boxes if you purchase 10, and 15 extra if you purchase 50!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/334030492b1c7f036ee5886531b5e56ba9277984.png

What's so special about Transcendence Chest?
You'll get 15 Mileage every time you open a Transcendence Chest.
All unused boxes will automatically be opened during maintenance when their sale ends on 12/5 (Wed).
A total of 19 types of Premium Enhanced Weapons are being added.
As a special bonus, the Magnum Launcher and the Dual Sword Phantom Slayer will be added to the highest group.

Hunter Killer X-12 Rate-Up Promotion! (November 21 – December 5)

During this promotion, your chances of getting the Hunter Killer X-12 from Top 50 Unlimited Decoders is a full 10 TIMES the normal rate!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/3c71ebed8422a958cb47ad21651c421848f603f4.png

Also, if you use 90 Top 50 Decoders or 15 Top 50 Unlimited Decoders, you'll instantly earn the Hunter Killer X-12!

It doesn't matter how you decide to get your Hunter Killer X-12! Just get it and show off its firepower!

Receive Free Top 50 Decoders! Play the Random Zombie Hero Event! (November 21 – December 5)

You'll get a reward for Zombie Kills in the Random Weapon Zombie Hero mode! Every time you score 5 kills, you'll receive a Top 50 Decoder!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/509a0a2e63939c02dd42e78b3ca57598b43e595d.png

This event resets every midnight (CET), and you only get credit towards it in rooms of 6 or more players. You can get up to 5 free Top 50 Decoders this way every day, just by scoring a total of 25 kills!

Remember the CSOGS! We're giving away a CSOGS spray! (November 21 – December 5)

CSOGS is starting soon! As we announced before, all the preparations for hosting the CSOGS are complete.

We're giving away a CSOGS 2018 spray to mark the coming of our very first CSOGS! (We've held the CSOWC in the past, but this is the first time hosting the CSOGS!)

How can you get your spray?

Type "Congratulations for the first CSOGS" in the channel during the event (remember, it's case sensitive!) and a marvelous CSOGS 2018 spray will be yours!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/8fb869e354d0d487085b9b9f21b14af05190e076.png

Don't forget that you can only type this once per day! And you can only participate once per account!

Once again, we want to thank you all for your continued support for CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

Holy Sword Divine Order Sales Promotion (November 7 – December 5)

During this event, your chances of getting the Holy Sword Divine Order weapon from Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder and Top 50 Premium Decoders are increased!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/a24e2c44eb1612e714f7885d9826925584d8ae2f.png

Surely you know this, but the Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder has a higher chance than the Top 50 Premium Decoder!

During the maintenance on December 19, 2 weeks after the promotion ends, all unused Top 50 Premium Decoders and Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders will be removed. All unused Top 50 Premium Decoders will be converted to 50 Mileage each, and Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders will be converted to 500 Mileage each.

Get Tokens, Get Rewards! Special Event for Steam CSN:Z Players! (November 7 – December 5)

CSN:Z players got new events and contents a little slower compared to CSO in other countries, but this event is for Steam CSN:Z players first!

During this event, you can collect tokens from many different activities and trade them for awesome rewards!

How can I get tokens?

You’ve got three different ways to get those sweet, sweet tokens!

Method 1: Get 1 token every time you achieve 3/6/9 Zombie Kills in Zombie Hero and Zombie Z modes!
Method 2: Get 1 token for 30 minutes of game time!
Method 3: Get 1 token for every Zombie Scenario Total War clear at Normal or higher difficulty.

How many tokens can I get across the whole event?
You can get a total of 84 during the event.

How many tokens do I need for rewards?

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/69fe9ccafecdbbebdb0b1ad005257280ee601b33.png

Level 1 Event Reward = 4 tokens
Level 2 Event Reward = 12 tokens
Level 3 Event Reward = 32 tokens
Level 4 Event Reward = 36 tokens
Level 5 Event Reward = 44 tokens
Level 6 Event Reward = 56 tokens
Level 7 Event Reward = 60 tokens
Level 8 Event Reward = 68 tokens
Level 9 Event Reward = 80 tokens
Level 10 Event Reward = 84 tokens

What can I get from each of the reward levels?
Level 1 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x1
Level 2 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x2
Level 3 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x3
Level 4 Event Reward = Choose one: Guillotine, Ripper, Gáe Bolg. (Selective)
Level 5 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x4
Level 6 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x5
Level 7 Event Reward = Choose one: Python Desperado, Stun Rifle, Red Dragon Cannon. (Selective)
Level 8 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x6
Level 9 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x7
Level 10 Event Reward = Guaranteed +6 M4A1 Dark Knight / +6 AK47 Paladin Exchange Coupons + Level 7 Reward.

What kind of items are in the Event Reward Box?
Red Dragon Cannon
Python Desperado
Stun Rifle
Star Chaser AR
Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
AUG Guardian
Hunter Killer X-15
Hunter Killer X-90
Bouncer

The above items come in 1 Day/7 Days/14 Days/Permanent variations from the Event Reward Box. 

When you earn tokens, you’ll be notified immediately of how you earned them and how many you have received. You can only earn up to 4 tokens per day. All earning methods only work in rooms of 4 or more people, and method 3 (Zombie Scenario) only counts if you play longer than 3 minutes.

All you have to do is play the game normally, and watch the tokens roll in! We hope to see lots of players taking advantage of this chance to earn rare and transcendence weapons!

Counter-Strike Online Global Showcase Participant Selection

The participant selection for CSOGS has concluded! All participants have either been contacted or will be contacted very soon.

Thank you all for participating, and we hope to see you again at the CSOGS venue!

Mileage Shop Notice

You can purchase package items using Mileage through the Mileage Shop located at the bottom of the Lobby.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/75ca6243e1be98486c88b5e41bc6582ddd9ebe53.png

What kind of content update awaits for next time? (Perhaps... The return of Hidden Mode or Fun Mode?)

We'll keep doing our best to provide you the best gaming experience possible!

See you next update!

Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

Mileage Auction Event (October 24 – November 7)

The secret's out!

The Mileage Auction House will finally re-open! We kept it very hush-hush these past months and remained tight-lipped about when it would open, but...the time is now, and it's finally here!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/3b0a7a445b29223d6979950c3c809a29d7ebc665.png

This time, the following weapons will be added to the Mileage Auction House:

We hope the Mileage Auction House will help you to get the weapon you've always wanted and fulfill your zombie-slaying dreams!

Trick or Treat! Treat Yourselves with Pumpkin Heads and Little Ghosts! (October 24 – November 21)

Halloween is just around the corner, and we've put together a little something to help all of you survivors celebrate with flair!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/2da439dacf1205b7cec13cdc3d7454976db91eb6.png

After the patch on 10/24, type 'Trick or Treat' (remember, it’s case-sensitive!) in the chat window to receive Pumpkin Head and Little Ghost items! Don't miss out on your chance for some cool holiday freebies, as you can only participate once per account!

CSOGS (Counter-Strike Online Global Showcase) Recruitment!

The CSOWC, a festival for players across the world who enjoy CSN:Z (or CSO) will take place in Seoul, Korea on December 9th. Last year, we informed you with a separate notice, but we figured, why not let everyone know in our patch notes? Instead of taking the form of a competition, this year's CSOWC will have more of a feeling of celebration, and participation will be open to all who love playing CSN:Z/CSO.

We're currently accepting applications to participate in the CSO:GS. Lots of players have applied so far, but if you haven't, don't delay: the registration period ends in about a week!

After many passionate internal discussions, we've decided to lower the requirements for applicants. We said we wanted the CSO:GS to feel like a celebration of all things CSN:Z/CSO, and that means bringing players on board united by their love of the game rather than just their win rate. We encourage everyone to apply - your chances may be better than you think!

Influencer Recruitment Criteria (1 Chosen)
Must have hosted a YouTube channel, Twitch stream, or similar video content, with CSN:Z as the the primary game for at least a year
Basic ability to communicate in English
A big plus if you're capable of livestreaming in English
Must have a valid passport or visa permitting travel to Korea
Must be over 18 years old
https://g00.gl/forms/1mlsSdvNjOTzIDLV2 (Registration for Influencers, please change number '00' to letter 'oo' after 'g' in the address. Steam blocked Google's link address so we have to change it to number '00')

Player Recruitment Criteria (2 Chosen)
[strike]The character on your personal account must be level 72 or higher.[/strike] Your level is no longer an obstacle! If you know CSN:Z well enough to play well, go ahead and apply!
We do count it a big plus if you've got the CSN:Z chops to take on challengers from around the world, of course
Also a big plus if you have an active presence in the CSN:Z community or on the forums
Basic ability to communicate in English
Must have a valid passport or visa permitting travel to Korea
Must be over 18 years old
https://g00.gl/forms/BaptCFVOfjrWttPB2 (Registration for users, please change number '00' to letter 'oo' after 'g' in the address. Steam blocked Google's link address so we have to change it to number '00')

We'll contact all chosen participants via mail separately. Everyone selected to join the CSO:GS will enjoy cool perks, such as:

Getting to meet CSN:Zs developers
A visit to Nexon's headquarters
Travel costs and lodging compensated for participating in CSOGS
...and more!

We greatly appreciate the support of everyone who can participate, since we have lots of great events being planned.

Once again, we want to thank you all for your continued support for CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Notice] Bug fix: Zombie Scenario 2nd Reboot
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/a7c91d360da13122706341ed3fd14c22b218d37e.jpg

Survivors,

We have found a bug from the Zombie Scenario - 2nd Reboot. In the notice, it is clearly said that "You'll have a chance to obtain Parts-Compatible Weapons by clearing the 'Normal' difficulty. (This applies to clearing 'Normal' difficulty for all Scenarios)" but as you know, the weapons are never actually awarded .

We will be fixing this bug on the next maintenance day. (It would be 24th of October, 2018 maybe)

When you clear 'Normal' difficulty, you will have a CHANCE to obtain Parts-Compatible Weapons. This means there are no guarantees.

However, we are going to give you a weapon if you clear the 'Normal' difficulty for all Scenarios at least once. (If you clear the second, third... doesn't matter, we are going to give you one. This will happen only until the 24th of October so if you would like to try to complete this challenge, play now!

We are terribly sorry for the mistake and we will also fix couple of minor bugs on the next maintenance day. Of course, I can't say when the mileage auction will come next.

Only Skooom says all... ːsteamhappyː

Thanks again and we are looking forward to hearing your feedback soon.

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

Updated Events

'Defeat the Zombie' Reboot Map Event (September 27 - October 10)

You'll earn a reward upon clearing all 3 Zombie Scenario Reboot Maps on difficulty levels Hard-1 to Hard-6 (18 stages in total).

Last Clue (Hard-1 - Hard-6)
Omen (Hard-1 - Hard-6)
Panic Room (Hard-1 - Hard-6)

You'll be rewarded with 5 Top 50 Decoders every time you clear each map. If you clear all 3 maps, you can receive a total of 15 Top 50 Decoders.

You can only participate in this event in rooms with 4 or more players, and participation is limited to once per account, with a minimum playtime of 5 minutes.

Hunter-Killer X-90 Sale Promotion (September 27 - October 10)

For the duration of this promotion, when you use a Top 50 Unlimited Decoder or a Top 50 Decoder, you'll have 10 TIMES the chance of winning the Hunter-Killer X90!

Hunter Killer X-90 Guaranteed Giveaway Promotion (September 27 - October 10)

For the duration of this promotion, If you open 15 Top 50 Unlimited Decoders or 90 Top 50 Decoders, we'll give you your very own Hunter Killer X-90!

Keep in mind, though, that each account can only receive this reward once!

Play the New Bell's Lab Map Event (September 27 - October 10)

For the duration of this event, those who can clear the studio escape map created by the devs will be rewarded! A Top 30 Brand Decoder Supply Box (10 days) is waiting for everyone who can successfully escape the lab.

Although there is no player limit, keep in mind that you can only claim the reward from this event once per account.

2 New Character Rate-Up Promotion (September 27 - October 24)

For the duration of this promotion, your chances of getting one of the two new Class Characters from Top 30 C and C Decoders is a full 10 TIMES the normal rate!
Mila
Lisa

These two new items will be removed from the Top 30 C and C Decoders during the 10/24 maintenance, when the offer ends.

Don't miss this fantastic chance to obtain both new class characters, available for a limited time only!

2 New Class Characters Giveaway Promotion (September 27 - October 10)

Either Mila or Lisa will be rewarded if you use a 30 Top 30 C and C Decoders, with whichever one you didn't get obtainable if you use an additional 30. (Ex: If you received Mila after using 30 decoders, you'll get Lisa if you use 30 more).

Do you already have both Mila and Lisa? Not to worry! You can get either of them as a reward again!

You’ll also have a chance to score the M32 Venom at 10 TIMES the normal rate, so don’t miss out!

Play the New Map Event (September 27 - October 10)

For the duration of this event, you'll receive 2 times the EXP and game points for playing the following maps:
Lighthouse
Mirage

Straight Talk with CSN:Z

We here with CSN:Z are always doing our best to ensure that you have an enjoyable environment for playing. We do, however, want you to be aware that how you experience the game on your end is influenced by many geographical, technological, and infrastructural conditions outside our ability to control.

We completed the migration process to AWS from the former IDC environment (and its many troubles), which should guarantee a greater degree of stability. While it does cost more than before, we felt the migration was worth it to give you a better gaming experience.

Redd, a huge fan of the game, posted a thread in the Discussion section before. (https://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/3338745825891944954/)

The thread listed various pieces of content we had not added. Using this thread as a reference, we've added the following content:
Turbulent-1
Turbulent-11
Korean 707th Special Missions Battalion, aka the 707th Commando (30 Days)
Red Beret Condottiere (7 Days – Points item)

We like hearing what you think about the game, so feel free to let us know about what kind of content you'd like to see added, or things you'd like to see that aren't in the game. Ideas and constructive criticism are always welcome in the Discussion section.

Once again, we want to thank you all for your continued support for CSN:Z. We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

Ps. Mileage auction will be added on.... Skooom!!!

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: June 7th: Part 2
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e88b4e95f1535e8dc9b908118187c14da6c45f7b.jpg

Survivors,

You have arrived at the SECOND part of this week's patch notes. If you haven't seen the FIRST part yet, click 'here' to catch up on all the news!


Studio Soccer Mode Update
You can now create Soccer Mode maps in Studio Mode. The Rules are identical to those of the previously existing Soccer Mode. This mode has a maximum of 24 participants.

We added 3 new NPCs: Soccer Coach, Male NPC (Uniformed), and Female NPC (Ji Yoon Choi Uniform version). We also added 2 new soccer-themed Monster NPCs. Hooligan A is a melee attacker, while Hooligan B is a ranged attacker.

To improve Studio Soccer Mode, we also added 6 new sound effects, such as the sound of a ball bouncing off metal bars.

Play Studio Soccer Mode in special Soccer-exclusive maps like Cage and Field!


Updated Top 50 Decoder Item & Weapon Content
As we mentioned in the first patch notes, we've updated the items and weapons available from Top 50 Decoders. We felt this revamp was necessary, as many new weapons have been released since the Decoders' rewards were last updated.

The following weapons have been added to the Top 7:
Red Dragon Cannon
Blade Runebreaker
Bunker Buster LTD

The following weapons have been removed from the Top 7:
M4A1 Dark Knight
AK47 Paladin
Ripper

The following weapons have been removed from the Top 25:
Papin
Crossbow
BALROG-XI

The following weapons have been removed from the Top 50:
Dart Pistol
Brick Piece V2
Ethereal

Please see below for the updated Top 50 Weapon list.

Big Changes to the Matching System!

The way you find and start games has changed significantly with today's patch.

We'd like to tell you a little bit about how we came to make this change, and what we took into account as we considered how to do it.

The matching system was developed last year with these goals and purposes in mind:

To allow players to play matches with others of similar skill levels, giving them fewer one-sided experiences and more exciting, evenly matched games.
To provide a fast, convenient UI that lets players join games easily and improves the accessibility needed to get a game started.

After the patch we did see many players' enjoyment of the game improved through use of the Matching System. However, we found that the playerbase was too split up, due to the fact that games created via the Matching System were treated as separate from Custom Games.

For many CSN:Z players, Studio and Custom Games form the majority of their play, so players using the Matching System had limited options when choosing a room.

With this patch we decided to fix the issues listed above while staying true to the system's original purpose.

Unifying the Split Playerbase
In order to solve this issue, we removed Matching System integration from all regular games, and integrated it fully with Custom Games. Our decision was based on a belief that players will enjoy their time with the game more if allowed the greatest freedom to play with the broadest possible pool of players, as represented by the players of Custom Games.

Maintain the Convenience of Finding Games
In order to maintain the ease of finding and starting a game, which was the best aspect of the original Matching System, we added a Quick Start function that is similar to the one currently employed in Matching. With this function you can select the modes you're interested in playing and select an automatically recommended room to quickly join a game.

Improved the Room Information UI functionality for conveniently starting games and checking information
Previously, Studio Maps only displayed the map name as the room title, and that title couldn't be changed. Now, players will be able to set the room name as they see fit. 

We also added a room title search function and a Studio/Regular Map filter so you can more easily check room information. Additionally, we added a feature that displays the rooms with games that started a short time ago in green, enabling players to find them more easily.

But wait...there's more! Before, you had to create and enter a room in order to change the settings. Now, you can configure the basic settings for the room as you create it. This should reduce the likelihood that players will skip over a room due to viewing only the default settings displayed as the room's creator configures it.

Improved the steps to join a game
Before, players who remained on standby in the map information or class selection screens hindered the players who wanted to start the game from actually playing. In order to minimize this issue, we've improved the flow of this process.

We removed the part that requires players to enter input on the map information screen. We also added a time limit on the studio entrance and class selection screens so that the game will begin automatically after a set time. 

Players who remain on standby after that will be automatically kicked from the room. Our intent in this is to make the time you spend with the game more meaningful.

We hope that the convenience-focused features in this update help you to enjoy and engage with our game as a member of the community.

Thank you again for your continued love and support of CSN:Z.

Well, that just about wraps things up for this week's update!
We're already busy getting the next batch of awesome updates ready.

As always, we hope you continue to enjoy playing CSN:Z. Stay tuned for the next patch!


Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team
