notes.title: Zombie Scenario Season 6-1 Update!
notes.notes:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/EN-Special-1029x346.jpg

Unveil The Forces Behind The Terrorist Group And Return Safely!

The world is in chaos because of terrorism and zombies. The Intelligence Agency doubts the relationship between the Asian Red Army and the zombies so they send Ji Yoon Choi to infiltrate the Asian Red Army. However after a while, the AI loses contact with Ji Yoon Choi....

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/0111_ZS6-1-724x1024.jpg

In this chapter, Ji Yoon Choi is chasing a possible terrorist leader and Ritsuka and Mei are chasing Ji Yoon Choi for different purposes. Unveil the forces behind the terrorist group and return safely!

Zombie Scenario Season 6-1 Update Event Part 1!

During the event period, you can get double EXP and points in the Zombie Scenario mode!

WHEN
From January 11th to February 15th.

REWARD
Double EXP and Points.

HOW
Play Zombie Scenario mode!

Zombie Scenario Season 6-1 Update Event Part 2!

Clear Zombie Scenario Season 6-1 with [Hard-6] difficulty or higher and get your rewards!

WHEN
From January 11th to February 15th.

REWARD
100,000 points

HOW
Play Zombie Scenario Season 6-1 with [Hard-6] difficulty or higher.
Play with at least 4 or more players together in the same room.
You can get the reward only once during the event period.
You have to play at least 3 or more minutes otherwise you are not eligible to get a reward.

Free Daily Rewards Event!

Free daily rewards are improved! Please check your free daily rewards when you log into the game!

WHEN
From January 11th to February 15th.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

Coin Event

We only have one update for this week. That’s the coin event. Maybe you can say “Coin Event? Is it updated?” Yes, the old coin event is gone and a new coin event is on its way.

REWARD
10 x Supreme Decoders (3 Players)
50 x Mileage Decoders (5 Players)
30 x Mileage Decoders (10 Players)
3 x Costume Box Season 2 (20 Players)
1 x Perfect Enhancement Box (20 Players)

WHEN
From October 19th to November 2nd.


Regarding Vulcanus-3 weapon.

As you can see in the past announcement, we have been doing the 'Trick or Treat' event for a while. However, we acknowledged that it leads a sudden game blocking issue therefore we have removed your Vulcanus-3 in your inventory today during the maintenance.

But don't panic.

We extracted Vulcanus-3 owners list from the game and your Vulcanus-3 will be given back during next week's maintenance time, without duration loss.

We apologize for the inconvenience, however this is a necessary choice for your pleasant gaming environment.

Maybe you are disappointed for our weekly update this week, but we are preparing many different contents for the next week’s update. Therefore, don’t miss our next week’s update note!

Kind Regards, 
CSN:Z Team

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

We're in the middle of August. However, the temperature is dropping day by day and now we need to start preparing for the winter. Your Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies team is also preparing for autumn and winter content now. When the snow falls, you will see what we have been preparing for.

Check out the full update notes:

Summer Games Event 1

In certain parts of the world, people are getting crazy about world sports games. We are not athletes, but we are CSN:Z players! We will play our game, our way!

Click here for more information.

Summer Games Event 2

You are able to get a free Mileage Decoder from this event. There is no reason to hesitate! Let’s join!

Click here for more information.

Permanent Weapon Giveaway Event!

Click here for more information.

50,000,000 Zombie Killing Spree Event!

Click here for more information.

Bingo Weapon Update!

What’s new on Bingo? Let’s check this out now!

Click here for more information.

Vote To Kick Item Adjustment.

We have renewed ‘Vote to Kick’ item’s function. There were many requests to change ‘Vote to kick’ function due to false usage or abuse. Finally, we've made adjustments. Let’s check this out.

CHANGES

Daily usage limitation from 5 times per day to 3 times per day.
‘Agree’ and ‘Disagree’ key will be randomly changed. Therefore, please look carefully and express your opinion.
You have to leave a comment for initiating votekick that is at least 10 letters long.
Adjustment of vote to kick usage time.
More ‘Agreed-players’ are needed when votekick initiated. (More than 90% of players have to be standing on ‘votekick-agree’ side, then votekick will be applied successfully.)


GM Event Reward Injection.

As we mentioned in last week’s weekly patch note, your GM event reward has been injected during today’s maintenance. Please check this out in your inventory now.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Bottom.jpg

... and don't forget our Gold/Silver medal event as well.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.notes:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

First, we have to say this: Thank you for your patience. We have prepared many things for this week. Hot weather has made us tired and we are looking for a cool place, but you don’t need to look too hard to find one. You are at the right place if you're reading this! Here is just a little something we've done.

Check out the full update notes:

New content: Crazy Zombie Hero

Limited duration! We just removed stress-driven rules, and left behind the fun parts of Zombie Hero! Enjoy Crazy Zombie Hero!

WHEN

From August 10th to September 7th.

WHAT

Adjusted new rules will be applied to Zombie Hero mode.

HOW

HUMAN: will use acquired items and your primary and secondary weapon ammunition will be reloaded automatically.
ZOMBIE: will have faster cooldown time and Zombie bomb will be reloaded automatically.
These rules will be applied to Crazy ITALY and Crazy DUST only. However you can also play original ITALY and DUST as well.
You can also participate in an event in the Crazy ITALY and Crazy DUST maps and acquire EXP and Points.

Note: Zombie Evolution, Medal, Miniature Medal, Mission, Statistics Accumulation, and league points will not be awarded in the Crazy ITALY and Crazy DUST maps.

Free Transcendence Decoder Event!

How can you get your free Transcendence Decoder during the event period?

Click here for more information.

Gold Medal and Silver Medal Event!

The Summer Olympic games have begun in the real world. Let’s get Gold and Silver medals in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies!

Click here for more information.

Improved Transcendence Decoders came back!

What’s changed in the New Transcendence Decoder? Let’s find out now!

Click here for more information.

Improved Mileage Decoder!

Changing the Mileage Decoder was not an easy decision. However, we decided to do this for you anyway! Let’s check out the new Mileage Decoder!

Click here for more information.

Flag weapon bonus event!

We have a newly designed flag weapon. Shall we learn about your flag weapon here?

Click here for more information.

GM Event Reward Injection.

We are going to inject recent GM Event rewards on August 17. Thanks for your patience in advance.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.notes:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

We are preparing many events for this week's update! Mainly, you can encounter many enhancement related events and a free giveaway event could be a bonus! Don’t miss this fantastic opportunity and play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies in this summer!

Check out the full update notes:

Killing Mosquito Event.

I love summer but there are bugs everywhere! Because the mosquitoes were sucking my blood, I was attacked! Zombies will follow the scent of my blood! Let’s kill mosquitoes around you to make your area safe from unexpected zombie attacks!

Click here for more info.

It’s Time For Enhancement!

During the event period, your enhancement chance is going to increase based on your play time!

Click here for more info.

Attendance Event For Enhancement! – Part 1

During the event period, you can get a ‘Perfect Enhancement Material Part’ randomly.

Click here for more info.

notes.title: EVENT RULES UPDATE - All against [NX]BlindFire
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/924813710d1822448c4697c8e31e8f6f03f4d694.jpg
Dear Survivors,

Yesterday it was the first day of the GM Event "All against [NX]BlindFire" and for as much as we wanted for it to go perfectly smooth, inconvenients happened.

Specifically, the balance of the Event overall was clearly shifted toward our dear GM, preventing users from having a fair chance at winning. This is not what the CSN:Z Team planned: the idea at the base of the Event is that of having an enjoyable and fun experience in a match which sees a GM roaming around killing everyone on sight for a good 10 minutes, while players struggle to get as many kills as possible in order to beat him.

But this proved to be impossible if efforts of the users are not combined as the Event's Title suggests.

Thanks to the tests performed by [NX]BlindFire during the Event itself and the 'unfortunate users' who had to suffer from his uncontrolled killing rampage yesterday, we came up with a better solution.
Please read below for the reviewed Event Rules:

 RULES:

Rounds last 10 minutes each and the kill limit is set at 120, a total of 6 rounds will take place and rooms will be switched every 2 rounds.
EU Channel will be shared before making the actual Event Room in it, to allow all interested users to gather and have a chance to join.
Map will be randomly selected and there will be no weapon restriction.
[NX]BlindFire is immortal and has unlimited ammo.
A round is considered completed whenever the 10 minutes run out, or the 120 kills limit has been reached. Depending on which of the two occurs first.
When a round is over, the top 3 players who managed to score the most kills will see their kill counts for that round combined and then compared to that of [NX]BlindFire alone.
If the combined kills are more than the ones scored by [NX]BlindFire, the round is won and all users in the room will get a reward.
If the resulting kills are less than the ones scored by [NX]BlindFire, the round is lost.
Tactics like kill farming or similar are still not tolerated and will completely invalidate the ongoing round as a penalty.
[NX]BlindFire's presence is required from start to end in the Match for it to be valid. In case of unexpected technical issues, the ongoing round will be simply restarted.

Note: Time/Date of the Event and its rewards are NOT subject to changes.
We will keep monitoring the situation and refine even more the Rules in case it's needed.

15th July Note:
During today's Event, we'll be performing some more tests to balance it further.
Tests will see the following variables addressed:
- Kill Limit
- Calculation of the win condition

We do believe that involving you and your performances actively in this process will make us capable of reaching a good level of balance and fairness, turning this into a fun and, possibly, rewarding experience.

As for previous days: all hosted rounds will count as valid in case no technical issues occur! Testing won't invalidate them!


Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

Survivors,

The wait is over. We would like to show our sincere appreciation for your patience with the long wait. We are pleased to introduce new content called: Last Flight. You will encounter new Zombies, bosses, items, and new stories as well. Now you are finally able to play this new content.

Check out the full update notes:

New Contents: Last Flight

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/LastFlight.jpg

Jennifer finally gets information from Soy but there’s another enemy. To protect each other and destroy the new enemy: Crono Wing.

When you defeat the new boss, Crono Wing, you will get a proper reward by chance.

It will be easiest if you pick up the weapon near you. You can also use the rooftop as a shield from enemy attack.

Supreme Decoder Strikes Back With New Items!

Supreme Decoder is back in town with new items. We have added SKULL-2, Lightening Dao-1, and Lightning Bazzie-1. Enjoy the new Supreme decoder now.

Supreme decoder will be removed from the shop on August 3rd.

Crow-7 Pre-Order Pack

Thanks for the support and encouragement that you have given us with the Vulcanus Pre-order pack. Now it’s time for us to show you our new Crow-7 Pre-order pack. This Crow-7 Pre-order pack consists of:

Crow-7 (100 days)
Supreme Decoder x 3 pcs.
Mileage Decoder Supply Box (10 days, 500% more EXP & Points)
Costume Box 2 x 2 pcs.

It is available from today until July 20th and you can buy only once per account.
(Single Crow-7 will be available from July 20th.)

10 Free Mileage Decoder Event!

During this event period, you can acquire free mileage decoders as a reward based upon your play time of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies.
Click here for more info.

Improved Promotion Rewards.

We have changed something in the promotion rewards. There is a 50% item discount coupon in the Level 3, Level 5, and Level 10 Promotion rewards box. Buy anything you want at a 50% discount now. Air supply mission has been successfully completed!

'Be One Of The First 50' Event Winners.

Check out your inventory. We have added your reward today. (KH 2002 Permanent)

Bug Fixes

NGS SDK Set update. – Patch for ‘BlackCipher not initialized’ error. If you have the same error after this patch, please send us a ticket!
Rebecca (Police class) and Ace’s (Thief class) in-game string length has been adjusted.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

-70% DLC Steam Sales

Rivals DLC

notes.notes:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

Welcome to the next big CSN:Z expansion. June brings plenty of changes to all game areas: comeback of the 2 most wanted buff weapons and plenty of new ones in Mileage Decoder and Perfect Pick Recipes; improvements and rewards for new users and leveling system upgrade for veterans as well as the usual free giveaways.

Check out the full update notes:

Transcendence Piece Event

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/02_0608_image.png

WHEN
⋅ 8 to 29 of June (For 3 weeks)
HOW
⋅ You can get the Transcendence Piece item from Mileage Decoder during the event period.
⋅ Once you have collected 888 of the pieces you can exchange them for either the M4A1 Dark Knight or AK-47 Paladin.
⋅ After this event, remaining Transcendence Pieces will be replaced with the other items.

Vulcanus Pre-order Pack

WHEN
⋅ 8 to 15 of June
AMOUNT
⋅ Only 100 EA for the first 100 buyers.
DETAIL
⋅ Mileage Decoder Supply Boxes supply Decoders upon logging in to the game. (For example, 5 Decoders x 10 days = 50 Decoders maximum for 10 days)
⋅ Mileage Decoder Growth Box. (500% EXP/GP Bonus / 10 days)
⋅ VULCANUS-9 (100 days)
⋅ VULCANUS-11 (100 days)
⋅ Every account can buy it one time only.
⋅ Enjoy first purchaser premium 1 week earlier than others.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=699851344

Improved Mileage Decoder

Add Permanent Blair + Fernando + Heavy Zombie Knife. (Not including Silver Luger and Holy Water Grenade)
Add new weapons: Lightning AR-1, Lightning AR-2, and Needler

Revamped Tutorial for new users*

New users can receive free weapons after completing the tutorial mode where they learn about the basics of the game mechanics and compete with zombie opponents.

Weapons to win
⋅ BALROG-VII (15 days) + Grade-1 and Grade-2 Blueprints [S] + 2x Durables (30 days) + 6400 Game Points
⋅ SKULL-VII (15 days) + Grade-3 and Grade-4 Blueprints [S] + 2x Durables (30 days) + 6400 Game Points
⋅ JANUS-VII (15 days) + Grade-5 and Grade-6 Blueprints [S] + 2x Durables (30 days) + 6400 Game Points
⋅ This reward will only be given the first time you complete the mission.

Zombie Mode Play Event

New users can receive the following weapons and other rewards when they clear any Zombie mode:

WHO?: You are considered a new user if you’re under level 5 or within 30 days of character creation you can receive:
When you clear Zombie mode for the first time
⋅ BALROG-XI (15 days) + Grade-1, Grade-2 and Grade-3 Blueprints [S] + 3x Durables (30 days) + 9600 Game Points + 5x Special Enhancement Material.
When you clear Zombie mode a second time
⋅ SKULL-IX (15 days) + Grade-4, Grade-5 and Grade-6 Blueprints [S] + 3x Durables (30 days) + 9600 Game Points + 10x Special Enhancement Material.

Maximum level of account has been increased from 72 to 250

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/01_0608_image.png

New levels are unlocked with new rank icons. You can finally rank up to General of the Armies title and reach level cap at 250! You will get ‘General of the Armies’ at level 78!
New Valor medals have been added.
New Honor Missions and medals have been added.

‘Be the first 50’ event

Be one of the first 50 players who reach level 78.
Click here for more detail.

The more, the merrier!

The more you play, the more you get!
Click here for more detail.

Return of the S/J/M/B Box Event

It’s way stronger and way more generous than before.
Click here for more detail.

notes.notes:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

You want maps and it has been quite a long time since we last updated maps with Zombie Scenario Season 5 locations. Two maps for Team Deathmatch are unveiled – Train Shed and Warehouse. On top of that, an event we did last year came back: the Coin Event is here with even better rewards thanks to our two sponsors: CAM and Creative.

Check out all the details below.

New Maps

Train Shed: This is a Shotgun Battle map which consists of wide open spaces, many covers, and a moving train! The map design is simple, but note that shotgun is only deadly in short range.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/0525_001-1024x608.jpg

Warehouse: A new map for Team Deathmatch redesigned for CSN:Z. This is originally the most popular map from Nexon’s Sudden Attack series!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/0525_002-1024x608.jpg

Coin Event

Duration: 25.05.2016 – 08.06.2016

You can see the ‘Coin Event’ button at the bottom of the lobby menu.
Earn a coin every 30 minutes of play time with at least 4 players in a room.
You can acquire a maximum of 3 coins at a time per account, and must use them as soon as you get them. Once you use them, you are eligible to receive more.
This event may be finished earlier if the prizes are all claimed. Therefore, you had better run to join this event quickly.
Rewards:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/0525_003.png
 S340 Razer Edition Casing
 Sound BlasterX Headset - H7
 and more prizes from CAM and Creative
 15,000  Mileage Decoders!

Special Mission 10 times completion event.

Duration: 25.05.2016 – 08.06.2016

During the event period, you will need to complete the Special mission 10 times.
Then, you will get an UZI (Permanent) as a reward.


Weapon Upgrade Event

Duration: 25.05.2016 – 08.06.2016

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/0525_004.png

M134 Minigun → M134 Predator (permanent)
Combat Knife → Knife Combat Master (permanent)
Double Barrel Shotgun → Triple Barrel Shotgun (permanent)
SL8 → SL8 Custom (permanent)
Acquire a default weapon from the shop and enter a room with at least 4 players.
Collect 5,000 kill points for a primary weapon and 3,000 kill points for a secondary weapon and your weapon will become upgraded.
You can check on your upgrading progress, which is visible in the game chat as you earn points.

¤ Tips! You can get relatively higher kill points in the Zombie Original, Zombie Mutant, Hidden Mode, Bot Zombie Mode, and Zombie Darkness mode!

Double Mileage Event!

Duration: 25.05.2016 – 01.06.2016

You will get double mileage from Mileage Decoder from today!
¤ Mileage from Mileage Decoder will be given randomly.

CSN:Z Team

Special ENH Material, Costume Box Items, Points, Blueprints [S], 72 day-Permanent Durable, Resetting Material, and etc.,

notes.title: [UPDATE] New Characters Strike Back!
notes.notes:
For a while, Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies has not had any new characters. There were a number of reasons for this, but one of them might have been that the last new characters, Carlito and Walter, didn't do so well - and also because it kind of felt like the characters didn't interest you very much.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/1.png
"These... these are not tears!"

So, this time I have prepared some very special guys for you!
Meet 'Blair' and 'Fernando'!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/2.png

Blair

Blair, a hunter who is originally from Ireland, was well-known as a problem solver for off-the-record requests. However, when her fame reached its peak, she vanished from this world without a trace. After she went missing, rumors about zombies swept all across Europe and many thought this wasn't just a coincidence.

If her looks remind you of 'Black Widow' from Marvel Comics, I have to say that it's just your imagination. That would not be the case....

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/3.png
"Do... they look alike? Um…. Well…. You're just imagining things!”

But Blair alone is not so flashy, right? As such we have quite daringly decided to offer Blair and the Silver Medal Luger together, making the [Blair & Silver Luger] set.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/4.png

The [Blair & Silver Luger] set has a Duration, and it can be purchased with cash. Unfortunately, the Duration cannot be extended. Blair is valid for 7 days, and the Silver Medal Luger for 14 days.

Fernando

After graduating from a seminary school in Spain, Fernando wandered all over Europe as an exorcist. He and His Holy Water Grenade were well known due to his many deeds. It is recorded that he was killed while performing an exorcism in Germany, but it seems like this theory was not so well received.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/5.png
"Are you saying that I'm dead? Here goes my Desert Eagle of Fury!!"

Of course, Fernando alone wouldn't be a fair match next to the [Blair & Silver Luger] set. So we have also decided to sell Fernando with the Holy Water Grenade, as the [Fernando & Holy Water Grenade] set!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/6.png

The [Fernando & Holy Water Grenade] has a Duration, and it can be purchased with cash. Unfortunately, the Duration for this item cannot be extended either. Fernando is valid for 7 days, and the Holy Water Grenade for 14 days.

The most useful function of the Holy Water is ignoring the Light Zombies' ability to cloak. When blasted with the Holy Water, they cannot hide, no matter how much they try. An even better function is preventing the zombies from recovering for a certain amount of time. Zombies by default are able to recover HP when they stay still without being hit for 3 seconds or more, but when hit with the Holy Water, the zombies' HP takes damage over time.

The zombie has to waste about 8 seconds, trying to recover HP before it can go catch some humans before the round ends.

I really hope you purchase these great weapons while you can!

Having prepared so much last time, there isn't much new for this week. For the time being, this is all for this week; check back next week for improved contents!

Removal of Supreme Decoder and CSN:Z Boost Package 1

Those two items have been removed today. I hope to see them in our in-game shop soon.

Oh right, you know that the May [Weapon of the Month] is AWP? When you get down to it, nothing can beat AWP. Please use it! Plus, it's free!!!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/7.png

Bye everyone, see you next week!

notes.title: [Event Update] Weapon Of The Month!
notes.notes:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/banner_en-3.jpg

Weapon Of The Month!

Following the K3 from the month before, AWP has been selected as the 'Weapon of the Month'!

Wouldn't you agree that AWP is the most iconic weapon in the Counter-Strike franchise? It's a gun boasting destruction, eliminating anyone in your sights with deadly aim and reflexes!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/1-6.png

This sniper rifle can deal massive damage, which even ignores armor, and holds 10 rounds of .338 Lapua ammunition. The best of the best, AWP! There isn't any competition!

However!

However!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2-7.png

The AWP selected as the 'Weapon of the Month' boasts of even greater force. (...)
(What is this madness!!)

The AWP selected as 'Weapon of the Month' will deal more damage in Zombie Scenarios! AWP may have a lower rate of fire compared to the previous 'Weapon of the Month' K3, thus decreasing the overall damage output, but it's one of my favorite weapons!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/3-5.png

Enjoy AWP, Natasha's favorite weapon, as 'Weapon of the Month'!

All users can use 'Weapon of the Month,' and it will be switched with one of the basic weapons in your inventory.
You can check it out under Inventory [Event] > [Weapon of the Month]
[Weapon of the Month] will be given out automatically in Zombie and Zombie Scenario modes.
It can be accessed in the Buy Menu whether the gun is a [Weapon of the Month] or not.


Moreover, the 'Weapon of the Month,' AWP can be used from midnight of 1st May to midnight of 30th May (CEST).

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2-5.png

I wonder which weapon you will get. Aren't you curious?

Supreme Decoder Event Over The Weekend!

As you know, we are always considering our players' happiness. Therefore, I am preparing a new event for you. This will be the best event in CSN:Z history.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/decoder.png

If you are logged into the game on 29th and 30th of April, you will get 1 Supreme Decoder for free. Of course, there are some conditions in order to get this wonderful item.

You can only get the decoder from 18:00 to 20:00 (CEST and PST).

I hope everyone participates in this event on 29th and 30th of April to play CSN:Z with free Supreme Decoders!

notes.title: [Update] 30% Discount Coupons for all items are released! It's Enhancement Time! Put the force back into your lives!
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors,

It looks like winter is finally over, and the weather is warming up to the point where some people are wearing T-shirts on the streets. We hope that the cold, cold winter has departed and the warm spring has arrived in the hearts of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies players!

30% Discount Coupons For All Items Are Released!

We are giving out 30% Discount Coupons for all items! When you log in for the first time during the event, you will receive 10x 30% Discount Coupons for all items! We are giving out 10 coupons!

This event will start from the 20th of April, 09:00 CEST to 4th of May, 09:00 CEST! With this 30% Discount Coupon, there will be no pressure to buy expensive items!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/7_en.png

Purchase all cash items in store at a 30% discounted price!
You wouldn't miss this big chance, would you?

 Supreme Decoder is back!

Don’t let the odds rattle you, my fellow single survivors! It’s always a bit of an ordeal the first time. And now, I can proudly announce that we are bringing the Supreme Decoder back! 

http://csoimage.nexoneu.com/csnz/game/promotion/others160217/decoder.png

Each time you open the Supreme Decoder, you have an 85% chance to win BALROG, SKULL, JANUS, Maverick series or Salamander, M32 MGL, AT4-CS, Leviathan. Any of these weapons will be at minimum 70 Day versions. 

This Decoder will be available from 20th April to 4th May so DO NOT MISS THIS OPPORTUNITY! 

Check out what you will get through this Supreme Decoder: 

http://csoimage.nexoneu.com/csnz/game/promotion/others160217/weapons.png

May Is The Month Of Events! The Giveaway Events Are Here!

As you know, it's not weird to call May the month of events. We have prepared events which will satisfy all your needs! Take a look at the bottom for a brief explanation of the events, and if you need more details, feel free to click on the links! We've prepared a detailed explanation of the events for you!

If you want to find out, click here! (ENGLISH)

It's Upgrade Time!

From April 20th, after maintenance, to April 27th, before maintenance, the chance of upgrading increases depending on the play time!

Enhancement Buff Stage 1: Play for 30 minutes in order to get this buff!
Enhancement Buff Stage 2: Play for 60 minutes in order to get this buff!

Two Upgrade Attendance Events!

The Upgrade Attendance Event consists of two parts. First, if you log in during the event period, a perfect reinforced material will be randomly given out! And second, if you play 1 hour each day for 7 days, a perfect reinforced material will be randomly given out!

If you log in during the event period…

We'll randomly distribute one of the Reinforced Parts below!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/5-2.png

If you log on during the event period, we'll supply you with 1 random perfect upgrade material.
Attendance can be done once per day.
This can be done only in A class rooms with 4 or more players.
If there is no space in your inventory, the item will not be given out.

If you play 1 hour per day for 7 days…

We'll randomly distribute one of the Perfect Reinforced Parts below!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/6-1.png

Well, as always, there are some prerequisites. Something that you all know by now!

If you play one hour per day for 7 days during the event period, we'll give out one random Perfect Reinforced Part.
The log-in does not have to be consecutive. You just have to play 1 hour per day, for 7 days total to get your Perfect Reinforced Parts.
This can be done only in A class room with 4 or more players.
If there is no space in your inventory, the item will not be given out. So make sure that you have space before you begin with the event.

This event will start from the 20th of April 00:00 (CEST) to 27th of April 00:00 (CEST)!

You all must have been wondering what happened to the Bingo items due to a lack of news, but do not fear, since the new bingo exclusive weapons have been released.

Shall we find out what those are?

Coil Machine Gun

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/1-4.png

The stubby appearance of the Coil Machine Gun may remind you of the Avalanche, but the Coil Machine Gun is categorized as machine a gun. The magazine comes with 100 rounds and the gun fires at 600 rounds per minute. With a full load, it comes in at a staggering 9kg. The rounds fired from the Coil Machine Gun will create an electrical field upon a hit, and will deal AoE damage and apply shock to the enemies.

However, this is only limited to biological targets, and will result in a blue electrical field on-hit. The electrical field will damage nearby targets with splash damage, but it's so minuscule that it can be ignored.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2-3.png

But... the gun has good rate of fire and accuracy, so it is a weapon that I would personally recommend! (And the knock-back power is a bonus!)

Sapientia

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/3-2.png

This is a new pistol which uses special 'holy' bullets. Appearance-wise, it looks similar to the Anaconda.

However, it uses the special 'holy' bullets, which explode on impact to damage any nearby zombies. It can also damage your opponent over time.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/4-3.png

As I've said before, Sapientia is based on the Anaconda, and it (as expected) out-performs the Anaconda.

Moreover, the Holy effect will ease your search for hidden Light zombies. For a pistol, it is a decent performer in the Zombie Scenarios. (Not to mention its sheer penetration power!)

If you haven't yet found a pistol that suits your needs, I would recommend picking up a Sapientia!

We, the Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies team, wish you the best of luck! We'll be back next week with more in store!

Until then, bye!

In order to give you all a better Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies experience, I've had a lengthy time to think about what I could do after the previous notice. So, I've decided to give you all better chances in upgrading your gear!

Depending on your play time, upgrade chances will increase! Enhancement Attendance Event!Don't miss your chance to get your hands on a stronger weapon!

Don't miss your chance to get your hands on a stronger weapon!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/1-3.png

How should you participate in this event? Well, let me just show you the way!


Upgrade Buff Stage 1: Play for 30 minutes in order to get this buff!
Upgrade Buff Stage 2: Play for 60 minutes in order to get this buff!


Isn't it easy? Well, of course I made it easy. Why? All because I've thought real hard about what I could give back to the community without putting too much restrictions! This would make it accessible to everyone, right?

However, there are some prerequisites! ...As always. Well, it’s not anything major, so don't worry! It can be only done in a room with 4 or more players, play time only counts in normal difficulty or higher for zombie scenarios, and the upgrade buff will reset every midnight.

It's really nothing.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2-2.png

Ah! I forgot to mention one thing! This event will start from the 20th of April 00:00 (CEST) to 27th of April 00:00 (CEST)! Don't forget!

Enhancement Attendance Event

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/3-1.png

In order to make the most of this upgrade event, we'll even give out materials for upgrading! You shouldn’t miss out on this! We'll give them out by truck loads, so claim your materials by truck loads as well!!

If You Log In During The Event Period!!

We'll randomly distribute one of the Reinforced Parts below!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/4-2.png

If you log on during the event period, we'll supply you with 1 random perfect upgrade material.
Attendance can be done once per day.
This can be done only in a room with 4 or more players.
If there is no space in the inventory, the item will not be given out.

If You Play 1 Hour Per Day For 7 Days!

We'll randomly distribute one of the Perfect Reinforced Parts below!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/5-1.png

Well, as always, there are some prerequisites. Something that you all know by now!


If you play one hour per day for 7 days during the event period, we'll give out one random Perfect Reinforced Parts.
The log-in does not have to be consecutive. You just have to play 1 hour per day, for 7 days total to get your Perfect Reinforced Parts.
And as usual, it can be done in a room with 4 or more players.
If there is no space in the inventory, the item will not be given out. So make sure that you have space before you begin with the event.
This event will start from the 20th of April 00:00 (CEST) to 27th of April 00:00 (CEST)!


To be continued! Event never stops!

notes.title: [Event Update] Participate In Weekly Events And Receive Free Items!
notes.notes:
This is the CSN:Z management team. Our goal is to provide various events for you. We've also planned a number of different events for this month. We hope you like them!

Let's look at the details...

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/banner_en.jpg


7 Kinds Of BATTLE Weapons!

Our first event is getting 7 kinds of BATTLE weapons for free. These weapons are also permanent. In order to receive weapons, you will need to collect keywords. You probably haven't seen or heard about this kind of event before!

So From When Does It Start And When Does It End?

This HUGE event starts from 14 April 09:00 CEST to 27 April 09:00 CEST.
Also, all the items that you earn are for permanent! You wouldn't miss this big chance, would you?

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/1-1.png

How Do I Collect A Keyword?

If you KILL the opponent during the event, you will receive a letter from the alphabet or a JOKER. Also, if you attend for 10 or more days, you are able to acquire 5x JOKERS.

Wait! What is a JOKER?

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2.png

When you lack a letter of the alphabet, you can use a JOKER instead! Also, JOKERS cannot be purchased. You can only acquire them through playing the game. So a JOKER is a very important item.

What Kind Of Keyword Do I Have To Collect And What Kind Of Weapons Can I Get?

To let you remember the keyword easily, we have prepared simple ones. We hope you like them! To let you remember easily, we made a table, shown below:

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/3_en.jpg

Are There Any Other Conditions?

Of course there are! If an event is too easy, it is not fun. Please look at the conditions listed below and please prepare well.

You can acquire BATTLE weapons with letters of the alphabet that you've earned during the event.
Only available in rooms with 4 or more people.
You can't receive items by bot kill with melee weapons.
The same letters of the alphabet can be collected.
JOKERS are not purchasable and can only be obtained through game play.
When you complete the keyword, the item will be distributed to you right away.
If there is no space in your inventory, you cannot receive the event reward. So please leave a space in your inventory before participating in the event.

All clear? I'll be back with other upcoming event information. Bye and take care!

To be continued! Events never stop!

notes.title: [Update] Leviathan! Salamander is Back!
notes.notes:
Have you been enjoying the Transcendence Decoders released last month? With your support, Transcendence Decoders are getting popular these days. However, the sale of Transcendence Decoders will end soon. If you want to buy more, please go to the in-game shop right now before they are disappear!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1960-3.png

If you want to know more about Transcendence Decoders, please click here.

I hope that you enjoyed the freebie update released last week. We, Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies Team, will do our best to ensure that you have fun.

Let us introduce the items that have been previously released.
Those are Leviathan and Salamander.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/Re_item_icons-1.png
  
These weapons are perfect arch-rivals to each other, also famous for their opposing characters.

Let's take a detailed look at them...

Leviathan

This weapon decreases the movement of enemies by shooting liquid gas, using the rapid-cooling device on the back.

As seen in the stat table, this is more like a supporting weapon rather than one used for direct attacks, as its goal is to freeze enemies. It might look like a vacuum cleaner at first glance.
 
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/smoke-0282.png

Since it is specialized in attacks that freeze the enemy, its attack is less powerful, unfortunately.

This is why it wields a special ability in zombie mode. If you use it against zombies, the freezing effect is more powerful than that of THANATOS-11. Even though zombies want to run toward you, their bodies will stiffen up, not able to move an inch if hit by Leviathan. Well, if you're playing as a zombie, you might become furious.

However, no matter how powerful the freeze, its damage to zombies is small, and is therefore not recommended to fight one-on-one. If you're playing with many users, you can get the most from Leviathan by massacring zombies after distracting them.

The damage to enemies is weak, but the speed of consecutive attacks is quick.

Salamander

This weapon was really popular when first released in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. It shoots raging flames, not allowing zombies to come closer. If attacked, enemies are burnt and get sustaining damage. (HP decreases by 20 per second)

It has a gas tank on the left, which needs to be filled before shooting.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/Salamander.png 

See the tank?

One magazine can have 100 shots, allowing you to shoot for a long time like a machine gun. However, it takes more time to load the magazine compared to other guns, increasing your risk of being hit.

Knock-back is normal. As it can have many shots like a machine gun, you might think it will send enemies back by attacking. But there is little knock-back if you shoot one by one. However, as it discharges flames against many zombies, dealing them sustaining and splash damage all at once makes it a superb weapon.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/s04_image02.jpg

This update introduces the battle between fire and water. What is your choice?

Do you want to freeze enemies with Leviathan? Or want to wield flames from Hell with Salamander? 

Check back next week for the next update!
Bye! See you again next week!

notes.title: [Update] This is no April Fool's Day joke! Freebie events instead of item sale events!
notes.notes:
Sometimes, change can be a really good thing. This time around, we are unveiling a freebie event without a new item sale.

This is not the regular April Fool's Day joke that you expect every year. Keep reading for more details.

You will receive a reward when you complete a special mission 10 times!

It's easy to participate. However, it's not easy to achieve! If you complete a special mission 10 times from 30th March 09:00 CEST to 14th April 09:00 CEST, you will receive MK3A1 (Permanent)!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1-1.png 

This weapon is also known as "Jackhammer". This 12 gauge shotgun is known as an innovative weapon when unleashed. This guns has 10 bullets in total. It weighs 4.57 kg when it's loaded so it's a bit heavy.

While you might feel the attacking speed is slow, you will be happy to see that the re-loading speed is faster compared to other automatic shotguns. Jackhammer fires 6 bullets at once! Take a shot at getting this permanent weapon!

April Fool's Day Spray Event

We can't forget about April Fool's Day Event! It's our special gift prepared for you to celebrate April Fool's Day.
Access Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies and obtain 3 sets of spray!

From 30th March, 09:00 CEST to 14th April, 24:00 CEST, the April Fool’s Day Spray Event will be carried out.

How do you get these weapons? It's simple!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/2-2.png
 
During the event, you will receive the AT4CS Spray (30 days) for the first time you log in.
During the event, you will receive the Lightning AR-2 Spray (30 days) when you access the game for 3 consecutive days.
During the event, you will receive the E-Key Spray (30 days) when you access the game for 5 consecutive days.

It's that simple. However, there's something that you should be aware of...

Rewards will be distributed immediately. It is possible to win the rewards only 1 time during the event period.
If you have no free space in your inventory, you can't receive the event items!
So please be sure to make space in your inventory to receive the rewards.

This event is too good to miss, and it would be a shame if we couldn't reward you due to a full inventory. Have fun!

April Fool's Big Head (Big Head or SD) Event!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/3-3.png 
If you clear [New Zombie Shelter] during the event period, we will reward you with ‘Soi's SD Zombie Maker (1 day)’!

[table]
[tr]
[th]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/4-3.png[/th]
[th]Soi's SD Zombie Maker
The bot, zombie, and boss monster's heads will get bigger in Bot Original, Bot Team Death, Bot Zombie, Zombie Scenario, and New Zombie Shelter modes.[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

You can participate in this event when there are 4 or more players in the room and you can create a Big Head room through Soi's SD Zombie Maker.

Soi's SD Zombie Maker will last for 24 hrs and it will be removed when the event ends. This doesn't get saved, so you should use it right away when you obtain it.

If there is no space in your inventory, you cannot receive the event reward. So please leave a space in your inventory before participating the event.

From 30th March, 09:00 CEST to 14th April, 24:00 CEST, the April Fool’s Big Head Event will be carried out!

Now, we have prepared a full update with real events. We hope to get a lot of support from you. It's spring time already, so take care and we'll chat again with another patch next week!

Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies is always with you.

See you next time!
Bye!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Transcendence Decoder – The Next Big Thing Is Here!
notes.notes:
Let’s start off with saying: Finally! Transcendence Decoder is available and it’s the best thing that happened to the survivors since the discovery of the gunpowder. But 23.03.2016 is truly a historical date and a really bad day for the undead.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/en.jpg

Will it really help with the Zombie problem? They are like sand on a desert: countless and it can get very irritating when trying to get rid of them. They even have their own Scenario! Not to mention their DNA has mutated and Daily Zombie Sweep is never enough to keep them away.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-1-1.png

Please welcome the youngest offspring in Decoders’ Family and your new best friend: Transcendence Decoder. Be fast to get familiar with it as it’s going to leave the party on 14.04.2016, and nobody know if it’s ever going to come back.

Get one or better a pack of Transcendence Decoders in the Item Shop immediately! Open it and become the owner of one of the rewards from the long list below:

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-2-1.png

Brand new top quality 4 weapons: AWP Elven Ranger, Warhammer Storm Giant, Petrol Boomer or Air Burster. They come only in permanent versions!

AWP Elven Ranger

It belongs to Buff weapon series, considered to be some of the best weapons in the game.

This sniper rifle has 20 shots with special bullet called .338 Lapua Magnum and it is very effective for zombies.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-3-1.png

Some special advantages of this weapon:


You can charge the power and attack when you maintain the zoom mode.
When you hit a target, the crosshair marker will show up, this helps improve accuracy even further
Unlimited spare magazine in zombie scenario mode
The sprint duration increases by 1sec in zombie hero
All players' armours are upgraded automatically to 5 LV in zombie scenario.
200% Additional game EXP to yourself and 50% of game EXP to survivors that play with you.


Warhammer Storm Giant

First melee weapon from Buff series and probably the biggest thing you can hit an opponent with.

A giant two-hand hammer that contains the ancient giant tribe’s strong power. By holding the hammer, the owner can feel The Power.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-4-1.png

Some special advantages of this weapon:


Draw attack: Attack while taking the hammer out
Combination attack: When you right-click during the draw attack, it will pound the enemy and fly it away.
Due to its instant attack, you can perform quick switch trick and combine it with other weapons to make continuous hits
Deals tremendous damage – use with caution


Petrol Boomer and Air Burster

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1960-1.png

Both premium heavy weapons that are placed in survivors’ equipment that deal

Petrol Boomer using compressed gas from the Gasoline Bottle that gives a big explosion when fired. Upon contact, massive damage is dealt to the area where the explosion occurs, and a damaging fire will be left for a certain period of time

Air Burster uses compressed air to deliver high power that can stop enemies. Its secondary fire mode is able to cause an explosion with large amounts of compressed air to the frontline, pushing the enemies away.

There is a total of 18 Permanent characters available!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1960-2.png

Great weapons need experienced soldiers to make a full use of them. Each opened Transcendence Decoder gives you a chance to acquire one of unique survivors from a group of 9 Terrorists and 9 Counter Terrorists. Some of them have special buffs to EXP when you use them.

Want more weapons? Worry not, as each time you open the Transcendence Decoder, you have a chance to win Maverick series with some new models, also the famous BALROG, SKULL, JANUS weapons. Any of these weapons will be 70-Day-versions.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1960-3.png

Don’t miss the chance to get as many permanent weapons and characters before Transcendence Decoder is removed from the shop on 14.04.2016!

Also make sure to follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Transcendence Decoder – The Next Big Thing Is Here!
notes.notes:
Let’s start off with saying: Finally! Transcendence Decoder is available and it’s the best thing that happened to the survivors since the discovery of the gunpowder. But 23.03.2016 is truly a historical date and a really bad day for the undead.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/en.jpg

Will it really help with the Zombie problem? They are like sand on a desert: countless and it can get very irritating when trying to get rid of them. They even have their own Scenario! Not to mention their DNA has mutated and Daily Zombie Sweep is never enough to keep them away.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-1-1.png

Please welcome the youngest offspring in Decoders’ Family and your new best friend: Transcendence Decoder. Be fast to get familiar with it as it’s going to leave the party on 14.04.2016, and nobody know if it’s ever going to come back.

Get one or better a pack of Transcendence Decoders in the Item Shop immediately! Open it and become the owner of one of the rewards from the long list below:

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-2-1.png

Brand new top quality 4 weapons: AWP Elven Ranger, Warhammer Storm Giant, Petrol Boomer or Air Burster. They come only in permanent versions!

AWP Elven Ranger

It belongs to Buff weapon series, considered to be some of the best weapons in the game.

This sniper rifle has 20 shots with special bullet called .338 Lapua Magnum and it is very effective for zombies.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-3-1.png

Some special advantages of this weapon:


You can charge the power and attack when you maintain the zoom mode.
When you hit a target, the crosshair marker will show up, this helps improve accuracy even further
Unlimited spare magazine in zombie scenario mode
The sprint duration increases by 1sec in zombie hero
All players' armours are upgraded automatically to 5 LV in zombie scenario.
200% Additional game EXP to yourself and 50% of game EXP to survivors that play with you.


Warhammer Storm Giant

First melee weapon from Buff series and probably the biggest thing you can hit an opponent with.

A giant two-hand hammer that contains the ancient giant tribe’s strong power. By holding the hammer, the owner can feel The Power.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-4-1.png

Some special advantages of this weapon:


Draw attack: Attack while taking the hammer out
Combination attack: When you right-click during the draw attack, it will pound the enemy and fly it away.
Due to its instant attack, you can perform quick switch trick and combine it with other weapons to make continuous hits
Deals tremendous damage – use with caution


Petrol Boomer and Air Burster

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1960-1.png

Both premium heavy weapons that are placed in survivors’ equipment that deal

Petrol Boomer using compressed gas from the Gasoline Bottle that gives a big explosion when fired. Upon contact, massive damage is dealt to the area where the explosion occurs, and a damaging fire will be left for a certain period of time

Air Burster uses compressed air to deliver high power that can stop enemies. Its secondary fire mode is able to cause an explosion with large amounts of compressed air to the frontline, pushing the enemies away.

There is a total of 18 Permanent characters available!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1960-2.png

Great weapons need experienced soldiers to make a full use of them. Each opened Transcendence Decoder gives you a chance to acquire one of unique survivors from a group of 9 Terrorists and 9 Counter Terrorists. Some of them have special buffs to EXP when you use them.

Want more weapons? Worry not, as each time you open the Transcendence Decoder, you have a chance to win Maverick series with some new models, also the famous BALROG, SKULL, JANUS weapons. Any of these weapons will be 70-Day-versions.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1960-3.png

Don’t miss the chance to get as many permanent weapons and characters before Transcendence Decoder is removed from the shop on 14.04.2016!

Also make sure to follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: [Update] Transcendence Decoder release!
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors,

The past week has been a tough one. Since we had to release both Zombie DNA and Teddy Nightmare DLC. However, it makes us very happy to see your never-ending support and love for the new content. 

Last week, there was a chance to purchase Mileage Decoders with GP. Have you had your chance to enjoy the event? We, Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, promise to bring more content and events that you can enjoy in return for the love and support you've given us.

Now then, shall we take a look at what we have in store for you all?

The Transcendence Decoders are now available!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-1.png 

The highly anticipated Transcendence Decoders are now available. The Transcendence Decoder, which was released from Korea and Hong Kong to Japan, will give out rare items at a higher chance. It looks like a Mileage Decoder, but the items that can be obtained just cannot be compared.

The Transcendence Decoder even surpasses the Supreme Decoder.

What can you acquire from the Transcendence Decoder? The list will go on if we had to name all rare items, but we'll name a couple as an example:

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-2.png

Can't you just imagine the item pool from those two items?

AWP ELVEN RANGER has a buff effect that is triggered as long as it's in possession, just like the M4A1 DARK KNIGHT AND AK47 PALADIN. Should we take a look at it?

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-3.png


Sprint duration increased by 1 second in Zombie Hero mode
Automatic upgrade to tier 5 armor for all users in the room in Zombie Scenario mode
200% additional game EXP
50% additional game EXP for other users that played with you


4% lighter weight and 12% faster rate of fire compared to a normal AWP. Isn't that great? Shall we take a look at Warhammer Storm Giant?

Warhammer Storm Giant does not have buff effects, but it does have special features that does not exist in any other melee weapons. The exclusive features are draw attack and combination attack. Draw attack allows you to attack with the Warhammer Storm Giant as it is being taken out, and combination attack allows you to knock back your opponent with an additional attack by clicking the right mouse button at the right timing during draw attack.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-4.png

These two features synergize each other very well, and if they are mastered, then Warhammer Storm Giant will surpass any other melee weapons out in the field.

It definitely lives up to its name. We've brought over all the good things that existed on the THANATOS-9, the damage against enemies have been upgraded, and it will fire just as fast as the THANATOS-9.

All these weapons will be available through Transcendence Decoder. You can get yours after the maintenance on Wednesday, 23rd of March. After the maintenance on 14th of April, Transcendence Decoders will no longer be available! So don't miss out on this chance to acquire rare weapons!

If you wish you find out more on the complete list of weapons that can be acquired through the Transcendence Decoder, please click here!

Click here for more info about Transcendence Decoder.

Golden Weapon Event

From 00:00 on 25th March to 24:00 on 28th March, the Golden Weapon Supply Event will be carried out! Don't miss out on this event during the Easter weekend!

During the event duration, one golden weapon of your choice will be given on the first login. You'll be able to choose one of a total 18 golden weapons.
  

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-5.png

You can receive weapons like HK23 Gold Edition or AKM Gold Edition! 

If you wish you find out more on the complete list of weapons, please click here!

Click here for more info about Golden Weapon Event.

Disabling Family Storage

We suspended Family weapon storage function temporarily to prevent it being abused by illegal acccounts. We wish to restore it as soon as we fix it. Please understand this is urgent case.

Frame rate drop caused by background video

There were user feedbacks about frame rate drop in the game menus caused by a video played in the background. We adjusted it with a patch, which we believe we have improvement on it. If it causes any issues, please feel free to contact us. We are listening to your opinion.

Well, this is it for this week. Aren't you curious of what will come next week? I'm curious as well, but time will tell.

See you next week!

Bye!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie DNA & Teddy Nightmare!
notes.notes:
Survivors,

Time flies, and I am back yet again to bring you news of another big update! Read on for all of the details...

WHAT IS ZOMBIE DNA?

 http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1_en.jpg

Gene modification has been a hot topic in the scientific community. Would there be unforeseen side effects? What would be the consequences? A lot of questions, indeed, but we already know the benefits.

Then, why don’t we modify Zombie’s DNA? Maybe we are able to upgrade our Zombies to attack humans with powerful skills and abilities? Zombie DNA is finally on stage and now it’s your time to experience this.

The DNA system is where you can activate certain sequences of DNA with the points you're given in order to customize your zombie according to your needs.

CLICK HERE FOR MORE INFO.

TEDDY NIGHTMARE DLC

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/2-1.png

Starting today, you are able to purchase the Teddy Nightmare DLC. Teddy Nightmare DLC is separated into 15 and 30 day items. Both packages have two valuable items such as the Teddy Nightmare Mode Key and Mileage Decoder Supply Box. 

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/3-2.png   

Only Teddy Nightmare Mode Key holder can create a room and play with the other users. It means that you don’t need a key to play Teddy Nightmare mode, so long as a valid key holder invites you to their room.

Usually, only key holders would get the many advantages, but we won’t stop there. For more information, click on one of the links below:

CLICK HERE FOR MORE INFO.

GP MILEAGE DECODER EVENT

Surely you have heard that the most popular cash item in Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies is the Mileage Decoder...

Well, starting after the maintenance on 16th March, you can purchase the Mileage Decoder with GP (game points)! 

Of course, there are few of rules: 

   • Level 15-29 players can purchase 1 Mileage Decoder for 5,000 GP
   • Level 30-49 players can purchase 1 Mileage Decoder for 10,000 GP
   • Level 50 and above players can purchase 1 Mileage Decoder for 15,000 GP

Even better, level 50 and above players can purchase all 3 Mileage Decoders listed above (total cost=30,000 GP).

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/4-2.png

This event will end on 30th of March before the maintenance.

WEAPON OF THE MONTH

Zombies are getting stronger and stronger every day. To cope with the dangerous situations, Aegis Institute has recently announced a weapon that has been properly modified and mechanized. It looks similar to the original one, but once you use it, you will never forget this weapon.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/6.jpg 

The Weapon of the Month is specially re-developed by Aegis institute to have superior blocking power against Zombie attacks. Aegis Institute has concrete plans to release a weapon every month.

The [Weapon of the Month] will be used as the default weapons that everyone has, and will be injected directly into their inventories.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/7.jpg

Do you want to know what the [Weapon of the Month] will be? Check your weapon purchasing screen!
 
To have superior firepower against Zombies, Aegis institute does really hard work continuously. Keep your Zombies out from your area with the re-developed [Weapon of the Month!]

RULER OF DARKNESS 50% DISCOUNT EVENT

Your wait is over! Starting from after the maintenance on 16th March, you are able to purchase this set. The Ruler of Darkness, a.k.a ‘Shadow Conqueror’ consist of two zombies, Spin Diver and Night Stalker.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/8_en.png

Since last September, these two Zombies have been showing outrageous outcomes in the world of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. You can find them at competitive prices now. Don’t miss out!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie DNA & Teddy Nightmare!
notes.notes:
Survivors,

Time flies, and I am back yet again to bring you news of another big update! Read on for all of the details...

WHAT IS ZOMBIE DNA?

 http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1_en.jpg

Gene modification has been a hot topic in the scientific community. Would there be unforeseen side effects? What would be the consequences? A lot of questions, indeed, but we already know the benefits.

Then, why don’t we modify Zombie’s DNA? Maybe we are able to upgrade our Zombies to attack humans with powerful skills and abilities? Zombie DNA is finally on stage and now it’s your time to experience this.

The DNA system is where you can activate certain sequences of DNA with the points you're given in order to customize your zombie according to your needs.

CLICK HERE FOR MORE INFO.

TEDDY NIGHTMARE DLC

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/2-1.png

Starting today, you are able to purchase the Teddy Nightmare DLC. Teddy Nightmare DLC is separated into 15 and 30 day items. Both packages have two valuable items such as the Teddy Nightmare Mode Key and Mileage Decoder Supply Box. 

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/3-2.png   

Only Teddy Nightmare Mode Key holder can create a room and play with the other users. It means that you don’t need a key to play Teddy Nightmare mode, so long as a valid key holder invites you to their room.

Usually, only key holders would get the many advantages, but we won’t stop there. For more information, click on one of the links below:

CLICK HERE FOR MORE INFO.

GP MILEAGE DECODER EVENT

Surely you have heard that the most popular cash item in Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies is the Mileage Decoder...

Well, starting after the maintenance on 16th March, you can purchase the Mileage Decoder with GP (game points)! 

Of course, there are few of rules: 

   • Level 15-29 players can purchase 1 Mileage Decoder for 5,000 GP
   • Level 30-49 players can purchase 1 Mileage Decoder for 10,000 GP
   • Level 50 and above players can purchase 1 Mileage Decoder for 15,000 GP

Even better, level 50 and above players can purchase all 3 Mileage Decoders listed above (total cost=30,000 GP).

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/4-2.png

This event will end on 30th of March before the maintenance.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/6.jpg 

The Weapon of the Month is specially re-developed by Aegis institute to have superior blocking power against Zombie attacks. Aegis Institute has concrete plans to release a weapon every month.

The [Weapon of the Month] will be used as the default weapons that everyone has, and will be injected directly into their inventories.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/7.jpg

Do you want to know what the [Weapon of the Month] will be? Check your weapon purchasing screen!
 
To have superior firepower against Zombies, Aegis institute does really hard work continuously. Keep your Zombies out from your area with the re-developed [Weapon of the Month!]

Your wait is over! Starting from after the maintenance on 16th March, you are able to purchase this set. The Ruler of Darkness, a.k.a ‘Shadow Conqueror’ consist of two zombies, Spin Diver and Night Stalker.

notes.title: [UPDATE] This Is Not The End… Teddy Nightmare Comes To The Stage!
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors,

We have been walking side by side on a road of adventure and we have been fighting many battles against countless enemies. Now it is time to take a jump into a whole new concept of zombie threats. Sounds like another bad dream? You are not far from correct, as its name is ‘Teddy Nightmare’.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_01.png
Hello, Survivors! We haven’t met before...

This suspiciously-huggable Teddy awaits to be challenged by survivors who purchase the key in the Teddy Nightmare DLC package.

In the available DLC packages, there is a key allowing you to open gates of Teddy Nightmare mode, plus a unique Mileage Decoder Supply Box. You can freely select a 15 or 30 day DLC version of this set.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_02.png

The Mileage Decoder Supply Box will give its owner 1x Mileage Decoder every day, upon logging into the game. You can continue to use it for 15 days or 30 days, depending on which pack you have chosen and accumulate Mileage Decoders.

Only Teddy Nightmare mode key holders can create Teddy Nightmare mode rooms, but any other survivor can join the challenge without the need of the key.

http://csoimage.nexoneu.com/csnz/game/promotion/etc/TD_NM_xxjpg.jpg
The room creator and other players have an equal chance of getting one of the great items below after defeating the horrific but fluffy bear boss.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_04.png
2,000/5,000/10,000 GP (One of the point items will be given randomly to the players as a result.)

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_05.png
Enhancement Materials for your Weapon Enhancement. You can enhance your weapon to its Enhancement Attributes Value up to 8 by using this material. (10/50/100 items will be given to the players as a result.)

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_06.png
This item is useful to boost the chances of success in manufacturing, especially for lower-tier combat blueprints.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_07.png
This item is used when manufacturing a weapon. It can return the weapon recipe or durability item if it fails to manufacture.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_08.png
The famous Mileage Decoder. You will receive 3x Mileage Decoders if you draw this reward after the match. Please do not disappoint yourself even if your score wasn’t good enough to get this reward.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_09.png
If you use these kits to enhance your weapon, you will have a 100% successful chance on enhancing that attribute by 1 level. (Random parts will be given as a result.)

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_10.png
Anti-Enhancement Material is used to reset your Weapon's Enhancement Attributes value. By using this, the specific stats will be reverted to 0, regardless of status. (Random parts will be given as a result.)

Keep in mind that like any dream, it will come to an end. Do not miss this opportunity!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_11.png


FRENCH
DEUTSCH
POLISH
RUSSIAN
ITALIAN
TURKISH
SPANISH
PORTUGUESE

Let’s have a fun fight with our new DLC challenge and get a chance to grab multiple rewards!

See you in your nightmare!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Vulcanus 5 and Vulcanus 7 Perfect Pick Recipe!
notes.notes:
http://csoimage.nexoneu.com/csnz/game/promotion/etc/0309_banner2_.jpg 

Survivors,

A time flies like an arrow. It seems like yesterday when 2016 started however it is already mid of March! I hope you have enjoyed last week’s NEW USER PACKAGE very much. Like I said in the past, NEW USER PACKAGE is including 11 hot items which includes BARLOG-XI, JANUS-7 and SKULL-1. Thank you for your support for this and keep loving NEW USER PACKAGE item in our in-game shop.

In this week, I am added new items for you guys. Take a rest after fierce battle with Zombies and take a look what we brought today!

VULCANUS-5
This weapon is an assault rifle developed by Aegis Institute chambered with 40 rounds of Smart Bullet. It is equipped with a special scope that can lock-on target by using Vulcanus Parts System.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1_en.png

We will release this item as Perfect Pick Recipe.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/2.png

With this set, the player can get the VULCANUS-5 for sure from Craft using the Perfect Pick Recipe item, but the durability will determine the duration of the weapon.

notes.title: [UPDATE] NEW ROCKET LAUNCHER!
notes.notes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2016/0211.jpg
An assault rifle is very effective for individual combat but sometimes you may feel that assault rifle is not good enough to take your enemy down. That’s true. Sometimes you need to pour your firepower at your enemy. Then my recommendation is going to be RPG-7.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0211/1.png

The RPG-7 (Rocket Propelled Grenade-7) is a rocket launcher purchasable in equipment slot but serves as primary weapon. RPG-7 is a Soviet Union light, versatile anti-tank rocket propelled grenade launcher. It boasts a potent destructive power with a large area of effect, making it an ideal weapon to use against multiple or tough targets, but can also damage the operator if used in close quarters. The user can aim through the iron sights to get an accurate firing.

Through this weapon, you will expect below advantages:

● Massive damage. (In original mode, without flak vest, it gives +100 damage to the body)
● Short reload time
● Fire accurately when using the iron sight
● Can kill multiple targets at once


http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0211/2.png

When you fire this weapon, you can zoom in your sight. However, you should know that a round is going up when you fired but if you zoomed in and fired the round, a round is not going up. That is strange, right?

With this set, the player can get the RPG-7 for sure from Craft using the Perfect Recipe item, but the durability will determine the period of the weapon.


Showing great fire power will help you to blow out your stress. Are you ready to fight now? Let’s roll with this new rocket launcher today!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0211/3.png

VALENTINE DAY’S ITEM GIVEAWAY
Love is not always comes at first sight. However, our item giveaway event comes at here for celebrating your love. Starting from 11th February after the maintenance, you will get two new Valentine day items for free. (1 time only)


HEART BOMB
This special grenade is given for free to all players who logged in during the Valentine's Day event. It shares the same performance as the normal HE Grenade.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0211/4.png

LOVE SPRAY

notes.title: [UPDATE] NEW ROCKET LAUNCHER!
notes.notes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2016/0211.jpg
An assault rifle is very effective for individual combat but sometimes you may feel that assault rifle is not good enough to take your enemy down. That’s true. Sometimes you need to pour your firepower at your enemy. Then my recommendation is going to be RPG-7.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0211/1.png

The RPG-7 (Rocket Propelled Grenade-7) is a rocket launcher purchasable in equipment slot but serves as primary weapon. RPG-7 is a Soviet Union light, versatile anti-tank rocket propelled grenade launcher. It boasts a potent destructive power with a large area of effect, making it an ideal weapon to use against multiple or tough targets, but can also damage the operator if used in close quarters. The user can aim through the iron sights to get an accurate firing.

Through this weapon, you will expect below advantages:

● Massive damage. (In original mode, without flak vest, it gives +100 damage to the body)
● Short reload time
● Fire accurately when using the iron sight
● Can kill multiple targets at once


http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0211/2.png

When you fire this weapon, you can zoom in your sight. However, you should know that a round is going up when you fired but if you zoomed in and fired the round, a round is not going up. That is strange, right?

With this set, the player can get the RPG-7 for sure from Craft using the Perfect Recipe item, but the durability will determine the period of the weapon.


Showing great fire power will help you to blow out your stress. Are you ready to fight now? Let’s roll with this new rocket launcher today!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0211/3.png

VALENTINE DAY’S ITEM GIVEAWAY
Love is not always comes at first sight. However, our item giveaway event comes at here for celebrating your love. Starting from 11th February after the maintenance, you will get two new Valentine day items for free. (1 time only)


HEART BOMB
This special grenade is given for free to all players who logged in during the Valentine's Day event. It shares the same performance as the normal HE Grenade.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0211/4.png

LOVE SPRAY
A love spray. You can use 'Love Spray' while playing the game. This item can only be used during the event only.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0211/5.png

Please follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: [UPDATE] NEW CLASS! WALTER & CARLITO
notes.notes:
We’ve been working hard behind-the-scenes to bring you this awesome update. Now it’s time to welcome our new mercenaries. Please welcome, Walter and Carlito!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0203/1.png

Walter
Walter is a mercenary who belongs to Aegis Institute. He is a former member of the Special Forces. Although not much is known about him, his operation performance is rated as the best.

●	5% point and EXP bonus will be applied when using this class.
●	Once you purchase Walter, you will have 1x FREE Costume Box Season 1 as a present! (bonus only from 03.02.2016 to 17.02.2016)

Carlito is a mercenary from the Vanguard Troop. He is the best among the veteran members. He lost his right eye during the escape from the collapsing Vanguard Lab due to a zombie plague incident.


●	You can use [Dance] emotion with this class.
●	5% point and EXP bonus will be applied when using this class.

You can purchase Walter and Carlito from the 3rd of February after the maintenance. Purchase this class and enjoy your battle with this dancing class. (Emotion will activate with the following key combo: J + 5.)

Once again: please use "key combo: J + 5." to activate the dance move.
