notes.title: [UPDATE] Upgrade to Dual Katana and Crossbow Advance!
notes.notes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2016/0127.jpg
Surviving in a land infested by zombies is not about finding a good hiding spot, staying there for as long as possible, and limiting food consumption. At some point Survivors have to become hunters and all they need to stay alive is a good hunting weapon.

There has been no better occasion to become a permanent owner of a serious Hunter’s set than now. Perfect for close combat, the Katana can now be upgraded to the dual blades version. You can also improve the Crossbow to become even more of a lethal ranged weapon.

WEAPON UPGRADE EVENT!
Starting from 27th of January until 11th of February, you are able to upgrade those 2 weapons to more powerful versions. As a result of a successful upgrade, you will receive a completely new and improved Permanent weapon.
Note: your previous weapon will still be available in your inventory unchanged.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0127/1.png

How to upgrade these weapons? Acquire a default Katana or Crossbow and enter a room with at least 4 players. Collect 2016 kill points for Katana and 2016 for Crossbow and your weapon will become upgraded. You can check your progress of upgrading in the in-game chat notifications.

The kill points are counted as follows:

1 Bot Kill = 1 Kill Point
1 Human Player Kill = 5 Kill Points
1 Zombie Player Kill = 15 Kill Points


Dual Katana
Wield two sharp Katanas and strike down anyone who stands in your way. The two-handed slash, a special attack skill, can deal lethal damage on a single opponent.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0127/2.png

*Katana can be acquired by using a Perfect Pick Recipe set, which will guarantee successfully crafting a Katana or with enough crafting materials and a bit of luck.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0127/3.png


Crossbow Advance
A crossbow that uses 50-foot bolts features a fast rate of fire, high accuracy, and the advantage of a quiet firing sound. The flight speed of the bolt has a time difference after shooting, which is slower than bullets. The upgraded Crossbow boasts an improved structure and more enhanced performance.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0127/4.png

*The crossbow can be acquired randomly only by opening Mileage Decoders. From 27.01.2016 to 11.02.2016, the probability to receive a crossbow from the Mileage Decoder is doubled!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0127/5.png


The weapon upgrade event has officially started! Happy hunting, Survivors!


Please follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: [UPDATE] New Medals and Weapons upgrade event!
notes.notes:
X-Mas is finally over and New Year’s Day finished too. There were many things that we enjoyed during past holidays but now people don’t know what will come next. However, CSN:Z team has prepared something that you are able to enjoy in the land of Zombies.

WEAPON UPGRADE EVENT!
Starting from 13th January until 27th January, you are able to upgrade your weapon upon your calculated kill points through every matches that you play with more than 4 players in the same room.

After successful upgrade, as a result you will receive a completely new improved permanent weapon. On top of that your previous default weapon model will still be available in your inventory unchanged.

Please see below table for detail information about the weapon and sales method.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0113/2.png

For example, you buy Spas-12 Perfect Recipe and then upgrade the weapon to Spas Deluxe and then upgrade it to Spas-12 Superior. So in other words the basic weapon you get from Recipes/crafting but upgrading it is event.

NEW MEDAL ITEMS
Medal is always showing courage, honor, valor and braveness. A true warrior needs to get at least one of those in the below medal list. Check this out and see how you can get one of those in the list. Total 19 new medals are waiting for your selection.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0113/medal_list.jpg


Stop by CSN:Z daily to check newly updated medals and weapons with your friends!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Red Weapon Series Collection
notes.notes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1222/en.jpg
Do you remember the very rare red versions of classic Counter-Strike weapons? We have not forgotten about them and they are back now! All of them are available as permanent weapons only on Xmas gift promotions!

They are red-colored limited production versions of default weapons. Aside from their very seductive looks, some of them have their damage increased compared to the original counterparts.

Starting from 22nd December and only until 6th January, during the exclusive Xmas event, you can acquire them permanently for your arsenal.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1222/1.png

How to become owner of these fine weapons
It’s simple: every time you use 30x Mileage Decoders, as a special Xmas bonus you will be given an option to choose one of the unique red weapons. You can repeat that as many times as you want, to earn whole red weapons series set. It doesn’t matter if you bought Mileage Decoders, had them for free from events, or you kept them stocked from previous giveaways – each use counts towards receiving the rewards! 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1222/2.png

Don’t miss out on this event and the chance to collect all of those red weapons: Desert Eagle, Glock 18, USP 45, XM1014, M4A1, AK47, Scout, AWP, and M249. 

Don't also forget that you only have until 6th January to obtain the M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin by collecting ‘Transcendence Pieces’.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2fpccdHcFNA
The Transcendence Pieces can be obtained through Mileage Decoders. Whenever you open a Mileage Decoder, you have a chance of receiving a random amount of pieces of transcendence.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w1.png

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z! 

Facebook (English): https://www.facebook.com/CSNZ.Official/

Twitter: https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.title: [UPDATE] Xmas Event: Weapons Giveaway!
notes.notes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1218/en.jpg
The Nightmare is almost over and that means you can get ready to celebrate the upcoming Xmas period. 

The zombies surely won’t become any nicer to survivors, but the CSN:Z team has prepared something to add a bit of the winter holidays atmosphere to the land of the undead.

FREE CHRISTMAS WEAPONS DAILY
Starting from 18th December until 6th January, log in every day to CSN:Z to receive one of the unique Christmas weapons gifts. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X1.png

Each of the weapons will be given out randomly from a list presented below and for a period of 14 days.

Winchester M1887 Christmas edition
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X2.png

A lever action shotgun that fires 8 rounds of 12 gauge ammo. Flip-cocking allows for quickly terminating hostile targets. A special decoration is added to celebrate Christmas.

MG36 Christmas edition
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X3.png

A light machine gun that fires 100 rounds of 5.56mm ammo but is able to maintain high accuracy comparable to a rifle. A special decoration has been added to celebrate Christmas.

M95 Christmas edition
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X4.png

A bullpup single-shot sniper rifle firing 5 rounds of 50 cal. Its design combines the power of 50 cal rounds and sniping accuracy. A special decoration has been added to celebrate Christmas.

M134 Christmas edition
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X5.png

This minigun, which fires 200 rounds of 7.62mm, may be limited in power but its incredible rate of fire is enough to overcome this weakness. A special decoration has been added to celebrate Christmas.

MG3 Christmas edition
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X6.png

This machine gun, which fires 200 rounds of 7.62mm ammo, is the modern version of the MG42, which was known as the chainsaw of terror during WWII. Its superior firepower and high ammo capacity makes it the core of a strong offensive but slow speed and low accuracy are its weaknesses. A special decoration has been added to celebrate Christmas.

Tomahawk Christmas edition
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X7.png

The dreary winter has made an advanced payment to create a Xmas version of the Tomahawk in order to give hope back to those lonely humans. Tis the season for the Tomahawk with twinkling lights brightening up this weapon on the darkest of nights, and Rudolph antlers to subdue the enemy, Xmas style. The winter is warmer now!

Can be pushed through oncoming zombie hoards in Zombie and Zombie Scenario modes.

Stop by CSN:Z daily to celebrate the season with irresponsibly decorated high caliber firearms! 


Make sure to follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything related to CSN:Z!

The dreams are over but the true nightmare is about to begin. There has been a report that there is an ongoing experiment to revive the bosses in secret. You have to eliminate the bosses and exterminate the roots of this plot.

On the 5th and final day of the “Enter the Nightmare” expansion, your skills will be put to the final test in a fight against multiple bosses from various Zombie Scenarios. 

You will face Oberon, Revenant, Neid and Zavist, Dione, Fallen Titan, Siege Type Phobos, and Frozen Terror.

Search and eliminate all revived bosses in the lab! Bosses will appear randomly, so each survivor’s story will be slightly different. 

You meet Oberon. A first obstacle on your way to stop the experiment to destroy the laboratory.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/18-2.jpg

After killing Oberon, follow the next path! You will need to annihilate another boss, Revenant!

Revenant's Resurrection
Revenant has been resurrected, and you need to kill him through the newly opened map.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/18-3.jpg

A new assault on Revenant!
After killing Oberon and Revenant, the third path has been identified! You need to catch the third boss, Zavist and Neid!

Resurrection
Zavist and Neid have been revived. Through the newly opened 3rd map, you must kill Zavist and Neid and find a new path.

Dione has been cured. Through the newly available 4th map, you need to destroy Dione and find a new way to the final encounter.

Those dreams become more and more real. You start to wonder whether you’ll die in the real world if you die in those nightmares. You don’t really want to risk checking, but you want to get out of this deadly coma. You’re getting paranoid, somehow you have to survive this madness. 

From 14th to 18th of December, each day CSN:Z will bring a new location in which you will have to fight once again the enemies you have previously defeated. 

Welcome to Night 4 of the “Enter the Nightmare” expansion.

Annihilated: Madness, the fourth nightmare location in which you’ll find yourself in different maps. There you will pit yourself against Zombie Scenario #4 bosses.

Your target is to eliminate the Boss Zombies that appears in each round. If you succeed to destroy the last enemy, every player will obtain 2 random rewards from Zombie Scenario: Season 4.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/17-1.png

Round 2: Frozen Wrath
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/17-2.png

Round 3: Gluttony

notes.title: [UPDATE] M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin!
notes.notes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1214_nightmare/en_weapon.jpg

They are here! The “Enter the Nightmare” expansion brings 2 of the most awaited weapons. 

Starting from 14th December, only until 6th January, you can obtain the M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin by collecting ‘Transcendence Pieces’.

https://youtu.be/2fpccdHcFNA

The Transcendence Pieces can be obtained through Mileage Decoders. Whenever you open a Mileage Decoder, you have a chance of receiving a random amount of pieces of transcendence.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w1.png

Until 6th January, every day you log in, you will receive 5 Transcendence Pieces for free. On top of that, for every 30 minutes spent playing the game, you will receive an additional piece, up to 4 times a day.

Once you have collected 888 of those pieces you can exchange them for either the M4A1 Dark Knight or AK-47 Paladin. You can start the exchange for the weapon by pressing the 'Use' button.

Each of those special weapons come with a unique buff effects whenever you have them in your inventory. 

If you have the following weapons in your inventory, the effects mentioned below will be applied.


M4A1 Dark Night
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w2.png

An assault rifle that uses 50 rounds of .50 caliber special ammo. It can apply high knockback against zombies, and increase penetration with its 2nd mode to eliminate multiple enemies. If you have the following weapon in your inventory the effects mentioned below will be applied:

•	Increases the duration of Deadly Shot in Zombie Hero by 1 second.
•	Firepower is increased 5 levels at the start of the round for all players in Zombie Scenario mode (max level does not increase).
•	+200% EXP to the owner.
•	+50% EXP to the other players in the room. 



AK-47 Paladin

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w3.png

An assault rifle that uses 50 rounds of 50 caliber special rounds. It can apply high push-back against zombies, and fire in powerful semi-automatic 2nd mode. If you have the following weapon in your inventory the effects mentioned below will be applied:

•	Start Zombie Hero mode with +20% morale
•	Automatic health upgrade by 5 levels in all Zombie Scenario rooms (max level does not increase).
•	+200% EXP to the owner.
•	+50% EXP to the other players in the room.


•	The buff mark will be indicated for rooms where you can receive it. 
•	The same buffs cannot be stacked, so your bonus game EXP can be 200% max, not more, even if you possess both the M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin. 
•	The EXP buff effect can be checked from the game result screen ‘Team/Family Bonus’. 


Special Skills of the M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin
The M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin have unlimited Spare magazines in Zombie Scenario Modes.

notes.notes:

They are here! The “Enter the Nightmare” expansion brings 2 of the most awaited weapons. 

Starting from 14th December, only until 6th January, you can obtain the M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin by collecting ‘Transcendence Pieces’.

https://youtu.be/2fpccdHcFNA

The Transcendence Pieces can be obtained through Mileage Decoders. Whenever you open a Mileage Decoder, you have a chance of receiving a random amount of pieces of transcendence.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w1.png

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w2.png

AK-47 Paladin

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w3.png

•	Start Zombie Hero mode with +20% morale
•	Automatic health upgrade by 5 levels in all Zombie Scenario rooms (max level does not increase).

notes.title: [UPDATE] Annihilated: Nightmare #1
notes.notes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/over_1.jpg

You fought bravely, defeating all the threats on your way to revel secrets of Zombie Scenarios. A hero like you deserves a proper rest, a good sleep to heal the wounds. You manage to fall asleep, but in the land of the undead dreams become your worst nightmares.

From 14th to 18th of December, each day CSN:Z will bring a new location in which you will have to fight once again the enemies you have previously defeated. 

Welcome to Night 1 of the “Enter the Nightmare” expansion.

Annihilated: A nightmare challenge awaits in the Lost City for those who dare to face Zombie Scenario #1 bosses.

Your target is to eliminate the Boss Zombies that appear in each round. If you succeed to destroy the last enemy, every player will obtain 2 random rewards from Zombie Scenario: Season 1.


Round 1: Juggernaut
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/14-1.png

Round 2: Siege Type Deimos
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/14-2.png

Round 3: Phobos
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/14-3.png
				
Round 4: Siege Type Phobos
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/14-4.png

Round 5: Oberon
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/14-5.png	


http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/14-6.png

To enter the 'Annihilation: Nightmare' map, a room host needs to acquire a Nightmare Key.

A key from which the energies of powerful zombies can be felt. It feels as if you'll experience a long nightmare tonight if you hold this key. 

The key can be dropped after Zombie Scenario mode is cleared. Its duration is 1 day only.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/14-7.png

The room host must have the key, so to open 1 room you will need 1 key. Players other than the host do not need a key to join the room.

If you already have a key, you can acquire more, but the number of keys does not increase – its duration will increase. 

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: [Update] New Era of Decoder SUPREME!
notes.notes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0817/supreme.jpg

You surely noticed all the recent updates: Zombie Rework, Zombie Darkness, Free new Zombies, Zombie War. There was so much Focus on Zombies one might think CSN:Z wants the Undead to win over the Humans - permanently.

This time we brought together with Heroine and Humans brand new skills, the most devastating tool a survivor can have: Supreme Decoders.

Unique type of Decoder in a form available only in CSN:Z and only from 17.08.2015 until 16.09.2015.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_1.jpg

You open Supreme Decoders from the same Decoder menu in the game. But the results are far superior to what you got used to.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_2.jpg
Each time you open Supreme Decoder you have 85% chances to win any of BALROG, SKULL, JANUS, Maverick series, or Salamander, M32 MGL, AT4CS, Leviathan. Any of these weapons will be 70 Days versions.

Any other weapon or item you can see on the Supreme Decoder list you have the remaining 15% chances to win! However they only come in 1 supreme version: Permanently only! And the list includes: Thunderbolt, Lightning weapons, Crossbow, golden weapons series, 6 characters and so many more!

And by many more we mean some latest weapons in CSN:Z

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_3.png

Black Dragon Cannon – Permanent

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_4.png

Ripper aka Power Chainsaw - Permanent

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_5.png
Gae Bolg aka Speargun - Permanent

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_6.png
Guillotine Permanent

With all the many permanent weapons you can now simply acquire you might find yourself in a unfortunate situation where you draw a permanent weapon which you already have. Fortunately In that case instead of receiving a 2nd one you will receive a 500 Days item extension! 2 of those and you can make any weapon permanent!

We are aware this will cause an unprecedented number of weapons in players hands that needs upgrading. Therefore we decided to make it easier for everybody to get to their +8 stats and make from now on all Anti-Enhancements materials purchasable by Game Points only.

You’ll need 20.000 Points for 10 Anti-Enhancements and 50.000 Points for 30x Anti-Enhancements.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_7_en.png

Please also take notice that Supreme Decoders are separate items from Mileage Decoders and they don’t give any mileage points upon opening.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie Rework Update
notes.notes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/rework_en.jpg
What is the Zombie Rework?

Since updating so many contents for Zombies, there were lots of change requests from users regarding Zombie modes.

We listened to the users (you all!!) and below are the things that have been most recently updated.
Adding double grenades for Zombies. Two powerful weapons can be chosen for Heroes and Heroines. Yes, you can finally be a Heroine, too! Or be a Sidekick and help the Hero or Heroine. A Sidekick also can be equipped with some powerful weapons.

You can also restrict the Zombie selection. The freedom to balance Zombie matches is now in your hands. You can also choose what kind of Zombie you want to be when you revive.

And the all-time most requested skills that users have asked for has been added: Bloody Blade and Deadly Shot. Now Humans can deal fatal damage to Zombies for 5 seconds to have more room to escape or annihilate them all.

There are many other changes in this patch, so please check the list below for details:

[Zombie Rework update]

1. New feature
- You can now play as Heroine in Zombie Hero mode, if you possess and have selected a female character.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_6.jpg

2. New items
- Double zombie grenade: double shock, one after another. It causes shock upon contact.
- 2 heroic weapons are added: M134 Vulcan and Dual Kriss Custom.
- You can now select or cancel heroic weapons.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_7.jpg

3. Sidekick
- In support of Heroes and Heroines, random players will be chosen as Sidekicks.
- Hidden weapons from the Supply Boxes can now be acquired upon being selected as a Sidekick.

4. Supply Box function change
- Ammo supplies, night vision goggles, and grenades available in Supply Boxes.
- Weapon buy now available again through Supply Boxes. (Cannot acquire hidden weapons anymore.)

5. Zombie Selection
- You can choose to become a different type of zombie upon revival.
- You can edit the zombie selection sequence in [Edit Buy Menu] from [My Info]
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_8_en.jpg

6. Option to restrict classes of zombies
- You can now restrict classes of zombies in the game options.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_9_en.png

7. Zombie skills
- Common skills added.
- Leap, Harden, and Confuse skills removed.
- Skills have been changed:

   Jump: Jumping ability increased for a set period.
   Regenerate: Recover a set amount of HP.
   Protect: Recover a set amount of armor.
   Trap: A set trap will move automatically once it detects a human.
   Charge: Movement speed lowered for a moment, but ignores knockback.
   Recover skill from Venom Guard: Instantly recovers half of its maximum HP.
   Rage: HP is no longer consumed upon use, but cooldown is now increased.
   Pulling: Pulling strength is decreased a tad bit.
   Heal: Healing amount decreased a bit, and cooldown increased.
   (Also, cooldown for other skills have been changed.)

8. Zombie classes abilities adjusted.
- Light Zombie
   Defense is reduced a small amount.

- Heavy Zombie
   Defense is reduced a small amount.

- Stomper
   Defense is increased a small amount.
   Movement speed is reduced a small amount.
   Jumping ability is reduced a small amount.

- Banshee
   Movement speed is increased a small amount.
   Jumping ability is increased a small amount.
   Defense is reduced a small amount.

- Voodoo Zombie
   Movement speed is increased a small amount.
   Defense is increased a small amount.

- Psycho Zombie
   Defense is increased a small amount.

- Ganymede
   Defense is increased a small amount.
   Movement speed is reduced a small amount.
   Jumping ability is reduced a small amount.

- Deimos
   Movement speed is reduced a small amount.
   Jumping ability is reduced a small amount.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_10.jpg

9. Human Skills

Deadly Shot: When activated, its user can do fatal damage to zombies for 5 seconds.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_11.png

Bloody Blade: When activated, its user's melee weapon's damage is doubled for 5 seconds. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_12.png

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/update_en.jpg

The CSN:Z team has decided to update the game based on the feedback of users.

One of the most impressive updates is the ‘Vote Kick Renewal’. Many users kept talking about ‘Vote Kick’, calling it ‘abusive’ and ‘misused’. Thankfully, as a result of the renewal, those users consider the game to be headed in the right direction – one might call the approach ‘democratic’.

Another remarkable update is the separation of the chat windows into two division. We heard user complaints about system messages always covering player chats. Well that is no longer an issue.

One thing also to be highlighted is the Inventory arranging/search function. This is what we should have done at the beginning of service, admittedly. And now you can re-arrange your inventory as you wish. It is more convenient and more comfortable.

There are many other changes in this patch, so please check the list below for details:

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_1.jpg

[All for Users Update]
1. Vote Kick Renewal
- The Vote Kick system has been renewed so that it cannot be abused and misused, and is headed in the right direction.
- You can use the vote kick only 5 times per day.
- The one being subjected to a vote kick will have a moment to convey his defense against the kick before the vote commences.
- The vote kick item can only be used in a room with 3 or more players.
- Once the vote begins, players can either say Yes (F3), No (F4), or Withdraw (ESC). Withdrawing will not be considered as a valid vote.
- In order to carry out the vote kick, a certain percentage of the players in the room must vote, either ‘yes’ or ‘no’, and in order to kick the person out from the room, a majority of the voting players must have said ‘yes’.
- The Vote Kick item can only be used by a player who has been in the room for more than 3 minutes.
- After using a Vote Kick, regardless of the result, the item can be reused after 1 minute.
- You have to be at least level 20 to be able to purchase the Vote Kick item

2. Zombie War in the zombie rankings
- Zombie War is now included in the Zombie League rankings.
- Upon playing in Zombie War mode, Zombie League ranking points can be earned.

3. Division in chat window
- Normal messages and system messages are now separated.
- Now players can chat with ease in the new chat layout.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_2_en.jpg

4. Inventory arrange/search function renewed
- Inventory renewed so that owned items can be seen and checked more easily.
- Item categorization is further divided so that items can be better organized.
- Newly acquired items will be labeled “new” on the top of its icon to ease its finding in the Inventory.
- Function added so that items can be arranged by name, date acquired, or category.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_3_en.png

5. Expanded Blacklist
- Increased to 150 from the previous 30.

6. Number of times allowed to receive special missions increased (again)
- Increased the count to re-receive special missions.
- Before: Premium Item 5 times.
- After: Standard 2 times/ Premium Item 7 times (total 9 times).

7. Weapon crafting cost and time required reduced
- Crafting time reduced to 0.75 from 1.00 seconds.
- Crafting cost reduced 20%. (For unlimited crafting, reduced to 12800 from 16000).

8. Demo renewed
- Now players are able to record videos other than the Demo. Recording options can be found under Options.
- For a proper playback of the videos, MP2 (MPEG-1 Layer 2) and MPEG1 codecs must be installed.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_4_en.png

9. Item auto-equip fixed (Costumes)
- Costumes now can be automatically equipped, if there aren’t any costumes currently equipped. If a costume is currently equipped, then newly acquired costume will not be automatically equipped.

10. Human Scenario Buy menu renewed.
- UI changed, Favorites tab added.
- Buy menu now can be seen even when dead.

11. Issue where game options could not be saved is fixed
- Temporary bug where game options could not be saved is now fixed.

12. Minigun sound bug fix
- Fixed an issue where the sound of the spinning barrel of the M134 would be constantly played when a player was spectating another player also using the M134.

13. Dismantling Blueprints/Durables
- Blueprints/Durables can now be dismantled.
- If the mentioned items are dismantled, 2 lower-tiered items can be acquired.
- If you wish to change the category of the current Blueprint, it can be demolished and then crafted into another one.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_5_en.png

notes.notes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/Darkness/01st_season4_map4.jpg

Your greatest Zombie Scenario fight awaits! Log in today to see if you can defeat the FINAL map of CSN:Z’s latest Zombie Scenario expansion. It’s also a great time to get your 10x FREE Decoders from our latest daily login event!


Click for Français , Deutsch ,Italiano ,Polski , Türkçe , Pусский , Português , Español.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0701_2.jpg

Did Gerrard and Jim, Leader of the Red Lizard Mercenaries, ever think agreeing to locate some research samples would take them on a path straight towards such a sinister villain? Dr. Rex and his Super Soldier Project are the source of the Zombies, and the reason for so many ruined lives. However, this monster has long since been lost to the Darkness, and this leaves our heroes only one option.

There’s no turning back now! Someone must put a stop to Dr. Rex, or else the world may forever be lost in Darkness.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0701_3.jpg

It will hurt if you rush into this battle blindly, as Dr. Rex has some aces left up his sleeve and you will need to truly be prepared for a fight. Not only will your team need to coordinate and cooperate to advance through this latest map’s challenges, but some big foes are standing between you and Dr. Rex.

Dr. Rex has an army of the undead, powerful Super Soldiers, and towering monsters at his disposal—no, he will not go quietly. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0701_4.png

Veterans of Zombie Scenario may recognize some of his attacks, Dr. Rex ‘reflecting’ some of his most devastating creations in this showdown, but don’t let your guard down. Keep your distance from Dr. Rex, a man consumed by Darkness shows no mercy and may kill you instantly!

Are you prepared to reveal what has been at the root of such horrifying Darkness? Dr. Rex is waiting for you…

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0701_5.jpg

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie Shelter Map HELLRIDE is now available!
notes.notes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/Darkness/30th_shelter.jpg

All aboard! Zombie Shelter has just gotten a new Co-Op map with new challenges for your squad to try and survive. Log in today to get a turn on the train car and get your 10x FREE Decoders!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0625_1.jpg

Click for Français , Deutsch ,Italiano ,Polski , Türkçe , Pусский , Português , Español.


Zombie Shelter not only puts your survival skills to the test, it also requires a team of survivors to really flex their carpentry skills! Each day offers a limited window of time to gather resources and explore further away from the team’s shelter, but when night arrives Humans must work together to keep their shelter from succumbing to the undead. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_2.jpg

To stay alive, up to 4 team members need to construct additions and improvements to their Shelter using resources collected throughout the map.

Get resources, build watch towers, kill Zombies, defeat bosses, race traincars… hold on a second, what was that last one?

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_3.jpg

HELLRIDE is the first map in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies to include vehicles! In the map are 2 traincars that players can operate, allowing for much faster movement throughout the map. Just as teams must work together to survive each day of Zombie Shelter, remember to take turns! 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_4.png

When in a traincar, press the [E] key to operate it. While operating a traincar tap the forward or backward movement keys (default: [W] and [S] keys.) to accelerate forwards, reduce speed, or switch down to reverse gear.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_5.png

Teamwork is also required for making the most of the traincars, such as clearing obstacles off the tracks and controlling which paths are taken using the rail’s switches. 

Zombie Shelter Tips
Of course, it doesn’t hurt to understand some important tips about making the most of Zombie Shelter!

--Share Resources: Wood and Iron collected is stored on your character, but don’t go hoarding it. Put Wood and Iron in the Shelter’s storage of resources so other team members can get to work on constructing needed buildings.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_6.jpg

--Build it Big: Press the[noparse]  [/noparse]key in-game to see what is available to construct. There’s a large variety of choices to help your team survive each day of Zombie Shelter. It’s important to know that some construction options have dependencies, and you may have to start small before the very big choices are possible.

--Use Your Skills: Press the [N] key in-game to apply skill points towards a variety of different talents. Surviving more days means more skill points, so do not forget to put your skills to use!

--Mind the Meter: Home is where the heart is, but it’s also immediately vital to your survival! At the bottom of your screen is a meter that depletes when traveling away from your Shelter. 


http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_7.jpg

If it depletes fully, your HP will begin to drop until either you get back to the Shelter or die on your feet! If your vision begins to go dark, it’s a warning you need to get back to the Shelter ASAP. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_8.jpg

Don’t get too caught up in the fun of dueling traincars in HELLRIDE, as Zombie Shelter is both about daily surviving and surviving the worst of which Zombies can throw at a team of Humans…

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_9.png


Let us know what you think in the comments and CSN:Z Forums. Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.notes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/Darkness/29th_season4_map3.jpg

The incredible battle through Darkness continues with the next Zombie Scenario Season 4 map! Log in today to take on map 3 of CSN:Z’s latest Zombie Scenario expansion, and also get your 10x FREE Decoders from our latest event!

Click for Français , Deutsch ,Italiano ,Polski , Türkçe , Pусский , Português , Español.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0629_2.jpg

Whoever Gerrard and Jim, Leader of the Red Lizard Mercenaries, are tracking down is no ordinary fiend. This much is true even if the monster has managed to keep their identity in the dark. As battle torn and weary as these mercenary teams may be, they have come too far to stop now.

Who could imagine that the dangers awaiting these Zombie-battling mercenaries grow even larger and greater? And, possibly, they may encounter revelations even more twisted...

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0629_3.jpg

Zombie Scenario is not about fair fights, so no one should be surprised that a true challenge waits at the end. With Map 3 of Zombie Scenario Season 4, it is the first time the boss battle is teaming up against the Humans!

Your eyes are not playing tricks on you. Players must face off against two towering super soldiers, Neid and Zavist. Both Neid and Zavist must be defeated, and do not pretend that they will not team up against Humans who are foolish enough to reach them and put their incredible size and strength to use in the fight. Goodness, those are some huge swords…

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0629_4.png

Those who have lasted this long while venturing so deep into the Darkness are brave souls. A commendable effort for uncovering the evil which lurks this far, but the journey to defeat it is not over yet.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie Darkness mode is now available!
notes.notes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/Darkness/zombie_darkness.jpg

Zombie VS Human PvP combat is about to take a dark turn! The latest mode Zombie Darkness is now available. Log in to try it out and get your 10x FREE Decoders from our latest event!

Click for Français , Deutsch ,Italiano ,Polski , Türkçe , Pусский , Português , Español.

In Zombie Darkness, new grotesque classes of Zombies are waiting to spread the undead infection to you and your currently-living team mates. However, don’t suit up for battle thinking all your strategies and tricks you’ve been refining will work as well in these new arenas. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_2.png

Normally, a strong camping strategy can outlast the undead. In Zombie Darkness, each map transitions from daylight to twilight, and under the cover of darkness, the Zombies gain a powerful advantage. Both all new Zombie classes and Human players will have new tricks to learn, making Zombie Darkness a new challenge for both long time survivors and newcomers alike!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_3.jpg

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_4.jpg

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_5.jpg

Humans have new ways of keeping the Darkness at bay, but they’ll need it to take on the nightmarish creations they’ll find in that Darkness…

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_6.jpg

NORMAL ZOMBIE – As the name implies, these Zombies are a staple of Zombie Darkness. Sprinting is great for ambushing unsuspecting Human enemies, but it is their wall climbing ability which can turn the tide in favor of the living dead. The Humans will be trying to hide high out of reach, so don’t let them get too comfortable.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_7.jpg

LIGHT ZOMBIE – Less hearty than other classes, the Light Zombie does not excel at defense but makes up for this with the ability to leap high distances. When leaping between buildings cannot get the job done, the invisibility skill can help get the drop on distracted Humans. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_8.jpg

HEAVY ZOMBIE – Speed? Mobility? Subtlety? These are not ways the Heavy Zombie class rolls. Unleash a powerful slam to the ground to get Humans shaking in their boots, or harden against incoming fire to withstand even greater amounts of damage.

Could Humans possibly withstand even more undead terror as nightfall approaches?... 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_9.png

Are you afraid of the Darkness? CSN:Z’s latest in Zombie PVP mode may test if you can keep your composure as night approaches, but everyone is still being drawn deeper into the void…

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie Files mode is now available!
notes.notes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/Darkness/Zombie_files.jpg

If you’re brave enough, try our new Zombie Files mode in CSN:Z and learn how the Zombie outbreak began. On top of our new mode, log in to get your 10x FREE Decoders from our latest event!

Click for Français , Deutsch ,Italiano ,Polski , Türkçe , Pусский , Português , Español.

Not everyone is a mercenary, soldier, or gun toting professional in an outbreak of the undead. Senior Researcher Soi is far more familiar with a pipette than a pistol, but she rose to the occasion and survived!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0626_2.jpg

…But, how did Senior Researcher Soi survive? How did the outbreak begin? To find out, you must uncover what is within the Zombie Files…

SPRINTING, STAMINA, SURVIVAL

Zombie Files provides a much different challenge than what you may be used to in existing modes like Zombie Scenario or Zombie Hero. Being a single player mode, there won’t be any team mates to watch your back but a group of players can join a match to indirectly compete for fastest map completion.

Another important difference is Stamina, which governs the actions Senior Researcher Soi can perform. Sprinting will come in handy, but getting winded trying to escape may prevent you from attacking any zombies until your Stamina refills!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0626_3.jpg

Use your wits to survive in the Zombie Files. The body count may just end up adding your own to the pile!

HELPFUL SURVIVAL TIPS
Find throwable items to lure Zombies away from your path before proceeding further, they’ll follow the sound of the object landing!
Sprinting may let you escape, but keeping quiet may prevent the Zombies from ever giving chase to begin with.
Grab a breather when you can. Stamina recharges, but takes a moment of time to refill completely.
Finding weapons is a staple of any Zombie outbreak, but just like a Zombie outbreak it is vital to conserve ammo! You’ll have to find another gun if the one you have runs out of ammo.


ESCAPING ZOMBIES AND EXECUTING ZOMBIES

Should your best efforts flop, it may become a life or death struggle with the Zombies. Always try to keep your distance or else Zombies may grab you and steadily drain your HP! Repeatedly press the [E] key to ESCAPE and quickly put space between yourself and the undead.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0626_4.jpg

However, there is value for getting in close when a Zombie is on the verge of defeat. Get in close and press the [E] key to instantly finish off the walking corpse!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0626_5.jpg


The secrets of the Zombie Files can be revealed to you, but only if you can survive to the bitter end. Don’t worry! It’s not like humanity’s fate is resting in the hands of one researcher caught in the epicenter of a Zombie infection outbreak, right?

…Right? 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0626_6.png

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie Giant mode is now available!
notes.notes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/1_en.png

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/menu1.png

Today uncovers the first horrifying secret of the Darkness, and it is truly a GIANT one. Log in today to not only try out CSN:Z’s brand new mode ZOMBIE GIANT, but also to get your 10x FREE Decoders from our latest event!


Click for Français , Deutsch ,Italiano ,Polski , Türkçe , Pусский
Português Español.


Mode Review:
In CSN:Z’s latest game mode, Humans take on Zombies in exciting combat to either survive another day or succumb to the terrors of the undead. This may all seem familiar to our experienced players, but Zombie Giant is anything but.

A Human player is randomly selected to join the Zombie team, but as a towering terrifying Zombie Boss! Suddenly, joining the undead doesn’t seem so bad. 

Humans will need to work as a team to take down the massive beast that used to be their comrade, but then another is selected to unleash some damage...

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_1.jpg

Zombie Team:
There are 3 Zombie Bosses that the player may become when selected to join the Zombie Team: Dione, Revenant, or Fallen Titan. They’re all great for destroying puny Humans, but make sure to put their unique skills to work for you.

Four skills are available, but the final fourth skill is only available if you’re a proper Zombie Giant and take out enough Human enemies to Evolve during combat.

Human Team:
Odds do not seem to be in the Human’s favor, but when are they ever? Don’t give up hope just yet! For scoring kills on the Zombie Giants, or doing your part to help, Humans are awarded Support Points that can be used to level the playing field.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_2.png

For starters, you’re not alone in this fight! Bot characters will help Humans chip away at the Zombie Giant. This is a good start, but the Humans will need more.
A few Support Points can be spent to restock for another skirmish, and building a larger stockpile of Support Points can put some military-grade weaponry in the map to work for you… but if you get truly wealthy with Support Points?

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_4.jpg

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_3.png

Let’s just say it will be a hell of a fight.

It’s good to be bad! Log in to CSN:Z today and serve up some GIANT sized mayhem.

Odds do not seem to be in the Human’s favor, but when are they ever? Don’t give up hope just yet! For scoring kills on the Zombie Giants, or doing your part to help, Humans are awarded Support Points that can be used to level the playing field.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_2.png

A few Support Points can be spent to restock for another skirmish, and building a larger stockpile of Support Points can put some military-grade weaponry in the map to work for you… but if you get truly wealthy with Support Points?

notes.notes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/banner_en_spreading.jpg

The Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies team is proud to announce some big additions in our latest update... continent-sized additions to be specific!

Click for Français , Deutsch ,Italiano ,Polski , Türkçe , Pусский
Português Español.


Quick rundown:
-- CSN:Z now offers language support for Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.
-- Regions of South America and MENA are now officially supported by CSN:Z.
-- 10x Free Decoders at login each day through 1st July.
-- New rewards in Decoder with increased probability event from 24th June through 7th of July
-- Decoders from Battlefield Supply on days 4 and 7 and new daily rewards. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang1.png

Whether shooting Zombies with friends, shooting friends that are Zombies, or enjoying all the rest which CSN:Z has to offer, it can make a world of difference being able to do so in your preferred language.

To help make CSN:Z a great experience for even more of our players, we have added Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese language options. 

Whether you want to use these new languages, or switch to any of the other languages CSN:Z supports, you can do this through the Interface page of the Steam Settings window.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang2.jpg

The CSN:Z Team is proud to announce that even more countries around the globe can join in on the Zombie mayhem. It just wouldn’t feel like a proper Zombie outbreak if the infection didn’t start hopping to new continents! Starting 24.06, the new regions 

being officially supported can access CSN:Z and get started playing.

South American regions CSN:Z has been opened to:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang2.png

MENA regions CSN:Z has been opened to;
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang3.png

What better way is there to welcome these new regions to CSN:Z than with FREE Decoders?

Each day from 24th June through 1st July, receive 10x Decoders for FREE instantly when logging in to CSN:Z. Log in every day of the event to get 10x bundle of FREE Decoders!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0625_1.jpg

Remember that every Decoder activated also awards a random sum of Mileage. Spend the Mileage you’ve accumulated on your Bingo Board to unlock even MORE rewards.

Please note that the event is set to Central Europe Summer Time (CEST), please check the difference between your region’s time zone and CEST when making sure you log in to get every reward.

…And what better to go with tons of FREE Decoders than new Decoder rewards?

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang3.jpg

Avalanche – This is more than just a futuristic looking machine gun! Switch between the Avalanche’s different firing modes to land more precise controlled shots or live up to the weapon’s name with an Avalanche of lead.

Blaster – With its large capacity 45 round magazine, the Blaster rifle can sling some serious amounts of lead at a target before needing to reload. The CSN:Z Team will understand if you still choose to reload after firing only a few shots just to watch the Blaster load and unload each magazine.

Take advantage of increased probability event to get a hold of the brand new Avalanche and Blaster!

From 24th of June through 7th of July both weapons will have double the chances to be drawn from Decoder.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang4.png

You can see the event is running by the golden tag and a x2 sign next to those items from within the Decoder menu.

LOG IN! – Free Decoders from Battlefield Supply and new weapon sets.
From 24th of June, redeeming your daily Battlefield Supply reward will get you free Decoders. On the 4th  reward day, the prize is 1x Decoder. On the 7th reward day, the prize is 2x Decoders.  
Additionally each other day you will receive limited duration, high ROF weapons: MG3, MG36, MK48, M134, M2.
This will surely help any survivor to fight of new hordes of Zombies that came along with latest content expansion.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang5.jpg

In case you were wondering what is this new Coupon system in the Item Shop, we can tell you we  have prepared something special for CSN:Z, that will become active very soon. Stay tuned for more information revealed in following weeks.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang6.png


Let us know what you think in the comments and CSN:Z Forums. Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

NEW GUNS AND PERFECT PICK RECIPE BUNDLES

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0212/3.jpg

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - 11-27 Content Update
notes.notes:
In addition to new content added to Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies for the end of year holidays, changes have been made to address feedback and problems reported by the CSN:Z Community.


Design Changes: 
•If you leave a Family, now only 2 days are required before being able to join a new Family (instead of 2 weeks).
•Upgrading a Zombie Class now only requires 5 skills to be raised to at least Level 5 first.
•Rankings for new players have been rebalanced, with less EXP required per rank through Lv. 10.
--NOTE: This design change may result in your rank level being higher following the update.
•Recipe slots have been removed from the Crafting menu as the CSN:Z Team makes further changes to improve Crafting.

Bug Fixes: 
•Added support for 1366x768 and 1360x768 game resolutions during gameplay.
•Set CSN:Z window to a borderless mode when game is launched on smaller sized windows desktops.
•Corrected incorrect name of Zombie Scenario boss from “Seize” to “Siege”.
•Corrected reward notifications for certain Scenario maps stating the wrong map completed.

Other Details: 
•Made general improvements to text through game for all supported languages.

notes.title: CSN:Z Update: Ver. 1.1- 05.11.2014
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors,

We are going to perform a maintenance and client patching on 05.11.2014 from 05:00 – 07:00 CET.

An update to CSN:Z will include following changes:

Additional content:

Added two new Zombies: Deimos and Ganymede. They will be also available in Zombie Enhancement menu.
Added Vote-To-Kick item.
Halloween items event enabled.
Added Cannon Shoot (Only for Football Mode)


Changes in design:

Changed items given in battlefield supply.
Battlefield supply window will now pop-up after launching the game instead of Announcement window.
All the maps of Season 2 Zombie Scenario will be unlocked
Walls and barricades can be destroyed more easily on Easy and Normal difficulty
Adjusted requirements to clear Zombie Scenario maps: Lost City and Trap
Made "Quick entry" and go back arrow more visible in the game main menu.
Crafting: Items are now sorted.
Crafting: Right mouse button works now like left button double click
Removed Jennifer and Natasha from the shop

Bug Fixes:

Achievement system fixed
Localization fixes


Known issue:
Mission: "Kill Zombies in First Contact (0/1000)" should be “Kill the Fallen Titan once”

Regards, 
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Maintenance][Finished] 12.10.2014, CEST - A patch update for the connection error reported including compensations.
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors, 

As we already had mentioned that the CSN:Z Team is currently working on creating a patch and building a new client to fix the connection error to servers.

We will implement the fix today (12.10.2014) during a technical maintenance beginning at 03:00AM CEST. During the maintenance, which lasts from 03:00AM - 05:00AM CEST, all game servers will be unavailable.

In addition, we prepared a compensation package for making a huge trouble today. 

[A patch]

- A fixed server patch for users to connect log in server 

[Compensation]

Players who login from today after the patch until 11:59PM, 19th of Oct will receive a package including Grade-A Blueprints X3, 24-30 Day Durables X3 and 19,200 Points per each account. 

It will be issued once per each account.

Thanks to all of your supports and patience, we can continue to work on improving the game and resolving all issues. 

Regards, 
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Update] Connectivity issue
notes.notes:
[Updated] Oct 13th

Dear Survivors, 

Connection issues were affecting many of you over the weekend. A fix has been implemented on our end to correct this problem. 
We can't thank you enough for the support you have shown CSN:Z during its first full weekend even in light of such problems. 

To get this week started on a better foot you can enjoy a 200% bonus on XP and GP for all the matches completed. It's already live and will run until tomorrow October 14th, 9am (CEST). 

Additionally every survivor that logs in the game until 9am Wednesday October 15th(CEST) will receive a special support package that includes 3x [A] Blueprints , 3x 24~30 Day Durables, and 19,200 Game Points! 

Once again, a big thanks to everyone for being a part of CSN:Z. 

See you in the game! 

Sincerely 
CSN:Z Team

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
[Updated]

An issue report from 14:00PM to 18:58PM, Oct 12
Dear Survivors. 

Yes, we did something for fixing it. However, we have not fully fixed it yet due to unknown socket errors in login servers. We need all of human resources from everywhere in the World but we stuck in weekend. 

[Updated] 

- 18:20PM, Oct 12th, CEST - The login server issue has not been eradicated yet. 

- 200% buffs and XP set up until the issue will be solved. 

If you guys can give us 1 more day to find out and keep playing with unstable servers yet, we will do fix it definitely. 

Sincerely, 
CSN:Z Team 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
Dear Survivors, 

As we already had mentioned that the CSN:Z Team is currently working on creating a patch and building a new client to fix the connection error to servers. 

We will implement the fix today (12.10.2014) during a technical maintenance beginning at 03:00AM CEST. During the maintenance, which lasts from 03:00AM - 05:00AM CEST, all game servers will be unavailable. 

In addition, we prepared a compensation package for making a huge trouble today. 

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[A patch] 

- A fixed server patch for users to connect log in server 

[Compensation] 

Players who login from today after the patch until 11:59PM, 19th of Oct will receive a package including Grade-A Blueprints X3, 24-30 Day Durables X3 and 19,200 Points per each account. 

It will be issued once per each account. 

Thanks to all of your supports and patience, we can continue to work on improving the game and resolving all issues. 

Dear Survivors. 

Regardless of our efforts, the issue has not been fixed yet. First, new connection we built last night is now unstable. 

Almost one third of users can access the servers due to limited of line allocated. 

As a staff of CSN:Z, It is to be regretted that we didn't expect and forecasted multi telecom related server issues. 

Now that we must go deep into the machines, we are about to have an hour maintenance from now on. 

[Urgent Maintenance] 

16:45PM, Oct 12th to 17:45PM - Machine analysis. 

I am assure that there might be a chance to express our deepest apology not only with a text with lots of excuses but also face to face via on/offline. 

Please keep with us and scolding us for this issue. 

Sincerely 
CSN:Z Team 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

Dear Survivors 

14:00PM, Oct 12th - A connection failure happened yesterday has been detected. 

We acknowledged that the issue was resolved but unstable. 

Thus, we did several measures to step up and build up concrete connections to servers. 

However, it happened again. Nonetherless we know the issue and how to deal with. 

We are handling it now and it will be resolved asap. Please keep patient with it and monitoring with us! 

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

[Updated] 

22:13PM, Oct 11th - The issue has been resolved temporarily. 

Currently the issue has been temporarily resolved. Over last few hours, we have excavated the issue with connecting server and sudden server crashes in various regions. 

We are preparing a patch to fix the issue and are scheduled to have a maintenance with downtime. 

Once we conduct a patch with a maintenance for designated period from an hour to 3 hours, the issue should be resolved affirmatively. 

Many of users are suffering from our connectivity issue and we must apology once again. All of our staffs in various countries are working toghether regardless of time differences. 

We will post a maintenance hour once again. 

We really appreciate your taking care of the issue, putting up with it and lots of cheering ups and hating ups. Both are to be our big energy and reason why we must do more efforts for our users. 

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

Dear Survivors. 

First of all, we must express our sincere apology not to cope with the issue in time and we are still investigating the issue. However, it takes a few more hours from now on. 

For several hours, we've been receiving reports of connection issues with our game service. We have conducted a system-wide check and found some technical problems with log in servers. Because of this, it has affected connections of all new CSN:Z players and current users as well. 

We are currently working on addressing this issue and get our game service back to normal. We will give an update as soon as we resolve it. 

We cannot appreciate your continued support and we know some of users will permanently hate us. However, we try to our best to show our endeavors to communicate with all of users. 

And we exactly know the compensations are not always the best solution. But we will do what we can support with all our respects. 

[Isuue report] 

1.13:26PM, Oct 11th - Users bounced back to Windows A.K.A the server crash. 

2.16:04PM, Oct 11th - We restrarted game server in EU but it had not been effected all users yet. 

3.19:00PM, Oct 11th - We announced additional server restart to restore users' sessions. However, it had not been resolved the issue. 

4.20:00PM, Oct 11th - We had conducted a system-wide investigation with physical machines, and we found out the issue. 

5.21:37PM, Oct 11th - We announced the issue and what we are doing now. 

We will keep you posted once the issue will be resolved. 

Once again, please keep patient and understanding more. 

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
We would like to keep you updated about the connectivity issue that happened today 11.10 at 14 pm CEST. 

We are still investigating the issue 11.10 8 pm CEST. 
Please check announcements, we will keep you informed. 
We are sorry for the inconveniences and would be happy to provide compensation on Monday. 

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Connectivity issue happened on 11.10 from 14 pm (CEST) and it still present now (11.10 7 pm).
Currently we are looking into this problem.
Despite our hard efforts we can't completely resolve it now.
But we would like to assure you that we are doing all the possible to fix it.
As a gratitude for your patience on Monday we will provide compensation to all affected users.

We are sorry for the inconvenience.

We would like to update you about the status of the issue.
8 pm 11.10 we are still looking into the problem. 


Thank you.
CSN:Z Team
